[Bench] Save server queue time and TTFT in detailed results (#55809)

Signed-off-by: zhicheng Liu <lzc021026@gmail.com>
Co-authored-by: OpenAI Codex <noreply@openai.com>
Co-authored-by: Roy Wang <jasonailu87@gmail.com>

@@ -158,6 +158,56 @@ In this example, the benchmark observes two 40 ms ITL samples. The three tokens
 in the second streamed output do not create additional ITL samples, so mean ITL
 is 40 ms. TPOT is `(180 ms - 100 ms) / (5 - 1) = 20 ms/token`.
 
+#### Saving Server-Side Per-Request Metrics
+
+When the server is started with
+[`--enable-per-request-metrics`](../features/per_request_metrics.md#enabling),
+`vllm bench serve` can preserve the server-side queue time and TTFT for each
+request. These fields are populated only by the `openai`, `vllm`, and
+`openai-chat` backends.
+
+Start the server:
+
+```bash
+vllm serve meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct \
+  --enable-per-request-metrics
+```
+
+Then run the benchmark in another terminal:
+
+```bash
+vllm bench serve \
+  --backend openai \
+  --endpoint /v1/completions \
+  --model meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct \
+  --save-result \
+  --save-detailed
+```
+
+The detailed result includes `server_queue_times` and `server_ttfts`, in
+seconds, when at least one request has an available server queue time or
+TTFT. Their indices align with the other per-request arrays, with unavailable
+values represented as `null`. Both arrays are omitted when neither metric is
+available for any request.
+
+`server_queue_times` measures server scheduler waiting time, while
+`server_ttfts` measures time from scheduling to first token generation.
+Client-side `ttfts` measures time from sending a request until receiving its
+first streamed token. Approximately, for each request:
+
+```text
+ttft ≈ server_queue_time + server_ttft + frontend/network overhead
+```
+
+Frontend/network overhead includes tokenization, chat-template application,
+multimodal preprocessing, detokenization, and transport. Client-side
+`queue_times` measures waiting for a benchmark concurrency slot before the
+request is sent, separately from the TTFT decomposition above.
+
+Enabling per-request metrics adds server CPU overhead, especially at high
+concurrency. Treat these as diagnostic runs rather than headline performance
+measurements.
+
 #### Results Visualization
 
 The `--plot-timeline` and `--plot-dataset-stats` can be used to generate respectively the requests completion timeline and dataset prompt and output tokens statistics, which can be useful for debugging purpose or for deeper analysis.

     monkeypatch.setattr(alloc_conf.torch.cuda, "memory", _NoSnapshot)
     assert alloc_conf.expandable_segments_enabled() is None
+
+
+def test_non_expandable_allocations(monkeypatch):
+    conf = "max_split_size_mb:512,expandable_segments:True"
+    writes: list[str] = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        alloc_conf, "current_alloc_conf", lambda: writes[-1] if writes else conf
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(alloc_conf, "set_alloc_conf", writes.append)
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError), alloc_conf.non_expandable_allocations():
+        assert writes == ["max_split_size_mb:512,expandable_segments:False"]
+        with alloc_conf.non_expandable_allocations():  # already off: no-op
+            pass
+        raise RuntimeError("capture failed")
+    assert writes == ["max_split_size_mb:512,expandable_segments:False", conf]

+def _num_memcpy_nodes(graph: torch.cuda.CUDAGraph) -> int:
+    hip = ctypes.CDLL(find_loaded_library("libamdhip64"))
+    handle = ctypes.c_void_p(graph.raw_cuda_graph())
+    num = ctypes.c_size_t()
+    assert hip.hipGraphGetNodes(handle, None, ctypes.byref(num)) == 0
+    nodes = (ctypes.c_void_p * num.value)()
+    assert hip.hipGraphGetNodes(handle, nodes, ctypes.byref(num)) == 0
+    node_type = ctypes.c_int()
+    count = 0
+    for node in nodes:
+        assert (
+            hip.hipGraphNodeGetType(ctypes.c_void_p(node), ctypes.byref(node_type)) == 0
+        )
+        count += node_type.value == 1  # hipGraphNodeTypeMemcpy
+    return count
+
+
+@ray.remote(num_gpus=1, max_calls=1)

+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,

+        device = torch.device(f"cuda:{rank}")

+        conf = alloc_conf.with_conf_flag(

+        )
+        alloc_conf.set_alloc_conf(conf)
+        init_test_distributed_environment(tp_size, pp_size, rank, distributed_init_port)
+        ensure_model_parallel_initialized(tp_size, pp_size)
+        assert get_tp_group().device_communicator.aiter_ar_comm.registers_graph_buffers
+
+        def capture_allreduce(capture_ctx) -> int:
+            shape, dtype = test_cases[-1]
+            with capture_ctx as graph_capture_context:
+                inp = torch.ones(shape, dtype=dtype, device=device)
+                torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+                graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph(keep_graph=True)
+                with torch.cuda.graph(graph, stream=graph_capture_context.stream):
+                    out = tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce(inp)
+            graph.replay()
+            torch.testing.assert_close(out, inp * tp_size)
+            return _num_memcpy_nodes(graph)

+        # Without the guard, AITER stages the VMM-backed input through a copy.
+        unguarded = get_tp_group().graph_capture(
+            GraphCaptureContext(torch.cuda.Stream(device=device))

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""MNNVL all-reduce with Beam's FP32 sandwich-norm epilogue."""
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.moe_output import UnfinalizedMoEOutput
+from vllm.utils.flashinfer import has_flashinfer
+from vllm.utils.math_utils import cdiv, round_up
+
+_NUM_LAMPORT_BUFFERS = 3
+# FlashInfer's MNNVL one-shot cutoff on the BF16 payload staged across ranks.
+_ONESHOT_MAX_BYTES = 1024 * 1024
+
+
+class BeamAllReduceWorkspace:
+    """Multicast Lamport buffers and generation flags for the Beam kernels."""
+
+    @classmethod
+    def create(
+        cls,
+        group: dist.ProcessGroup,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        max_tokens: int,
+        dtype: torch.dtype,
+    ) -> "BeamAllReduceWorkspace | None":
+        # The CUDA epilogue handles one packed load per thread.
+        if (
+            group.size() not in (2, 4, 8)
+            or dtype != torch.bfloat16
+            or hidden_size % 1024
+            or not 1024 <= hidden_size <= 8192
+            or not hasattr(torch.ops._C, "beam_allreduce_norm")
+            or not has_flashinfer()
+        ):
+            return None
+        from flashinfer.comm.mnnvl import (
+            TorchDistBackend,
+            all_ranks_agree,
+            is_multicast_supported,
+        )
+
+        device = torch.accelerator.current_device_index()
+        supported = torch.cuda.get_device_capability(device)[0] in (9, 10)
+        supported = supported and is_multicast_supported(device)
+        if not all_ranks_agree(TorchDistBackend(group=group), supported):
+            return None
+        return cls(group, hidden_size, max_tokens)
+
+    def __init__(
+        self, group: dist.ProcessGroup, hidden_size: int, max_tokens: int
+    ) -> None:
+        self.world_size = group.size()
+        self.rank = dist.get_rank(group)
+        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
+        self.max_tokens = max_tokens
+        # Scale one-shot cutoffs by the BF16 payload staged across all ranks.
+        token_bytes = hidden_size * 2
+        rank_token_bytes = self.world_size * token_bytes
+        self.oneshot_max_tokens = _ONESHOT_MAX_BYTES // rank_token_bytes
+        self.small_batch_max_tokens = 3200 * 1024 // rank_token_bytes
+        self.separate_norm_min_tokens = cdiv(
+            10 * 1024**2 * self.world_size, token_bytes
+        )
+
+        # One-shot stages one row per rank; two-shot two rows per owned token.
+        oneshot_tokens = min(max_tokens, self.small_batch_max_tokens)
+        buffer_bytes = max(
+            oneshot_tokens * rank_token_bytes,
+            2 * cdiv(max_tokens, self.world_size) * rank_token_bytes,
+        )
+        # Both two-shot stages stay 16-byte aligned.
+        buffer_bytes = round_up(buffer_bytes, 32)
+        if buffer_bytes >= 2**32:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Beam all-reduce needs {buffer_bytes} bytes per Lamport "
+                "buffer, which exceeds the 32-bit flag field"
+            )
+        # FlashInfer only maps the multicast memory; the Lamport protocol and
+        # its flags are ours. Small batches reduce ~0.3us faster on its mapping
+        # than on torch symmetric memory.
+        from flashinfer.comm.mnnvl import McastGPUBuffer, TorchDistBackend
+
+        device = torch.device("cuda", torch.accelerator.current_device_index())
+        self.buffer = McastGPUBuffer(
+            _NUM_LAMPORT_BUFFERS * buffer_bytes,
+            self.world_size,
+            self.rank,
+            device,
+            TorchDistBackend(group=group),
+        )
+        self.multicast_ptr = self.buffer.get_multicast_ptr()
+        if not self.multicast_ptr:
+            raise RuntimeError("Beam all-reduce requires NVLink multicast")
+        self.local_ptr = self.buffer.get_unicast_ptr(self.rank)
+        self.buffer_ptrs = self.buffer.get_buffer_ptrs_dev()
+        self.buffer.lamport_initialize(self.rank, torch.float32)
+        # [current, dirty, bytes per buffer, dirty stages, bytes to clear x4,
+        # arrival count]
+        self.flags = torch.tensor(
+            [0, 2, buffer_bytes, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
+            dtype=torch.uint32,
+            device=device,
+        )
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+        dist.barrier(group=group)
+
+
+def beam_allreduce_norm_residual_norm(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    post_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    post_eps: float,
+    next_weight: torch.Tensor | None,
+    next_eps: float | None,
+    scales: tuple[float, float],
+    workspace: BeamAllReduceWorkspace,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:
+    assert x.shape == residual.shape
+    for weight in (post_weight, next_weight):
+        if weight is not None:
+            assert weight.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and weight.is_contiguous()
+            assert weight.shape == (workspace.hidden_size,)
+    assert x.dtype == residual.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+    assert x.is_contiguous() and residual.is_contiguous()
+    assert x.shape[1] == workspace.hidden_size
+    assert x.shape[0] <= workspace.max_tokens
+    if x.shape[0] >= workspace.separate_norm_min_tokens:
+        from .layernorm import beam_norm_residual_norm
+
+        reduced = torch.empty_like(x)
+        torch.ops._C.beam_allreduce(
+            x,
+            reduced,
+            workspace.buffer_ptrs,
+            workspace.flags,
+            workspace.multicast_ptr,
+            workspace.world_size,
+            workspace.rank,
+        )
+        return beam_norm_residual_norm(
+            reduced,
+            residual,
+            post_weight,
+            post_eps,
+            next_weight,
+            next_eps,
+            scales,
+            launch_pdl=True,
+        )
+    return _cuda_allreduce_norm_residual_norm(
+        x, residual, post_weight, post_eps, next_weight, next_eps, scales, workspace
+    )
+
+
+def _cuda_allreduce_norm_residual_norm(
+    x,
+    residual,
+    post_weight,
+    post_eps,
+    next_weight,
+    next_eps,
+    scales,
+    workspace,
+    unfinalized: UnfinalizedMoEOutput | None = None,
+    routed_scale: float = 1.0,
+):
+    assert x.dtype == residual.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+    assert x.is_contiguous() and residual.is_contiguous()
+    m, n = x.shape
+    assert n == workspace.hidden_size and m <= workspace.max_tokens
+    hidden = torch.empty_like(x)
+    normalized = torch.empty_like(x) if next_eps is not None else None
+    if m:
+        small_batch = unfinalized is None and m <= workspace.small_batch_max_tokens
+        torch.ops._C.beam_allreduce_norm(
+            x,
+            residual,
+            post_weight,
+            next_weight,
+            hidden,
+            normalized,
+            workspace.buffer_ptrs,
+            workspace.flags,
+            workspace.multicast_ptr,
+            workspace.local_ptr,
+            workspace.world_size,
+            workspace.rank,
+            post_eps or 0.0,
+            next_eps or 0.0,
+            *(scales if scales is not None else (1.0, 1.0)),
+            post_eps is not None,
+            next_eps is not None,
+            scales is not None,
+            small_batch or m <= workspace.oneshot_max_tokens,
+            small_batch,
+            unfinalized.gemm2_permuted if unfinalized is not None else None,
+            unfinalized.expert_weights if unfinalized is not None else None,
+            unfinalized.expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx
+            if unfinalized is not None
+            else None,
+            routed_scale,
+        )
+    return hidden, normalized
+
+
+def beam_finalize_allreduce_norm_residual_norm(
+    x: UnfinalizedMoEOutput,
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    post_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    post_eps: float,
+    next_weight: torch.Tensor | None,
+    next_eps: float | None,
+    scales: tuple[float, float],
+    workspace: BeamAllReduceWorkspace,
+    routed_scale: float,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:
+    """Finalize local experts before AR, retaining the local BF16 rounding."""
+    m, n = residual.shape
+    for weight in (post_weight, next_weight):
+        if weight is not None:
+            assert weight.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and weight.is_contiguous()
+            assert weight.shape == (n,)
+    assert x.gemm2_permuted.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+    assert x.gemm2_permuted.is_contiguous() and x.gemm2_permuted.shape[1] == n
+    assert x.expert_weights.dtype in (torch.float32, torch.bfloat16)
+    assert x.expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx.dtype == torch.int32
+    assert x.expert_weights.is_contiguous()
+    assert x.expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx.is_contiguous()
+    assert x.expert_weights.shape == x.expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx.shape
+    assert x.expert_weights.shape[0] == m
+    return _cuda_allreduce_norm_residual_norm(
+        residual,
+        residual,
+        post_weight,
+        post_eps,
+        next_weight,
+        next_eps,
+        scales,
+        workspace,
+        x,
+        routed_scale,
+    )

+"""Shared sizing helpers for SimpleCPUOffloadConnector."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import KVCacheConfig
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+
+def sync_num_offload_blocks_across_workers(num_offload_blocks: int) -> int:
+    """All-reduce MIN so every rank allocates the same offload pool size."""
+    if not dist.is_initialized():
+        return num_offload_blocks
+
+    from vllm.distributed.parallel_state import get_world_group
+
+    world_group = get_world_group()
+    if world_group.world_size <= 1:
+        return num_offload_blocks
+
+    blocks_tensor = torch.tensor([num_offload_blocks], dtype=torch.int64, device="cpu")
+    dist.all_reduce(blocks_tensor, group=world_group.cpu_group, op=dist.ReduceOp.MIN)
+    synced = int(blocks_tensor.item())
+    if synced != num_offload_blocks:
+        logger.info(
+            "SimpleCPUOffload: aligned num_offload_blocks from %d to %d "
+            "across %d workers",
+            num_offload_blocks,
+            synced,
+            world_group.world_size,
+        )
+    return synced
+
+
+def gpu_total_bytes(gpu_config: KVCacheConfig) -> int:
+    assert len(gpu_config.kv_cache_tensors) > 0
+    # Every KVCacheTensor describes placement within the same backing allocation,
+    # so its size is the total GPU KV cache size.
+    return gpu_config.kv_cache_tensors[0].size

+def _capture(fn):

+    CUDA graph; returns the graph and the captured outputs."""
+    fn()

+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()

+    """Distance in BF16 ulps between two BF16 tensors."""
+
+    def ordered(x):

+        return torch.where(bits < 0, -32768 - bits, bits)

+    return (ordered(a) - ordered(b)).abs()

+    result = trtllm_fp4_block_scale_routed_moe(
+        topk_ids=(routing.topk_ids, routing.topk_weights),
+        routing_bias=None,
+        hidden_states=routing.x_quant,
+        hidden_states_scale=routing.x_scale.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn),
+        gemm1_weights=w13,
+        gemm1_weights_scale=w13_scale,
+        gemm1_bias=None,
+        gemm1_alpha=None,
+        gemm1_beta=None,
+        gemm1_clamp_limit=clamp,
+        gemm2_weights=w2,
+        gemm2_weights_scale=w2_scale,
+        gemm2_bias=None,
+        output1_scale_scalar=None,
+        output1_scale_gate_scalar=None,
+        output2_scale_scalar=None,
+        num_experts=EXPERTS,
+        top_k=TOP_K,
+        n_group=None,
+        topk_group=None,
+        intermediate_size=PADDED,
+        local_expert_offset=0,
+        local_num_experts=EXPERTS,
+        routed_scaling_factor=None,
+        routing_method_type=RoutingMethodType.Renormalize,
+        do_finalize=output is not None,
+        enable_pdl=True,
+        activation_type=activation_to_flashinfer_int(MoEActivation.SILU),
+        output=output,
+        tune_max_num_tokens=8,
+    )
+    if output is not None:
+        return output
+    rows, _, permuted = result
+    return rows[permuted.view(routing.topk_ids.shape).long()]

+def _fma_finalize(rows: torch.Tensor, permuted: torch.Tensor, weights: torch.Tensor):
+    """The top-k reduction as the fused all-reduce + mHC kernel computes it: an
+    FP32 fused multiply-add chain over k (emulated in FP64), then BF16."""
+    rows, permuted, weights = (
+        rows.cpu().double(),
+        permuted.cpu(),
+        weights.cpu().double(),
+    )
+    out = torch.zeros(permuted.shape[0], HIDDEN, dtype=torch.float32)
+    for k in range(permuted.shape[1]):
+        out = (
+            out.double() + weights[:, k : k + 1] * rows[permuted[:, k].long()]
+        ).float()
+    return out.to(torch.bfloat16)
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("graph", [False, True], ids=["eager", "graph"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rows", [1, 5, 6, 8])
+def test_routed_experts_match_flashinfer(experts, rows, graph):
+    """Route + GEMM pair: the routed rows bitwise those of FlashInfer's
+    TRT-LLM-gen MoE, and their top-k reduction within one BF16 ulp of its
+    finalized output."""
+    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(rows)
+    gemm = _gemm(experts)
+
+    def inputs():
+        x = torch.randn(rows, HIDDEN, generator=generator).to(torch.bfloat16)
+        weights = torch.softmax(torch.randn(rows, TOP_K, generator=generator), -1)
+        return x.to(DEVICE), _routing(rows, generator), weights.to(DEVICE)
+
+    x, ids, weights = inputs()
+
+    def run():
+        routing = gemm.route(x, ids, weights)
+        return routing, gemm.gemms(routing)
+
+    if graph:
+        cuda_graph, (routing, out) = _capture(run)
+        for tensor, fresh in zip((x, ids, weights), inputs()):
+            tensor.copy_(fresh)
+        cuda_graph.replay()
+    else:
+        routing, out = run()
+    routed = out.gemm2_permuted[out.expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx.long()]
+    assert torch.equal(routed, _flashinfer_experts(experts, routing))
+
+    finalized = torch.empty(rows, HIDDEN, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=DEVICE)
+    _flashinfer_experts(experts, routing, finalized)
+    ours = _fma_finalize(
+        out.gemm2_permuted, out.expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx, out.expert_weights
+    )
+    assert _bf16_ulps(ours, finalized.cpu()).max() <= 1

+SENTINEL = 128815  # First of five image sentinel token ids.
+
+
+def _front_inputs(rows: int, generator: torch.Generator, image_rows: int):
+    """Router logits with exact ties, NaN, and values past the softplus
+    thresholds; BF16 rows with a zero, a tiny and a large MXFP8 block."""
+    logits = 3 * torch.randn(rows, EXPERTS, generator=generator)
+    logits[:, 10:20] = logits[:, 10:11]
+    logits[0, 30], logits[0, 31] = 25.0, -100.0
+    if rows > 1:
+        logits[1, 40] = float("nan")
+    x = torch.randn(rows, HIDDEN, generator=generator)
+    x[0, :32] = 0
+    x[0, 32:64] *= 1e-30
+    x[-1, 64:96] *= 1e4
+    ids = torch.randint(0, 100000, (rows,), generator=generator)
+    ids[:image_rows] = SENTINEL + torch.arange(image_rows) % 5
+    ids[image_rows : image_rows + 1] = SENTINEL + 5
+    return logits.to(DEVICE), x.to(torch.bfloat16).to(DEVICE), ids.to(DEVICE)
+
+
+def _chain(gemm: RoutedExpertGemm, x, logits, ids):
+    """What the front replaces: the DSv4 top-k, then quantization and route."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.router.dsv4_topk import dsv4_topk
+
+    config = gemm.front_config
+    weights, topk_ids = dsv4_topk(
+        logits,
+        config.bias,
+        torch.int32,
+        config.scale,
+        input_ids=ids,
+        bias_vl=config.bias_vl,
+        image_sentinel_lo=config.image_sentinel_lo,
+    )
+    return gemm.route(x, topk_ids, weights)
+
+
+def _assert_same_routing(got, want):
+    for field in (
+        "topk_ids",
+        "topk_weights",
+        "x_quant",
+        "x_scale",
+        "permuted",
+        "record",
+    ):
+        a, b = getattr(got, field), getattr(want, field)
+        assert a.shape == b.shape, field
+        assert torch.equal(
+            a.contiguous().view(torch.uint8), b.contiguous().view(torch.uint8)
+        ), field
+    assert got.ctas == want.ctas
+

+    block, nblocks = 8, 131072

+    def select(selector):

+        out = torch.full((rows, k), 7, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)
+        selector(out)
+        return out
+
+    def stock():
+        return select(
+            lambda out: select_candidate_blocks(logits, None, row_ends, k, block, out)
+        )
+
+    def cooperative():
+        return select(

+        )

+    def assert_same_sets(got, want):
+        assert torch.equal(got.sort(dim=1).values, want.sort(dim=1).values)

+    fill_logits(0)
+    assert_same_sets(cooperative(), stock())
+    graph, out = _capture(cooperative)

+    graph.replay()
+    assert_same_sets(out, stock())

+class _Mxfp8Linear(nn.Module):
+    """An MXFP8 linear with weights processed for the ``cute-dsl`` kernel."""
+
+    def __init__(self, n: int, k: int):
+        super().__init__()
+        w = torch.randn(n, k, device=DEVICE) / k**0.5
+        w_q, w_s = mxfp8_e4m3_quantize(
+            w.to(torch.bfloat16), is_sf_swizzled_layout=False
+        )
+        self.weight = nn.Parameter(w_q, requires_grad=False)
+        self.weight_scale = nn.Parameter(w_s.view(n, k // 32), requires_grad=False)
+        kernel = FlashInferCutedslMxfp8LinearKernel(Mxfp8LinearLayerConfig((n, k)))
+        kernel.process_weights_after_loading(self)
+        self.quant_method = SimpleNamespace(kernel=kernel)
+
+    def forward(self, x):
+        return self.quant_method.kernel.apply_weights(self, x)
+
+
+def _quantized(rows: int, k: int) -> QuantizedActivation:
+    """An input pre-quantized as the fused producers emit it (F8_128x4 scales)."""
+    x = torch.randn(rows, k, device=DEVICE).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    data, scale = mxfp8_e4m3_quantize(x, is_sf_swizzled_layout=True)
+    return QuantizedActivation(
+        data, scale.reshape(-1), torch.bfloat16, x.shape, kMxfp8Dynamic
+    )
+

+    if not mxfp8_linear._backend_supported():

+    def refresh(self):

+            layer.swa_cache_layer.kv_cache,

+    def forward(self, layers, tables, mode, stop=None, join_at_end=True):
+        """The layers' table lookups in model order, on ``tables`` (None: the
+        stock build of each layer): each index source joins the side builds,
+        then its indexer writes the top-k indices; the executor joins after
+        its layers. Returns copies of each layer's table."""
+        out = []
+        context = ForwardContext({}, self.by_layer, {}, cudagraph_runtime_mode=mode)
+        with override_forward_context(context):
+            if tables is not None:
+                tables.reset()
+            for layer_id, layer in enumerate(layers[:stop]):
+                if layer_id in INDEX_SOURCES:
+                    if tables is not None:
+                        tables.join()
+                    self.topk.copy_(self.sources[layer_id])
+                args = self.lookup_args(layer)
+                if tables is None:
+                    *_, indices, lens = layer._build_sparse_index_metadata(*args)
+                else:
+                    *_, indices, lens = tables.lookup(layer, *args)
+                out.append((indices.clone(), lens.clone()))
+            if tables is not None and join_at_end:
+                tables.join()
+        return out
+
+    def serial_tables(self):
+        """Every layer's table from builds on the main stream only."""
+        self.clear_tables()
+        tables = self.forward(self.layers(), None, CUDAGraphMode.NONE)
+        self.clear_tables()
+        return tables

+"""The DeepSeek-V4.1 specialized decode through the real model: a five-layer
+DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on random weights at TP4 with DSpark, served with
+``decode_backend`` ``latency_specialized`` and ``auto``. Unlike
+``test_kernels.py`` and ``test_numerics.py`` next to it, which
+check each path against the op it replaces, this runs the engine: the
+executor and its per-step gates, the CUDA graphs, the recorded metadata builds
+and the weights the executor takes off the layers.
+
+The layers hold each variant: 0 sliding window only, 1 ratio-2 KV and index
+source, 2 a ratio-2 consumer with an Engram, 3 ratio-1 KV, index and
+candidate source, 4 a ratio-1 index source over 3's candidates. Twelve
+requests decode together once the last prefill is done, finish one by one
+and leave the last on its own: FULL decode graphs of 12 down to 1 requests
+(6 rows each), above 48 rows (inline mHC), padded, row-sharded (12
+requests) and low-batch (one request).
+
+Every decoder layer's residual streams and FFN input and the model's output
+are kept for every decode token and every 16th prefill position, and the two
+runs compared within the tolerances below. Neither run is bitwise
+reproducible, not even on the stock paths: the engine batches requests as
+they arrive, and two stock runs already differ. Prefill
+positions are compared before the decoder's bounded replay only, which runs
+the later layers of a prefill step on each request's last tokens.
+
+Needs four GB300 (SM103) GPUs; about 10 minutes, mostly two engine starts.
+"""

+    too: the target takes its aux hidden-state layers from the draft's
+    ``dspark_target_layer_ids``. Module level, so engine processes unpickle it."""

+@torch.no_grad()
+def _fill(name: str, t: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+    """A random value for every weight, seeded by its name (alike on every
+    rank and in every run), in the ranges the checkpoint's formats hold."""
+    if t.device.type == "meta":
+        return
+    g = torch.Generator(device=t.device).manual_seed(zlib.crc32(name.encode()))
+
+    def randn(scale=1.0, shift=0.0):
+        return torch.randn(t.shape, generator=g, device=t.device) * scale + shift
+
+    if t.dtype == torch.uint8 and "scale" in name:
+        # E8M0 2^-12 .. 2^-8, alike over each 32 rows as in the checkpoint.
+        rows = t.shape[-2] if t.dim() > 1 else 1
+        shape = (*t.shape[:-2], -(-rows // 32), t.shape[-1]) if t.dim() > 1 else t.shape
+        e8m0 = torch.randint(115, 120, shape, generator=g, device=t.device)
+        if t.dim() > 1:
+            e8m0 = e8m0.repeat_interleave(32, dim=-2)[..., :rows, :]
+        t.copy_(e8m0)
+    elif t.dtype in (torch.uint8, torch.float4_e2m1fn_x2):
+        u8 = t.view(torch.uint8)
+        u8.copy_(torch.randint(0, 256, u8.shape, generator=g, device=t.device))
+    elif t.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn:
+        t.copy_(randn().clamp(-6, 6))
+    elif not torch.is_floating_point(t):
+        return
+    elif "norm" in name:
+        t.copy_(randn(0.1, 1.0))
+    elif name.endswith(("hc_attn_scale", "hc_ffn_scale")):
+        t.copy_(randn(0.5).abs() + 0.5)
+    elif name.endswith(("hc_attn_base", "hc_ffn_base", "attn_sink")):
+        t.copy_(randn(0.1))
+    elif name.endswith("embed_tokens.weight"):
+        t.copy_(randn())
+    else:
+        t.copy_(randn(0.02))

+
+    The stock layers fill them from hooks. The executor runs the layers'
+    modules but not their forwards, so its boundary into each layer's FFN
+    fills them."""
+
+    def __init__(self, core: torch.nn.Module):
+        from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.model import DeepseekV4DecoderLayer
+        from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.specialized_decode.boundary.boundary import (  # noqa: E501
+            Boundaries,
+        )
+
+        layers = [m for m in core.layers if isinstance(m, DeepseekV4DecoderLayer)]
+        hc, hidden = layers[0].hc_mult, layers[0].hidden_size
+        rows, device = MAX_BATCHED_TOKENS, layers[0].attn_norm.weight.device
+
+        def zeros(*shape, dtype=torch.bfloat16):
+            return torch.zeros(rows, *shape, dtype=dtype, device=device)
+
+        self.residual = [zeros(hc, hidden) for _ in layers]
+        self.ffn_input = [zeros(hidden) for _ in layers]
+        self.gap = [zeros(dtype=torch.float32) for _ in layers]
+        self.output = zeros(hidden)
+        self.gates = [layer.ffn.gate for layer in layers]
+        for i, layer in enumerate(layers):
+            layer.register_forward_hook(self._keep_residual(i))
+            self._hook_ffn(i, layer.ffn)
+        core.register_forward_hook(self._keep_output)
+
+        index = {layer: i for i, layer in enumerate(layers)}
+        sublayer = Boundaries.sublayer
+        # Executor boundaries traced (the executor runs only in captures):
+        # proves that the CUDA graphs hold the executor, not the stock layers.
+        self.executor_sublayers = 0
+
+        def sublayer_and_keep(boundaries, layer, ffn, state, step, **kwargs):
+            self.executor_sublayers += 1
+            out = sublayer(boundaries, layer, ffn, state, step, **kwargs)
+            i = index.get(layer)
+            if ffn and i is not None:
+                residual = out[0].residual
+                self.residual[i][: residual.shape[0]].copy_(residual)
+                self._keep_ffn_input(i, out[1])
+            return out
+
+        Boundaries.sublayer = sublayer_and_keep
+
+    def _keep_residual(self, i):
+        def hook(module, args, out):
+            self.residual[i][: out[1].shape[0]].copy_(out[1])
+
+        return hook
+
+    def _keep_ffn_input(self, i: int, x: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+        gate = self.gates[i]
+        n = x.shape[0]
+        self.ffn_input[i][:n].copy_(x)
+        score = torch.nn.functional.softplus(x.float() @ gate.weight.float().T)
+        score = score.sqrt() + gate.e_score_correction_bias.float()
+        top = score.topk(TOP_K + 1, dim=-1).values
+        self.gap[i][:n].copy_(top[:, TOP_K - 1] - top[:, TOP_K])
+
+    def _hook_ffn(self, i, ffn):
+        ffn.register_forward_pre_hook(
+            lambda module, args: self._keep_ffn_input(i, args[0])
+        )
+        # The stock deferred-finalize MoE is called as forward_unfinalized.
+        unfinalized = ffn.forward_unfinalized
+
+        def forward_unfinalized(x, input_ids):
+            self._keep_ffn_input(i, x)
+            return unfinalized(x, input_ids)
+
+        ffn.forward_unfinalized = forward_unfinalized
+
+    def _keep_output(self, module, args, out):
+        out = out[0] if isinstance(out, tuple) else out
+        self.output[: out.shape[0]].copy_(out)
+
+    def values(self, rows: torch.Tensor) -> dict:
+        """The kept tensors of ``rows``, the residual streams' hc mean."""
+        return {
+            "residual": [
+                t[rows].float().mean(1).bfloat16().cpu() for t in self.residual
+            ],
+            "ffn_input": [t[rows].cpu() for t in self.ffn_input],
+            "gap": [t[rows].cpu() for t in self.gap],
+            "output": self.output[rows].cpu(),
+        }
+
+
+@register_model_loader(LOAD_FORMAT)
+class RandomWeightLoader(DummyModelLoader):
+    """Dummy loading with weights in the checkpoint's ranges, before post-load
+    processing, so every processed copy follows. Also puts a ``_Probe`` on
+    the target model before its CUDA graphs are captured."""
+
+    def load_weights(self, model, model_config) -> None:
+        from vllm.distributed import get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size
+        from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.model import DeepseekV4Model
+
+        super().load_weights(model, model_config)
+        for name, t in model.state_dict().items():
+            _fill(name, t)
+        # The routed experts' intermediate past this rank's share is the
+        # loader's zero padding (576 -> 640 at TP4).
+        inter = model_config.hf_text_config.moe_intermediate_size
+        inter //= get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
+        for m in model.modules():
+            w13, w2 = getattr(m, "w13_weight", None), getattr(m, "w2_weight", None)
+            if w13 is None or w2 is None or w13.device.type == "meta":
+                continue
+            padded = w13.shape[1] // 2
+            if padded > inter:
+                w13, w2 = w13.data.view(torch.uint8), w2.data.view(torch.uint8)
+                for half in (0, padded):
+                    w13[:, half + inter : half + padded] = 0
+                w2[..., inter // 2 :] = 0

+        cores = [m for m in model.modules() if type(m) is DeepseekV4Model]
+        if cores:
+            model._layer_probe = _Probe(cores[0])

+
+class StepRecorder:
+    """Worker extension (``worker_extension_cls``): it also brings this module,
+    and so the loader, into the workers. Rank 0 keeps every step's rows."""
+
+    model_runner: "GPUModelRunner"
+    rank: int
+
+    def _target(self) -> torch.nn.Module:
+        return next(m for m in _LOADED if hasattr(m, "_layer_probe"))
+
+    def paths(self) -> dict:
+        """Which implementation each path took on this rank."""
+        from vllm.model_executor.layers.logits_processor import LogitsProcessor
+        from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.model import (
+            DeepseekV4DecoderLayer,
+            DeepseekV4Model,
+        )
+        from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.ops import mhc
+
+        def layers(model):
+            return [m for m in model.modules() if isinstance(m, DeepseekV4DecoderLayer)]
+
+        target = self._target()
+        (draft,) = [m for m in _LOADED if m is not target]
+        assert not any(type(m) is DeepseekV4Model for m in draft.modules())
+        logits = [m for m in target.modules() if isinstance(m, LogitsProcessor)]
+        (core,) = [m for m in target.modules() if type(m) is DeepseekV4Model]
+        language_model = (
+            target.get_language_model()
+            if hasattr(target, "get_language_model")
+            else target
+        )
+        decode = language_model.specialized_decode
+        model_state = self.model_runner.model_state
+        graphs = getattr(model_state, "graphs", None)
+        return {
+            # Prefill steps run the layers from here on a subset of the rows.
+            "decoder_replay_start": core.decoder_replay_start,
+            "decode": type(decode).__name__,
+            "executor_sublayers": target._layer_probe.executor_sublayers,
+            "draft_decode": getattr(draft, "specialized_decode", None) is not None,
+            "model_state": type(model_state).__name__,
+            "attention": [type(m.attn).__name__ for m in layers(target)],
+            "ffn": [type(m.ffn).__name__ for m in layers(target)],
+            "routed_experts": [
+                plan.moe.gemm is not None for plan in getattr(decode, "plans", ())
+            ],
+            "logits": [type(m).__name__ for m in logits],
+            "metadata_graphs": 0 if graphs is None else len(graphs._graphs),
+            "fused_mhc_max_rows": (
+                None if decode is None else decode.all_reduce.capacity
+            ),
+            "stock_fused_mhc_max_rows": getattr(mhc._all_reduce_mhc, "capacity", None),
+            "draft_attention": [type(m.attn).__name__ for m in layers(draft)],

+    def record_steps(self, prompt_lens: list[int]) -> None:
+        """From now on, keep each step's rows on rank 0."""
+        runner = self.model_runner
+        if self.rank != 0:
+            return
+        self._prompt_lens = prompt_lens
+        self._steps: list[dict] = []
+        self._full = False
+        run_fullgraph = runner.cudagraph_manager.run_fullgraph
+
+        def run_and_flag(desc):
+            self._full = True
+            return run_fullgraph(desc)
+
+        runner.cudagraph_manager.run_fullgraph = run_and_flag
+        execute_model = runner.execute_model
+
+        def execute_and_record(*args, **kwargs):
+            self._full = False
+            output = execute_model(*args, **kwargs)
+            state = runner.execute_model_state
+            if not kwargs.get("dummy_run") and state is not None:
+                self._record(state.input_batch)
+            return output
+
+        runner.execute_model = execute_and_record
+
+    def _record(self, batch) -> None:
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+        probe = self._target()._layer_probe
+        n, padded = batch.num_tokens, batch.num_tokens_after_padding
+        positions = batch.positions[:n].tolist()
+        input_ids = batch.input_ids[:n].tolist()
+        step = {
+            "rows": n,
+            "padded_rows": padded,
+            "requests": batch.num_reqs,
+            "full": self._full,
+            "has_prefill": batch.has_prefill,
+        }
+        kept = []
+        for i in range(batch.num_reqs):
+            prompt = self._prompt_lens.index(int(batch.prefill_len_np[i]))
+            decode = not batch.is_prefilling_np[i]
+            start, end = batch.query_start_loc_np[i : i + 2]
+            for row in range(start, end):
+                key = (prompt, positions[row])
+                if decode:
+                    key += (tuple(input_ids[start : row + 1]),)
+                elif positions[row] % PREFILL_SAMPLE:
+                    continue
+                kept.append((row, key))
+        if kept:
+            rows = torch.tensor([r for r, _ in kept], device=probe.output.device)
+            values = probe.values(rows)
+            step["tokens"] = {
+                key: {
+                    "residual": [t[j] for t in values["residual"]],
+                    "ffn_input": [t[j] for t in values["ffn_input"]],
+                    "gap": [float(t[j]) for t in values["gap"]],
+                    "output": values["output"][j],
+                }
+                for j, (_, key) in enumerate(kept)
+            }
+        self._steps.append(step)
+
+    def save_steps(self, path: str) -> None:
+        if self.rank == 0:
+            torch.save(self._steps, path)

+def _serve(vllm_runner, specialized_decode: bool, prompts, max_tokens, path: str):

+    paths each rank took; the steps' rows saved under ``path``."""
+    from vllm import SamplingParams
+    from vllm.inputs import TokensPrompt
+
+    with vllm_runner(
+        MODEL,
+        tensor_parallel_size=4,
+        load_format=LOAD_FORMAT,
+        hf_overrides=_truncate,
+        worker_extension_cls=f"{__name__}.StepRecorder",
+        additional_config={

+        },

+            "num_speculative_tokens": DRAFTS,
+            "enable_adaptive_verification": False,

+        attention_config={
+            "backend": "FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_DSV41",
+            "indexer_kv_dtype": "mxfp4",

+        # stock paths; FlashInfer's defaults are the same in both.
+        enable_flashinfer_autotune=False,
+        # Decode graphs of 1, 2, 4, 8 and 16 requests of 6 rows.

+def _rel(a: torch.Tensor, b: torch.Tensor) -> float:
+    a, b = a.float(), b.float()
+    return ((a - b).norm() / b.norm()).item()
+
+
+def _assert_quantiles(errs: list[float], what, median: float, p99: float) -> None:
+    assert errs, what
+    q = torch.quantile(torch.tensor(errs), torch.tensor([0.5, 0.99])).tolist()
+    # Any single token within 15%, five times what two stock runs differ by.
+    assert q[0] < median and q[1] < p99 and max(errs) < 0.15, (what, q, max(errs))

+def _check_close(got: dict, want: dict, keys: list, layers, output: bool) -> None:
+    """The kept tensors of ``keys`` on both runs, close in distribution.
+
+    Random weights amplify any difference layer by layer, and the stock paths
+    do not reproduce either: single decode tokens of two stock runs
+    differ by up to about 3%, with a median below 0.5% at every layer. Per
+    layer, the residual streams' median within 1% and 99th percentile within
+    5%. A token whose FFN input is off by 3% at layer 0 or
+    8% past it must have a near-tie top-6 routing on the stock path: it may
+    pick another expert (the low-batch experts route in the same FP32 order,
+    but their input carries the earlier differences), and its later layers
+    are exempt. A path the specialized-decode run no longer follows is off by far
+    more, on every token.
+    """
+    flipped: set = set()
+    for i in layers:
+        residual = []
+        for key in keys:
+            if key in flipped:
+                continue
+            a, b = got[key], want[key]
+            residual.append(_rel(a["residual"][i], b["residual"][i]))
+            err = _rel(a["ffn_input"][i], b["ffn_input"][i])
+            if err >= (0.03 if i == 0 else 0.08):
+                assert b["gap"][i] < (5e-3 if i == 0 else 1e-2), (i, key, "x", err)
+                flipped.add(key)
+        _assert_quantiles(residual, (i, "residual"), median=0.01, p99=0.05)
+    if output:
+        errs = [
+            _rel(got[k]["output"], want[k]["output"]) for k in keys if k not in flipped
+        ]
+        _assert_quantiles(errs, "output", median=0.02, p99=0.08)

+"""Cross-rank numerics of the DeepSeek-V4.1 specialized decode at TP4.
+
+Each check runs one rank late, so a missing wait reads a peer's stale data:
+
+* the fused all-reduce + mHC at 1, 6, 48 and 384 rows (its whole capacity),
+  plain, with the MXFP8 layer input, with a deferred MoE finalize and
+  residual-only, bitwise against the separate all-reduce and mHC kernels;
+* the executor's sublayer boundary on it, with the next mHC coefficients on
+  the side stream and inline, against the separate kernels and the stock mHC
+  pre;
+* the ``wo_b`` GEMM that publishes into the fused kernel's mailbox, per
+  split-K tactic, bitwise against FlashInfer's GEMM plus the separate publish;
+* logits gathered with the custom all-gather, bitwise against NCCL;
+* the row-sharded decode indexer against the replicated one (equal top-k
+  sets up to exactly tied scores);
+* one CUDA graph of all of these, replayed ``REPLAYS`` times bitwise.
+
+Needs four SM100-family GPUs with NVLink multicast and flashinfer-python
+0.7.2; about 5 minutes. For a race stress run, run this file as a module
+(``python -m tests.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.specialized_decode.test_numerics``)
+with ``--replays 100000``.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import importlib.metadata
+import os
+import tempfile
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+TP = 4
+HIDDEN, HC, TOP_K = 5120, 4, 6
+CAPACITY = 384
+REPLAYS = 300
+LATE_CYCLES = 20_000
+
+
+def _late(rank: int, step: int) -> None:
+    """Delay one rank per step, a different one each step."""
+    if rank == step % TP:
+        torch.cuda._sleep(LATE_CYCLES)
+
+
+def _randn(generator, *shape, dtype=torch.bfloat16):
+    return torch.randn(*shape, generator=generator, device="cuda").to(dtype)
+
+
+def _mix(rows: int):
+    """The replicated mHC inputs of one boundary, equal on every rank."""
+    generator = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(rows)
+    return dict(
+        residual=_randn(generator, rows, HC, HIDDEN),
+        post=torch.rand(rows, HC, generator=generator, device="cuda"),
+        comb=_randn(generator, rows, HC, HC, dtype=torch.float32) * 0.1,
+        pre=torch.rand(rows, HC, generator=generator, device="cuda"),
+        norm_weight=_randn(generator, HIDDEN),
+        norm_eps=1e-6,
+    )
+
+
+def _partial(rows: int, rank: int, seed: int = 0) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """This rank's partial sum, with +0/-0 pairs that look like the Lamport
+    sentinel."""
+    x = _randn(
+        torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed + 97 * rank), rows, HIDDEN
+    )
+    x[:, :16] = 0
+    x[:, 9:16:2] = -0.0
+    return x
+
+
+def _moe_partial(rows: int, rank: int):
+    """An unfinalized MoE output (padded permuted GEMM2 rows, routing with a
+    route to an expert this rank does not hold) and its shared output."""
+    generator = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(7 + rank)
+    num_rows = rows * TOP_K + 5
+    gemm2 = _randn(generator, num_rows, HIDDEN)
+    permuted = torch.randperm(num_rows, generator=generator, device="cuda")
+    permuted = permuted[: rows * TOP_K].view(rows, TOP_K).int()
+    permuted[0, -1] = -1
+    weights = torch.rand(rows, TOP_K, generator=generator, device="cuda")
+    return gemm2, weights, permuted, _randn(generator, rows, HIDDEN)
+
+
+def _fma_finalize(gemm2, weights, permuted, shared) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """One FP32 FMA per route in route order, the shared add, one rounding."""
+    acc = torch.zeros(shared.shape, device="cuda")
+    for k in range(TOP_K):
+        valid = (permuted[:, k] >= 0).unsqueeze(-1)
+        rows = gemm2[permuted[:, k].clamp_min(0).long()].float()
+        torch.addcmul(
+            acc,
+            torch.where(valid, rows, 0.0),
+            torch.where(valid, weights[:, k : k + 1], 0.0),
+            out=acc,
+        )
+    return (acc + shared.float()).bfloat16()
+
+
+def _assert_equal(got, want, what):
+    for a, b in zip(got, want):
+        if a is None or b is None:
+            assert a is None and b is None, what
+        else:
+            assert torch.equal(a.view(torch.uint8), b.view(torch.uint8)), what

+def _check_all_reduce_mhc(arm, rank):
+    from tests.distributed.test_custom_all_reduce import (
+        _bf16_ulps,
+        _unfused_all_reduce_mhc,
+    )

+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.mxfp8_utils import (
+        mxfp8_e4m3_quantize,

+        Boundaries,
+        BoundaryState,
+        empty_quantized_layer_input,
+    )
+
+    step = 0
+    for rows in (1, 6, 48, 384):
+        mix = _mix(rows)
+        x = _partial(rows, rank)
+        _late(rank, step := step + 1)
+        streams, layer_input = arm(x, **mix)
+        peers = get_tp_group().all_gather(x, dim=0).view(TP, rows, HIDDEN)
+        reference = _unfused_all_reduce_mhc(peers, *mix.values())
+        # The RMSNorm sums squares in another order, with an approximate rsqrt.
+        assert torch.equal(streams, reference[0]), rows
+        assert _bf16_ulps(layer_input, reference[1]) <= 1, rows

+        # The layer input also as MXFP8, as fused_wqa_wkv would quantize it.
+        quantized = empty_quantized_layer_input(rows, HIDDEN, x.device)
+        _late(rank, step := step + 1)

+        data, scale = mxfp8_e4m3_quantize(layer_input, is_sf_swizzled_layout=True)
+        _assert_equal(
+            (quantized.data, quantized.scale),
+            (data, scale.reshape(-1)),
+            f"MXFP8 layer input, {rows} rows",

+
+        _late(rank, step := step + 1)

+        # A deferred MoE finalize reduces as the plain call on the finalized

+        gemm2, weights, permuted, shared = _moe_partial(rows, rank)
+        finalized = _fma_finalize(gemm2, weights, permuted, shared)
+        _late(rank, step := step + 1)
+        want = arm(finalized, **mix)
+        _late(rank, step := step + 1)
+        got = arm.finalize(gemm2, weights, permuted, shared, *mix.values())
+        _assert_equal(got, want, f"finalize, {rows} rows")
+        moe_output = MoEOutput(

+                gemm2_permuted=gemm2,
+                expert_weights=weights,
+                expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx=permuted,
+            ),
+            shared_output=shared,
+        )
+        state = BoundaryState(
+            mix["residual"], mix["post"], mix["comb"], mix["pre"], moe_output
+        )
+        _late(rank, step := step + 1)
+        got = Boundaries(arm).post_only(state)

+def _check_boundaries(arm, rank):
+    """``Boundaries.sublayer`` on a partial sum and on a deferred MoE output,
+    with the next coefficients on the side stream and inline: the streams
+    bitwise against the separate all-reduce and mHC post, the mixes bitwise
+    against the stock mHC pre on those streams, and the layer input within
+    the fused RMSNorm's ulp of it."""
+    from tests.distributed.test_custom_all_reduce import (
+        _bf16_ulps,
+        _unfused_all_reduce_mhc,
+    )
+    from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.moe_output import (
+        MoEOutput,
+        UnfinalizedMoEOutput,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.ops.mhc import mhc_pre_delayed_overlap
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.specialized_decode.boundary.boundary import (
+        Boundaries,
+        BoundaryState,
+    )
+
+    generator = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(3)  # equal on all ranks
+    mix_size = HC * (HC + 2)
+    fn = torch.randn(mix_size, HC * HIDDEN, generator=generator, device="cuda") * 0.02
+    scale = torch.tensor([0.5, 0.25, 1.0], device="cuda")
+    base = torch.randn(mix_size, generator=generator, device="cuda")
+    side = torch.cuda.Stream()
+    boundaries = Boundaries(arm)
+    step = 0
+    for rows in (1, 6, 48, 384):
+        mix = _mix(rows)
+        layer = SimpleNamespace(
+            hc_attn_fn=fn,
+            hc_attn_scale=scale,
+            hc_attn_base=base,
+            attn_norm=SimpleNamespace(weight=mix["norm_weight"], variance_epsilon=1e-6),
+            rms_norm_eps=1e-6,
+            hc_eps=1e-6,
+            hc_post_alpha=2.0,
+            hc_sinkhorn_iters=20,
+            mhc_stream=side,
+        )
+        gemm2, weights, permuted, shared = _moe_partial(rows, rank)
+        deferred = MoEOutput(
+            UnfinalizedMoEOutput(
+                gemm2_permuted=gemm2,
+                expert_weights=weights,
+                expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx=permuted,
+            ),
+            shared_output=shared,
+        )
+        # (what the sublayer left, the partial sum it amounts to)
+        cases = (
+            ("partial", _partial(rows, rank), _partial(rows, rank)),
+            ("deferred", deferred, _fma_finalize(gemm2, weights, permuted, shared)),
+        )
+        for name, pending, finalized in cases:
+            peers = get_tp_group().all_gather(finalized, dim=0)
+            streams, _ = _unfused_all_reduce_mhc(
+                peers.view(TP, rows, HIDDEN), *mix.values()

+                fn,
+                scale,
+                base,

+                1e-6,
+                1e-6,
+                2.0,
+                20,
+                pre_mix=mix["pre"],
+                norm_weight=mix["norm_weight"],
+                norm_eps=1e-6,
+                stream=side,
+            )
+            torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(side)
+            for side_stream in (True, False):
+                what = f"{name}, {rows} rows, side stream {side_stream}"
+                state = BoundaryState(
+                    mix["residual"], mix["post"], mix["comb"], mix["pre"], pending

+                decode_step = SimpleNamespace(side_stream=side_stream)
+                _late(rank, step := step + 1)
+                state, layer_input, _, aux = boundaries.sublayer(

+                boundaries.join(layer, decode_step)

+WO_B_K = 2048  # o_lora_rank x local groups at TP4

+def _wo_b(rank: int, index: int):
+    """A ``wo_b`` linear with its weights processed for the low-latency
+    MXFP8 kernel, different on each rank."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.mxfp8.flashinfer import (
+        FlashInferCutedslMxfp8LinearKernel,
+    )
+    from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.mxfp8.Mxfp8LinearKernel import (
+        Mxfp8LinearLayerConfig,
+    )
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.mxfp8_utils import (
+        mxfp8_e4m3_quantize,
+    )
+
+    generator = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(1000 * rank + index)
+    w = _randn(generator, HIDDEN, WO_B_K, dtype=torch.float32) / WO_B_K**0.5
+    w_q, w_s = mxfp8_e4m3_quantize(w.bfloat16(), is_sf_swizzled_layout=False)
+    linear = torch.nn.Module()
+    linear.weight = torch.nn.Parameter(w_q, requires_grad=False)
+    linear.weight_scale = torch.nn.Parameter(
+        w_s.view(HIDDEN, WO_B_K // 32), requires_grad=False
+    )
+    kernel = FlashInferCutedslMxfp8LinearKernel(
+        Mxfp8LinearLayerConfig((HIDDEN, WO_B_K))
+    )
+    kernel.process_weights_after_loading(linear)
+    linear.quant_method = SimpleNamespace(kernel=kernel)
+    return linear
+
+
+def _attention_output(rows: int, rank: int):
+    """``wo_b``'s MXFP8 input as the fused WO-A kernel emits it, with a zero
+    row (zero outputs, whose negative zeros the publish clears)."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fusion.quant_activation import (
+        QuantizedActivation,
+    )
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.mxfp8_utils import (
+        mxfp8_e4m3_quantize,
+    )
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.quant_utils import (
+        kMxfp8Dynamic,
+    )
+
+    x = _randn(torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(rank), rows, WO_B_K)
+    x[-1] = 0
+    data, scale = mxfp8_e4m3_quantize(x, is_sf_swizzled_layout=True)
+    return QuantizedActivation(
+        data, scale.reshape(-1), torch.bfloat16, x.shape, kMxfp8Dynamic
+    )

+def _flashinfer_wo_b(linear, qa, tactic):
+    """FlashInfer's low-latency MXFP8 GEMM with ``tactic`` (None: the
+    default), and the valid tactics."""
+    from flashinfer.gemm import gemm_base
+
+    out = torch.empty(qa.data.shape[0], HIDDEN, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+    major, minor = torch.cuda.get_device_capability()
+    runner = gemm_base._cutedsl_low_latency_blockscaled_gemm_runner(
+        major * 10 + minor, True
+    )
+    workspace = gemm_base._get_cache_buf(
+        "mm_mxfp8_workspace", gemm_base.DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_SIZE, out.device
+    )
+    inputs = [
+        qa.data,
+        linear.weight,
+        qa.scale,
+        linear.weight_scale,
+        torch.bfloat16,
+        out,
+        workspace,
+    ]
+    runner.forward(inputs, tactic=tactic)
+    return out, [tuple(t) for t in runner.get_valid_tactics(inputs, None)]

+# ---------------------------------------------------- row-sharded indexer
+
+CONTEXTS = (84_000, 163_000, 300_000, 360_000, 406_000, 490_000, 556_000, 648_000)
+NEXT_N = 6  # rows per request: DSpark verification of five drafts
+INDEX_HEADS, INDEX_HEAD_DIM, INDEX_TOPK = 32, 128, 512
+CANDIDATE_BLOCKS, CANDIDATE_BLOCK_SIZE = 2048, 8
+MAX_MODEL_LEN = 655_360
+PAGE_TOKENS = 128
+ROPE_POSITIONS = 2048
+# (requests, of which trailing padding requests).
+INDEX_BATCHES = ((8, 0), (32, 10))
+# A dense index source (ratio 2) and the candidate source (ratio 1).
+INDEX_LAYERS = ((2, False), (1, True))
+
+
+def _index_keys(ratio: int, generator):
+    """A paged MXFP4 indexer key cache holding every context once."""
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.common.ops import indexer_k_norm_rope_store
+
+    row_bytes = INDEX_HEAD_DIM // 2 + INDEX_HEAD_DIM // 32
+    page_states = PAGE_TOKENS // ratio
+    pages = [-(-(ctx // ratio) // page_states) for ctx in CONTEXTS]
+    page_bytes = -(-(page_states * row_bytes) // 512) * 512
+    storage = torch.empty(sum(pages), page_bytes, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    cache = storage.as_strided(
+        (sum(pages), page_states, row_bytes), (page_bytes, row_bytes, 1)
+    )
+    angles = torch.rand(2 * ROPE_POSITIONS, 32, generator=generator, device="cuda")
+    cos_sin = torch.cat((angles.cos(), angles.sin()), dim=-1)
+    norm_weight = torch.ones(INDEX_HEAD_DIM, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+    num_slots = sum(pages) * page_states
+    for first in range(0, num_slots, 1 << 20):
+        slots = torch.arange(first, min(first + (1 << 20), num_slots), device="cuda")
+        k_pre = _randn(generator, slots.numel(), INDEX_HEAD_DIM)
+        positions = (slots % ROPE_POSITIONS) * ratio + ratio - 1
+        indexer_k_norm_rope_store(
+            k_pre, positions, cos_sin, norm_weight, 1e-6, cache, slots, ratio, True
+        )
+    starts = [sum(pages[:i]) for i in range(len(pages))]
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        cache=cache, page_states=page_states, pages=pages, starts=starts
+    )
+
+
+def _decode_step(requests, padding, ratio, keys, generator):
+    """The indexer metadata and queries of a pure-decode step of ``NEXT_N``
+    rows per request; padding requests have rows of length 0."""
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.common.ops import fused_indexer_q_rope_quant
+    from vllm.utils.deep_gemm import get_paged_mqa_logits_metadata
+    from vllm.utils.platform_utils import num_compute_units
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.indexer import (
+        DeepSeekV32IndexerDecodeMetadata,
+        DeepseekV32IndexerMetadata,
+    )
+
+    rows = requests * NEXT_N
+    real = requests - padding
+    lens, tables, indices = [], [], []
+    for request in range(real):
+        i = request % len(CONTEXTS)
+        table = torch.zeros(max(keys.pages), dtype=torch.int32)
+        table[: keys.pages[i]] = torch.arange(
+            keys.starts[i], keys.starts[i] + keys.pages[i]
+        )
+        for j in range(NEXT_N):
+            lens.append((CONTEXTS[i] - NEXT_N + j + 1) // ratio)
+            tables.append(table)
+            indices.append(request)
+    for row in range(real * NEXT_N, rows):
+        # Padding rows: no context, each its own index.
+        lens.append(0)
+        tables.append(torch.zeros(max(keys.pages), dtype=torch.int32))
+        indices.append(requests + row - real * NEXT_N)
+    seq_lens = torch.tensor(lens, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda").unsqueeze(1)
+    indices = torch.tensor(indices, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    decode = DeepSeekV32IndexerDecodeMetadata(
+        block_table=torch.stack(tables).cuda(),
+        seq_lens=seq_lens,
+        decode_lens=torch.ones(rows, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"),
+        requires_padding=False,
+        schedule_metadata=get_paged_mqa_logits_metadata(
+            seq_lens, keys.page_states, num_compute_units(), indices=indices
+        ),
+        indices=indices,
+    )
+    metadata = DeepseekV32IndexerMetadata(
+        seq_lens=torch.zeros(requests, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"),
+        max_seq_len=max(CONTEXTS),
+        slot_mapping=torch.zeros(rows, dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda"),
+        num_decodes=requests,
+        num_decode_tokens=rows,
+        num_prefills=0,
+        num_prefill_tokens=0,
+        decode=decode,
+    )
+    angles = torch.linspace(0, 6.3, ROPE_POSITIONS * 32, device="cuda").view(-1, 32)
+    (q, q_scale), weights = fused_indexer_q_rope_quant(
+        torch.arange(rows, device="cuda") + 100,
+        _randn(generator, rows, INDEX_HEADS, INDEX_HEAD_DIM),
+        torch.cat((angles.cos(), angles.sin()), dim=-1),
+        _randn(generator, rows, INDEX_HEADS),
+        INDEX_HEAD_DIM**-0.5,
+        INDEX_HEADS**-0.5,
+        use_fp4=True,
+        weights_out_dtype=torch.float32,
+    )
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        metadata=metadata, rows=rows, q=(q, q_scale), weights=weights
+    )
+
+
+def _indexer(keys, ratio, candidates):
+    """The decode indexer of a layer, writing ``topk`` (and ``candidates``)."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.sparse_attn_indexer import SparseAttnIndexer
+
+    rows = max(r for r, _ in INDEX_BATCHES) * NEXT_N
+    return SparseAttnIndexer(
+        SimpleNamespace(prefix="indexer", kv_cache=keys.cache),
+        quant_block_size=128,
+        scale_fmt="ue8m0",
+        topk_tokens=INDEX_TOPK,
+        head_dim=INDEX_HEAD_DIM,
+        max_model_len=MAX_MODEL_LEN // ratio,
+        max_total_seq_len=0,
+        topk_indices_buffer=torch.empty(
+            rows, INDEX_TOPK, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"
+        ),
+        skip_k_cache_insert=True,
+        use_fp4_cache=True,
+        compress_ratio=ratio,
+        candidate_blocks=torch.empty(
+            rows, CANDIDATE_BLOCKS, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"
+        )
+        if candidates
+        else None,
+        candidate_block_size=CANDIDATE_BLOCK_SIZE,
+        candidate_write=candidates,
+    )
+
+
+def _run_indexer(indexer, step, stock=False):
+    """One decode forward, stock or the executor's; returns the top-k and
+    candidate rows it wrote."""
+    from vllm.forward_context import ForwardContext, override_forward_context
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.specialized_decode.attention.indexer import (
+        decode_rows,
+    )
+
+    hidden = torch.empty(step.rows, 1, device="cuda")
+    with override_forward_context(ForwardContext({}, {"indexer": step.metadata}, {})):
+        if stock:
+            indexer.forward_cuda(hidden, step.q, None, step.weights)
+        else:
+            decode_rows(indexer, hidden, step.q, step.weights)
+    candidates = indexer.candidate_blocks
+    return (
+        indexer.topk_indices_buffer[: step.rows],
+        None if candidates is None else candidates[: step.rows],
+    )

+def _index_scores(indexer, step):
+    """The replicated logits, and the candidate block scores (newest block
+    pinned) the candidate selection ranks."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.sparse_attn_indexer import (
+        as_fp32_logits,
+        kv_cache_as_quant_view,
+    )
+    from vllm.utils.deep_gemm import fp8_fp4_paged_mqa_logits, mqa_logits_mx_inputs
+
+    decode = step.metadata.decode
+    q, q_scale = step.q
+    q = q.unsqueeze(1).view(torch.int8)
+    q_scale, weights = mqa_logits_mx_inputs(q, q_scale.unsqueeze(1), step.weights)
+    ends = decode.seq_lens.view(-1)
+    logits = as_fp32_logits(
+        fp8_fp4_paged_mqa_logits(
+            (q, q_scale),
+            kv_cache_as_quant_view(indexer.k_cache.kv_cache, INDEX_HEAD_DIM, True),
+            weights,
+            decode.seq_lens,
+            decode.block_table,
+            decode.schedule_metadata,
+            max_model_len=indexer.max_model_len,
+            indices=decode.indices,
+        ),
+        ends,
+    )
+    width = logits.shape[1]
+    valid = logits.masked_fill(
+        torch.arange(width, device="cuda") >= ends.unsqueeze(1), float("-inf")
+    )
+    valid = torch.nn.functional.pad(
+        valid, (0, -width % CANDIDATE_BLOCK_SIZE), value=float("-inf")
+    )
+    blocks = valid.view(step.rows, -1, CANDIDATE_BLOCK_SIZE).amax(-1)
+    live = (ends > 0).nonzero().view(-1)
+    blocks[live, ((ends[live] - 1) // CANDIDATE_BLOCK_SIZE).long()] = float("inf")
+    return logits, blocks
+
+
+def _assert_same_sets(got, want, scores, limits, k, what):
+    """Per row: equal index sets, except that indices whose scores tie
+    exactly at the selection boundary may be swapped; padding rows are -1."""
+    got, want, limits = got.cpu(), want.cpu(), limits.cpu()
+    for row in range(got.shape[0]):
+        g = got[row][got[row] >= 0].tolist()
+        w = want[row][want[row] >= 0].tolist()
+        assert len(set(g)) == len(g) == min(int(limits[row]), k), (what, row)
+        assert (got[row][got[row] < 0] == -1).all(), (what, row)
+        if set(g) != set(w):
+            row_scores = scores[row]
+            boundary = row_scores[torch.tensor(w, device="cuda")].min()
+            swapped = torch.tensor(sorted(set(g) ^ set(w)), device="cuda")
+            assert (row_scores[swapped] == boundary).all(), (what, row)
+
+
+def _check_row_sharded_indexer(rank):
+    generator = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(0)  # equal on all ranks
+    keys = {ratio: _index_keys(ratio, generator) for ratio, _ in INDEX_LAYERS}
+    for requests, padding in INDEX_BATCHES:
+        for ratio, candidates in INDEX_LAYERS:
+            what = f"{requests} requests ({padding} padding), ratio {ratio}"
+            generator.manual_seed(1000 * requests + ratio)
+            step = _decode_step(requests, padding, ratio, keys[ratio], generator)
+            indexer = _indexer(keys[ratio], ratio, candidates)
+            want = [
+                t if t is None else t.clone()
+                for t in _run_indexer(indexer, step, stock=True)
+            ]
+            _late(rank, requests)
+            got = _run_indexer(indexer, step)
+            logits, blocks = _index_scores(indexer, step)
+            ends = step.metadata.decode.seq_lens.view(-1)
+            _assert_same_sets(got[0], want[0], logits, ends, INDEX_TOPK, what)
+            if candidates:
+                block_ends = (ends + CANDIDATE_BLOCK_SIZE - 1) // CANDIDATE_BLOCK_SIZE
+                _assert_same_sets(
+                    got[1], want[1], blocks, block_ends, CANDIDATE_BLOCKS, what
+                )

+# ------------------------------------------------------- graph replays
+
+
+def _check_replays(arm, publisher, keys, rank, replays):
+    """One CUDA graph of a decode step's collectives: a published ``wo_b``
+    boundary, a deferred finalize with the MXFP8 layer input, a residual-only
+    boundary, a full-capacity boundary and the row-sharded indexer, with the
+    ranks arriving in a fixed skew. Every replay must equal the first; the
+    indexer's top-k rows as sets up to boundary ties, since top-k writes them
+    in any order and picks any of the indices that tie at the boundary."""
+    from vllm.distributed.parallel_state import graph_capture
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.specialized_decode.boundary.boundary import (
+        empty_quantized_layer_input,
+    )
+
+    linear = _wo_b(rank, 0)
+    qa = _attention_output(6, rank)
+    moe = _moe_partial(6, rank)
+    quantized = empty_quantized_layer_input(6, HIDDEN, qa.data.device)
+    mixes = {rows: _mix(rows) for rows in (6, 48, CAPACITY)}
+    partials = {rows: _partial(rows, rank, seed=rows) for rows in (48, CAPACITY)}
+    step = _decode_step(8, 0, 2, keys[2], torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(1))
+    indexer = _indexer(keys[2], 2, candidates=False)
+
+    def decode_step():
+        torch.cuda._sleep(rank * LATE_CYCLES)
+        out = list(arm(publisher(linear, qa), **mixes[6]))
+        out += arm.finalize(
+            *moe, *mixes[6].values(), mxfp8_out=(quantized.data, quantized.scale)
+        )
+        out += [quantized.data, quantized.scale]
+        mix = mixes[48]
+        streams, _ = arm(
+            partials[48], mix["residual"], mix["post"], mix["comb"], None, None, 1e-6
+        )
+        out.append(streams)
+        out += arm(partials[CAPACITY], **mixes[CAPACITY])
+        out.append(_run_indexer(indexer, step)[0])
+        return [t for t in out if t is not None]
+
+    with graph_capture(device=torch.device("cuda")) as context:
+        decode_step()
+        graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+        with torch.cuda.graph(graph, stream=context.stream):
+            outputs = decode_step()
+    graph.replay()
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    *collectives, topk = outputs
+    first = [t.clone() for t in collectives]
+    first_topk = topk.clone()
+    logits, _ = _index_scores(indexer, step)
+    ends = step.metadata.decode.seq_lens.view(-1)
+    for i in range(replays):
+        graph.replay()
+        if i % 50 == 49 or i == replays - 1:
+            _assert_equal(collectives, first, f"replay {i}")
+            _assert_same_sets(topk, first_topk, logits, ends, INDEX_TOPK, f"replay {i}")
+
+

+def _worker(rank: int, port: int, replays: int, skip_path: str) -> None:
+    from tests.utils import init_test_distributed_environment
+    from vllm.config import VllmConfig, set_current_vllm_config

+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.ops import mhc
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.specialized_decode.boundary.all_reduce import (
+        BoundaryAllReduce,
+    )

+        PublishingMxfp8Linear,
+    )
+    from vllm.v1.worker.workspace import init_workspace_manager
+
+    torch.accelerator.set_device_index(rank)
+    with set_current_vllm_config(VllmConfig()), torch.inference_mode():
+        init_test_distributed_environment(TP, 1, rank, str(port), local_rank=rank)
+        init_workspace_manager(torch.device("cuda", rank))
+        config = SimpleNamespace(
+            parallel_config=SimpleNamespace(

+            ),
+            model_config=SimpleNamespace(

+                )
+            ),
+        )
+        supported = torch.tensor([int(mhc.supports_mhc_all_reduce(config))])
+        torch.distributed.all_reduce(
+            supported, torch.distributed.ReduceOp.MIN, get_tp_group().cpu_group
+        )
+        if not supported.item():
+            if rank == 0:
+                with open(skip_path, "w") as f:
+                    f.write("no NVLink multicast for the fused all-reduce + mHC")
+            cleanup_dist_env_and_memory()
+            return
+        arm = BoundaryAllReduce(config.model_config.hf_config, True)
+        assert arm.capacity == CAPACITY and arm.quantize_layer_input

+        _check_publishing_wo_b(arm, publisher, rank)

+        torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+        cleanup_dist_env_and_memory()
+
+
+def run(replays: int) -> str | None:
+    """Run the checks on four GPUs; returns why they were skipped, if so."""
+    from vllm.utils.network_utils import get_open_port
+
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
+        skip_path = os.path.join(tmp, "skipped")
+        torch.multiprocessing.spawn(
+            _worker, args=(get_open_port(), replays, skip_path), nprocs=TP
+        )
+        if os.path.exists(skip_path):
+            with open(skip_path) as f:
+                return f.read()
+    return None
+

@@ -0,0 +1,105 @@
+# DeepSeek-V4.1 specialized decode (NVIDIA)
+
+A decode executor for small decode batches of DeepSeek-V4.1 on GB300, enabled
+with `--additional-config '{"decode_backend": "latency_specialized"}'` (the
+default, `auto`, keeps the stock decode). With it off, the model runs exactly as
+without this package. The executor runs the target model; the DSpark draft
+model keeps its stock paths.
+
+## Scope
+
+`specialized_decode_config` (`__init__.py`) reads the setting once, when the
+target model is built. Any deployment other than the one below raises at
+startup on every TP rank with the missing requirements:
+
+- GPU: GB300 (SM103).
+- Runner: Model Runner V2.
+- Parallelism: TP=4; no pipeline, data, expert or context parallelism, no
+  micro-batching.
+- Speculative decoding: DSpark, without adaptive verification.
+- Attention: `FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_DSV41`, fp8 KV cache, MXFP4 indexer with
+  sparse logits.
+- CUDA graphs: FULL graphs for decode batches only (`FULL_AND_PIECEWISE` or
+  `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`).
+- No `torch.compile` of the model, no sleep mode.
+- No LoRA, KV transfer or batch invariance.
+- DeepGEMM and NVLink multicast for the fused all-reduce + mHC.
+
+This check runs once, at startup. The configuration is the same on every
+rank, but the last requirement is probed per rank: the custom all-reduce sets
+up its NVLink multicast buffers on each rank and catches a failure there, so
+one rank can be without them while the others have them. The ranks' results
+are therefore combined with a MIN all-reduce over the TP group: if any rank
+misses a requirement, every rank raises, rather than some ranks running the
+specialized decode and others the stock one, which issue different
+collectives and would hang. Which forward steps use the executor depends
+only on the batch, which every TP rank receives identically, so that needs no
+collective.
+
+Four features run only on flashinfer-python 0.7.2 (`FLASHINFER_VERSION`, the
+version `requirements/cuda.txt` pins). Three use FlashInfer internals:
+
+- the publishing `wo_b` GEMM: the CuTe DSL low-latency block-scaled GEMM
+  kernel, and `mm_mxfp8`'s private runner and tuning config
+  (`flashinfer.gemm.gemm_base`) to look up its tuned tactic;
+- the fused kernel's MXFP8 layer input: the CuTe DSL MXFP8 quantize helpers
+  (`flashinfer.quantization.quantization_cute_dsl_utils`,
+  `flashinfer.cute_dsl.fp4_common`);
+- the pinned MXFP8 GEMM tactics: the low-latency GEMM's `autotune_tactics`.
+
+The fourth, the sparse-MLA decode's persistent KV counters, passes the
+`multi_ctas_kv_counter_buffer` argument that 0.7.1 added.
+
+On any other version each logs a warning once and the executor goes without
+it; the MXFP8 GEMMs then tune over every tactic.
+
+## Structure
+
+The model state (`runtime/model_state.py`) builds the executor
+(`runtime/decode.py`) once the weights are loaded, and tunes and compiles its
+kernels (`runtime/warmup.py`) before memory profiling. For each forward, the
+model asks the executor for a `DecodeStep`; the backbone runs its embedding and
+Engram hashing as usual, then hands the decoder layers to the step. Only FULL
+CUDA graph captures of pure decode steps of up to 384 rows get one; every other
+forward runs the stock layers, which the executor does not modify.
+
+| Package | Contents |
+| --- | --- |
+| `runtime/` | The executor and its per-step gates, the model state, warm-up, attention-metadata CUDA graphs |
+| `boundary/` | The mHC between sublayers on the fused all-reduce + mHC kernel, and the publishing `wo_b` GEMM |
+| `attention/` | The attention step: low-batch MXFP8 and BF16 projections, the row-sharded indexer, candidate overlap, shared sparse-index tables and the sparse-MLA decode |
+| `moe/` | The MoE step with a deferred finalize, and the low-batch routed-expert GEMMs |
+| `engram/` | The Engram WKV ahead of the decoder layers |
+| `logits/` | The low-batch LM head and the logits gather |
+
+## Paths
+
+| Path | Steps |
+| --- | --- |
+| Fused Lamport all-reduce + mHC at every sublayer boundary; the next mHC coefficients on the side stream up to 48 rows, inline beyond | all executor steps (up to 384 rows) |
+| Every MoE finalize deferred to the next boundary's fused kernel, in a residual-only variant before an Engram layer and after the last layer | all executor steps |
+| The fused kernel also writes the attention input as MXFP8, which `fused_wqa_wkv` reads instead of quantizing again | all executor steps |
+| Aux hidden-state means on the mHC side stream | up to 48 rows |
+| Routed experts on CuTe DSL routing and `tcgen05` GEMM kernels (`moe/routed_expert_gemm.py`) | 1-8 rows |
+| `fused_wqa_wkv`, `wq_b` and `wo_b` on FlashInfer's low-latency CuTe DSL MXFP8 GEMM with pinned tactics | 1-8 rows |
+| Compressor, indexer-weight and indexer `wk` projections on a low-batch BF16 GEMM; the index key store reads `wk`'s FP32 output | 1-8 rows |
+| `wo_b` stores its output into the fused kernel's mailbox, which then only collects | 1-8 rows |
+| Indexer query, compressor and index key on side streams, each joined at its first reader | all executor steps; the side projections up to `VLLM_MULTI_STREAM_GEMM_TOKEN_THRESHOLD` rows |
+| Candidate consumers' candidate expansion and MQA-logits schedule on a side stream after the candidate source's indexer | up to 16 rows |

+| Candidate blocks selected with `cooperative_topk` | up to 64 rows per rank |
+| Compressed layers sharing an index source reuse one sparse-index table; the first of them builds the other KV-cache groups' tables on a side stream | all executor steps |
+| Sparse-MLA decode launched on a KV-counter buffer zeroed once | all executor steps |
+| Engram WKV chain on a side stream right after each layer's lookup | up to 16 rows, with host-offloaded TP-only tables and a CuTe DSL MXFP8 `wkv` |
+| Attention metadata builds recorded at CUDA graph capture, one per batch shape the FULL decode graphs serve, and replayed | FULL-graph uniform decode |
+| LM head on FlashInfer's CuTe DSL BF16 GEMM | 1-16 rows |
+| Logits gathered with the custom all-gather | whenever it accepts the input |
+
+## Dispatch
+
+The executor issues cross-rank collectives, so a rank that diverged would hang
+rather than fall back. Every per-step gate reads only host state that all TP
+ranks share (row and request counts, graph mode, the attention metadata's host
+fields); nothing is read back from the GPU. The LM head and logits gather run
+outside the CUDA graph (Model Runner V2 computes logits eagerly), gated by row
+count and by the custom all-gather.
