+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""DeepSeek-V4.1 specialized decode on NVIDIA GPUs: a decode executor over the
+stock backbone, enabled by
+``additional_config={"decode_backend": "latency_specialized"}``.
+
+The executor runs FULL-graph decode steps; every other step runs the stock
+forward. It issues cross-rank collectives, so the deployment check below is
+collective over the TP group and every per-step decision reads host state that
+all TP ranks share.
+"""
+
+import importlib.metadata
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from functools import cache
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+import vllm.envs as envs
+from vllm.config import CompilationMode, CUDAGraphMode, VllmConfig
+from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.registry import AttentionBackendEnum
+
+from ..ops.mhc import supports_mhc_all_reduce, supports_mhc_overlap
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+# Rows of the executor's fused all-reduce + mHC mailbox: the largest FULL
+# decode graph at 64 requests x 6 DSpark tokens.
+FUSED_MHC_MAX_ROWS = 384
+# Rows whose next mHC coefficients run on the side stream; larger steps compute
+# them inline after the fused kernel.
+MHC_OVERLAP_MAX_ROWS = 48
+# Rows of the low-batch GEMMs: one DSpark verification step of up to 8 rows
+# (6 at one request).
+LOW_BATCH_MAX_ROWS = 8
+# The FlashInfer (requirements/cuda.txt) whose internals the publishing wo_b
+# GEMM, the MXFP8 layer input and the pinned MXFP8 tactics were checked
+# against. Its sparse-MLA decode takes caller-owned KV counters (since 0.7.1).
+FLASHINFER_VERSION = "0.7.2"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class DecodeConfig:
+    # Tune the executor's FlashInfer GEMMs at build
+    # (kernel_config.enable_flashinfer_autotune is not False).
+    autotune: bool
+    # Compile the mHC pre-norm kernels of the executor's row counts.
+    jit_warmup: bool
+
+
+@cache
+def uses_checked_flashinfer(feature: str) -> bool:
+    """Whether the installed FlashInfer is the version whose internals
+    ``feature`` uses; logs once per feature when it is not."""
+    try:
+        version = importlib.metadata.version("flashinfer-python")
+    except importlib.metadata.PackageNotFoundError:
+        version = None
+    if version == FLASHINFER_VERSION:
+        return True
+    logger.warning(
+        "DeepSeek-V4.1 specialized decode: %s needs flashinfer-python %s "
+        "(found %s); using the stock path instead.",
+        feature,
+        FLASHINFER_VERSION,
+        version,
+    )
+    return False
+
+
+def unsupported(vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> list[str]:
+    """Every requirement of the specialized decode this deployment misses."""
+    parallel = vllm_config.parallel_config
+    attention = vllm_config.attention_config
+    spec = vllm_config.speculative_config
+    compilation = vllm_config.compilation_config
+    cudagraph_mode = compilation.cudagraph_mode
+    requirements = {
+        "a GB300 (SM103) GPU": current_platform.is_device_capability(103),
+        "Model Runner V2": vllm_config.use_v2_model_runner,
+        "tensor parallel size 4 without pipeline, data, expert or context "
+        "parallelism or micro-batching": (
+            parallel.tensor_parallel_size == 4
+            and parallel.pipeline_parallel_size == 1
+            and parallel.data_parallel_size == 1
+            and not parallel.enable_expert_parallel
+            and parallel.decode_context_parallel_size == 1
+            and parallel.prefill_context_parallel_size == 1
+            and not parallel.use_ubatching
+        ),
+        "DSpark speculative decoding without adaptive verification": (
+            spec is not None
+            and spec.method == "dspark"
+            and not spec.enable_adaptive_verification
+        ),
+        "the FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_DSV41 attention backend, an fp8 KV cache "
+        "and the MXFP4 indexer with sparse logits": (
+            attention.backend == AttentionBackendEnum.FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_DSV41
+            and vllm_config.cache_config.cache_dtype in ("fp8", "fp8_e4m3")
+            and attention.indexer_kv_dtype == "mxfp4"
+            and attention.indexer_sparse_logits
+        ),
+        "FULL CUDA graphs for decode batches only (FULL_AND_PIECEWISE or "
+        "FULL_DECODE_ONLY)": (
+            cudagraph_mode is not None
+            and cudagraph_mode.decode_mode() == CUDAGraphMode.FULL
+            and cudagraph_mode.mixed_mode() != CUDAGraphMode.FULL
+        ),
+        # The decode loop runs in forward; a compiled forward would trace it.
+        "no torch.compile of the model": (
+            compilation.mode != CompilationMode.STOCK_TORCH_COMPILE
+        ),
+        # The routed-expert GEMMs and the publishing wo_b bind weight addresses.
+        "no sleep mode": not vllm_config.model_config.enable_sleep_mode,
+        "no LoRA, KV transfer or batch invariance": (
+            vllm_config.lora_config is None
+            and vllm_config.kv_transfer_config is None
+            and not envs.VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT
+        ),
+        "DeepGEMM and NVLink multicast for the fused all-reduce + mHC": (
+            supports_mhc_overlap(vllm_config) and supports_mhc_all_reduce(vllm_config)
+        ),
+    }
+    return [need for need, ok in requirements.items() if not ok]
+
+
+def specialized_decode_config(vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> DecodeConfig | None:
+    """The specialized decode settings, or None for the stock decode.
+
+    Collective over the TP group when requested: every rank raises if any rank
+    cannot run the specialized decode.
+    """
+    extra = vllm_config.additional_config
+    backend = extra.get("decode_backend", "auto") if isinstance(extra, dict) else "auto"
+    if backend == "auto":
+        return None
+    if backend != "latency_specialized":
+        raise ValueError("Supported decode_backend values are auto/latency_specialized")
+    missing = unsupported(vllm_config)
+    supported = torch.tensor([0 if missing else 1], dtype=torch.int32)
+    # The NVLink multicast check is rank-local (the custom all-reduce catches a
+    # failed setup on each rank), and ranks that disagree would hang.
+    dist.all_reduce(supported, op=dist.ReduceOp.MIN, group=get_tp_group().cpu_group)
+    if not supported.item():
+        reason = "; ".join(missing) or "another tensor parallel rank to support it"
+        raise ValueError(f"decode_backend=latency_specialized needs {reason}.")
+    logger.info_once(
+        "DeepSeek-V4.1 specialized decode on, for FULL-graph decode steps of up "
+        "to %d rows.",
+        FUSED_MHC_MAX_ROWS,
+    )
+    kernel = vllm_config.kernel_config
+    return DecodeConfig(
+        autotune=kernel.enable_flashinfer_autotune is not False,
+        jit_warmup=bool(kernel.enable_jit_warmup),
+    )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Low-batch GEMMs of the attention side projections.
+
+Next to ``fused_wqa_wkv``, the kv-source layers project the attention input
+through the compressor's ``fused_wkv_wgate`` (FP32 ``kv_score``) and the
+index-source layers through the indexer's ``weights_proj``. At decode sizes
+cuBLAS runs both as a split-K GEMM plus a reduce kernel, longer than
+``fused_wqa_wkv`` itself. For low-batch FULL-graph steps they run the CuTe DSL
+``ll_bf16`` kernels instead: FP32 ``x @ W.T`` that differs from cuBLAS only in
+the K summation order. The indexer's ``wk`` (compressor latent to index key)
+takes the same kernels.
+"""
+
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.cute_dsl import ll_bf16
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.cute_dsl.ll_bf16 import LLBf16Gemm
+
+from .. import LOW_BATCH_MAX_ROWS
+
+# Below this N the split-K kernel has too few CTAs; the dot product runs.
+_DOTPROD_MAX_N = 128
+_DOTPROD_BS = 128
+
+# Per (K, N) and row count, the fastest config on GB300 where it beats the
+# default dispatch: ("dotprod", bs) or ("splitk", (split_k, num_stages)).
+_TUNED: dict[tuple[int, int], dict[int, tuple[str, int | tuple[int, int]]]] = {
+    # Compressor ratio 2 (kv + score).
+    (5120, 1024): {m: ("splitk", (4, 4)) for m in (5, 6, 7, 8)},
+    # Compressor ratio 1 (kv only).
+    (5120, 512): {5: ("dotprod", 128), 6: ("dotprod", 64), 8: ("splitk", (4, 6))},
+}
+
+
+class AuxProjectionGemm(LLBf16Gemm):
+    def dispatch(
+        self, *, M: int, K: int, N: int, output_dtype: torch.dtype = torch.float32
+    ) -> LLBf16Gemm.CompileKey:
+        tuned = _TUNED.get((K, N), {}).get(M)
+        if tuned is not None:
+            backend, config = tuned
+            if backend == "dotprod":
+                assert isinstance(config, int)
+                return self.CompileKey(
+                    backend="dotprod", M=M, K=K, bs=config, output_dtype=output_dtype
+                )
+            assert isinstance(config, tuple)
+            split_k, num_stages = config
+            return self.CompileKey(
+                backend="splitk",
+                split_k=split_k,
+                num_stages=num_stages,
+                output_dtype=output_dtype,
+            )
+        if N < _DOTPROD_MAX_N:
+            return self.CompileKey(
+                backend="dotprod", M=M, K=K, bs=_DOTPROD_BS, output_dtype=output_dtype
+            )
+        return super().dispatch(M=M, K=K, N=N, output_dtype=output_dtype)
+
+
+aux_projection_gemm = AuxProjectionGemm()
+
+
+def aux_projection_gemm_accepts(weights: list[torch.Tensor]) -> bool:
+    """Whether ``aux_projection_gemm`` takes every one of ``weights``."""
+    return (
+        bool(weights)
+        and ll_bf16.is_available()
+        and all(
+            w.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            and w.dim() == 2
+            and w.is_contiguous()
+            and w.shape[1] % 8 == 0
+            for w in weights
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def warmup_aux_projection_gemms(weights: Iterable[torch.Tensor]) -> None:
+    """Compile the kernels of every row count before graph capture."""
+    shapes = sorted({(w.shape[1], w.shape[0]) for w in weights})
+    aux_projection_gemm.warmup(shapes=shapes, m_values=range(1, LOW_BATCH_MAX_ROWS + 1))

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Candidate-block selection with ``cooperative_topk`` for decode rows.
+
+`select_candidate_blocks` scores every block of the padded logits row and
+runs ``torch.topk`` over all of them. At long context most of a decode row is
+padding, so here the score kernel also writes each row's valid block count and
+``cooperative_topk`` scans only that prefix.
+
+The selected set of non-negative ids matches `select_candidate_blocks` except
+for which blocks whose fp32 scores tie exactly at the selection boundary are
+kept. ``cooperative_topk`` keeps at most ``k`` (rows of up to 16384 blocks) or
+1024 per cluster CTA (longer rows) candidates of its fp16 boundary bin, so a
+more crowded boundary bin is selected approximately. The pinned newest block is
+kept unless at least ``k`` blocks of the row score NaN or overflow fp16. Rows
+are not sorted and -1 padding may sit anywhere; every consumer of the candidate
+buffer treats a row as a set.
+"""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.attention.dsa.candidate_blocks import _max_with_nan
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.indexer_topk import (
+    AUTO_COOPERATIVE_MAX_ROWS,
+    RADIX_TOPK_WORKSPACE_SIZE,
+)
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+from vllm.v1.worker.workspace import current_workspace_manager
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["width", "nblocks"])
+def _block_scores_kernel(
+    logits,
+    ends,
+    scores,
+    lengths,
+    out,
+    stride_row,
+    stride_col,
+    width,
+    nblocks,
+    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    K: tl.constexpr,
+    TILE: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    blocks = tl.program_id(1) * TILE + tl.arange(0, TILE)
+    end = tl.load(ends + row)
+    # Blocks from cdiv(end, BLOCK_SIZE) on score -inf and are not pinned, so
+    # the top-k reads only this prefix of the row, the only part stored.
+    limit = tl.minimum((tl.maximum(end, 0) + BLOCK_SIZE - 1) // BLOCK_SIZE, nblocks)
+    if tl.program_id(1) == 0:
+        tl.store(lengths + row, limit.to(tl.int32))
+        # cooperative_topk may leave slots unwritten when its boundary bin
+        # overflows; they must read -1, never a stale block id.
+        for tile in range(0, K, TILE):
+            slots = tile + tl.arange(0, TILE)
+            tl.store(out + row * K + slots, -1, slots < K)
+    offsets = tl.arange(0, triton.next_power_of_2(BLOCK_SIZE))
+    cols = blocks[:, None] * BLOCK_SIZE + offsets[None, :]
+    values = tl.load(
+        logits + row * stride_row + cols * stride_col,
+        (blocks[:, None] < nblocks)
+        & (offsets[None, :] < BLOCK_SIZE)
+        & (cols < end)
+        & (cols < width),
+        other=-float("inf"),
+    )
+    reduced = tl.reduce(values, 1, _max_with_nan)
+    reduced = tl.where(
+        (end > 0) & (blocks == (end - 1) // BLOCK_SIZE), float("inf"), reduced
+    )
+    tl.store(scores + row * nblocks + blocks, reduced, blocks < limit)
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["nblocks"])
+def _finalize_candidates_kernel(
+    out,
+    scores,
+    lengths,
+    nblocks,
+    K: tl.constexpr,
+    TILE: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    cols = tl.program_id(1) * TILE + tl.arange(0, TILE)
+    index = tl.load(out + row * K + cols, cols < K, other=-1)
+    valid = (index >= 0) & (index < tl.load(lengths + row))
+    value = tl.load(
+        scores + row * nblocks + index, (cols < K) & valid, other=-float("inf")
+    )
+    # Only -inf blocks become padding, as in select_candidate_blocks.
+    tl.store(
+        out + row * K + cols,
+        tl.where(valid & (value != -float("inf")), index, -1),
+        cols < K,
+    )
+
+
+def supports_cooperative_candidates(num_rows: int, num_blocks: int, k: int) -> bool:
+    """Whether `select_candidate_blocks_cooperative` takes ``num_rows`` rows of
+    ``num_blocks`` blocks and ``k`` candidates."""
+    return (
+        0 < num_rows <= AUTO_COOPERATIVE_MAX_ROWS
+        and k in (512, 1024, 2048)
+        # cooperative_topk reads the scores with TMA: 16-byte aligned rows.
+        and num_blocks % 4 == 0
+    )
+
+
+def select_candidate_blocks_cooperative(
+    logits: torch.Tensor,
+    row_ends: torch.Tensor,
+    block_size: int,
+    out: torch.Tensor,
+) -> None:
+    """`select_candidate_blocks` for decode rows, on ``cooperative_topk``.
+
+    Args:
+        logits: [rows, width] fp32 logits; row ``i`` is valid below
+            ``row_ends[i]``.
+        row_ends: Contiguous [rows] int32 row lengths in logits columns.
+        block_size: Columns per candidate block.
+        out: Contiguous [rows, k] int32 candidate block ids, -1 padded; see
+            `supports_cooperative_candidates` for the supported shapes.
+
+    """
+    rows, width = logits.shape
+    k = out.shape[1]
+    nblocks = triton.cdiv(width, block_size)
+    assert supports_cooperative_candidates(rows, nblocks, k)
+    assert out.dtype == torch.int32 and out.shape[0] == rows and out.is_contiguous()
+    scores = logits.new_empty((rows, nblocks))
+    lengths = torch.empty(rows, dtype=torch.int32, device=logits.device)
+    _block_scores_kernel[(rows, triton.cdiv(nblocks, 128))](
+        logits,
+        row_ends,
+        scores,
+        lengths,
+        out,
+        *logits.stride(),
+        width,
+        nblocks,
+        block_size,
+        k,
+        128,
+    )
+    (workspace,) = current_workspace_manager().get_simultaneous(
+        ((RADIX_TOPK_WORKSPACE_SIZE,), torch.uint8),
+    )
+    # Rows of at most k blocks take all of them and pad with -1; the last
+    # argument (max_seq_len) is unused by the kernel.
+    torch.ops._C.cooperative_topk(scores, lengths, out, workspace, k, nblocks)
+    _finalize_candidates_kernel[(rows, triton.cdiv(k, 1024))](
+        out, scores, lengths, nblocks, k, 1024
+    )

+"""The sparse-attention indexers in a specialized decode step.
+
+``decode_rows`` runs a dense indexer (``SparseAttnIndexer``) on a copy of the
+varlen decode branch of ``sparse_attn_indexer``, with two additions:
+
+- Row sharding. The indexer is replicated across the TP ranks. In a step of at
+  least ``ROW_SHARD_MIN_REQUESTS`` requests whose count the ranks divide, each
+  rank scores, selects candidates for and top-k's only its contiguous slice of
+  the rows; TP all-gathers of the int32 rows rebuild ``topk_indices_buffer``
+  and, in the candidate source, the candidate blocks.
+- The candidate source selects its candidate blocks with ``cooperative_topk``
+  for up to 64 rows per rank (see ``candidate_topk``).
+
+Steps it does not take run the stock indexer.
+
+``CandidateOverlap`` moves the candidate consumers' candidate expansion and
+sparse MQA-logits schedule onto a side stream.
+
+The row-sharded path issues TP collectives, so its gates read only host state
+that every TP rank shares: the step's row and request counts.
+"""
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.attention.dsa.candidate_blocks import (
+    apply_candidate_mask,
+    select_candidate_blocks,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.attention.dsa.sparse_mqa_logits import (
+    candidate_blocks_to_sparse_indices,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.indexer_topk import get_indexer_topk
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.sparse_attn_indexer import (
+    SparseAttnIndexer,
+    as_fp32_logits,
+    kv_cache_as_quant_view,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.sparse_mqa_indexer import SparseMQAIndexer
+from vllm.models.common.ops.sequence_parallel import sp_all_gather
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.attention import DeepseekV4Indexer
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.common.ops import fused_indexer_q_rope_quant
+from vllm.triton_utils import triton
+from vllm.utils.deep_gemm import (
+    fp8_fp4_paged_mqa_logits,
+    get_paged_mqa_logits_metadata,
+    get_paged_sparse_mqa_logits_metadata,
+    mqa_logits_mx_inputs,
+)
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.indexer import (
+    DeepSeekV32IndexerDecodeMetadata,
+    DeepseekV32IndexerMetadata,
+)
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.sparse_indexer import (
+    DeepseekV41SparseIndexerMetadata,
+    SparseMQARowsMetadata,
+)
+
+from .candidate_topk import (
+    select_candidate_blocks_cooperative,
+    supports_cooperative_candidates,
+)
+
+# Fewest requests of a row-sharded decode step.
+ROW_SHARD_MIN_REQUESTS = 8
+# Most rows of a step whose candidate expansion overlaps.
+OVERLAP_MAX_ROWS = 16
+
+
+def row_shard_bounds(
+    num_rows: int, num_requests: int, world_size: int, rank: int
+) -> tuple[int, int] | None:
+    """Rows ``[start, end)`` that ``rank`` scores in a pure-decode step, or
+    None when the step stays replicated.
+
+    Each slice holds whole requests of a uniform step; varlen rows are
+    independent, so the split is exact either way. Slices start on an even
+    row: DeepGEMM's paged MQA logits needs its int32 ``indices`` 8-byte
+    aligned. DSpark decode steps always split so; capture and profiling runs
+    of one row a request may not, and stay replicated.
+    """
+    rows = num_rows // world_size
+    if (
+        world_size < 2
+        or num_requests < ROW_SHARD_MIN_REQUESTS
+        or num_requests % world_size
+        or num_rows % num_requests
+        or rows % 2
+    ):
+        return None
+    return rank * rows, (rank + 1) * rows
+
+
+def rope_quant_q(
+    indexer: DeepseekV4Indexer,
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    indexer_weights: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    rotary_emb: nn.Module,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None, torch.Tensor]:
+    """The second half of ``indexer.forward_q``: RoPE and quantize the
+    projected queries ``q`` and scale the per-head ``indexer_weights``."""
+    q_quant, weights = fused_indexer_q_rope_quant(
+        positions,
+        q.view(-1, indexer.n_head, indexer.head_dim),
+        rotary_emb.cos_sin_cache,
+        indexer_weights,
+        indexer.softmax_scale,
+        indexer.n_head**-0.5,
+        use_fp4=indexer.use_fp4_kv,
+        weights_out_dtype=indexer.indexer_weights_dtype,
+    )
+    if isinstance(q_quant, tuple):
+        return q_quant[0], q_quant[1], weights
+    return q_quant, None, weights
+
+
+def _all_gather_rows(local: torch.Tensor, out: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+    # The custom all-gather takes floating-point rows and moves the int32
+    # bits unchanged: its Lamport variant rewrites only the INT32_MIN pattern.
+    out.copy_(sp_all_gather(local.view(torch.float32)).view(torch.int32))
+
+
+def decode_rows(
+    op: SparseAttnIndexer,
+    hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+    q_quant: torch.Tensor | tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor],
+    weights: torch.Tensor,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``op(hidden_states, q_quant, None, weights)`` for a pure-decode step,
+    row-sharded and with cooperative candidates where they apply."""
+    attn_metadata = get_forward_context().attn_metadata
+    metadata = (
+        attn_metadata.get(op.k_cache.prefix)
+        if isinstance(attn_metadata, dict)
+        else None
+    )
+    if (
+        not isinstance(metadata, DeepseekV32IndexerMetadata)
+        or metadata.num_prefills > 0
+        or metadata.decode is None
+        # Varlen paged MQA logits without DCP.
+        or metadata.decode.indices is None
+        or metadata.decode.global_seq_lens is not None
+        or not op.skip_k_cache_insert
+    ):
+        return op(hidden_states, q_quant, None, weights)
+    num_rows = metadata.num_decode_tokens
+    tp_group = get_tp_group()
+    bounds = row_shard_bounds(
+        num_rows, metadata.num_decodes, tp_group.world_size, tp_group.rank_in_group
+    )
+    start, end = bounds or (0, num_rows)
+    fast_candidates = (
+        op.candidate_write
+        and op.candidate_blocks is not None
+        and supports_cooperative_candidates(
+            end - start,
+            triton.cdiv(op.max_model_len, op.candidate_block_size),
+            op.candidate_blocks.shape[1],
+        )
+    )
+    if bounds is None and not fast_candidates:
+        return op(hidden_states, q_quant, None, weights)
+
+    q_values, q_scale = q_quant if isinstance(q_quant, tuple) else (q_quant, None)
+    topk_indices_buffer = op.topk_indices_buffer
+    topk_indices_buffer[: hidden_states.shape[0]] = -1
+    _decode_rows(
+        op,
+        q_values,
+        q_scale,
+        weights,
+        metadata.decode,
+        metadata.max_seq_len,
+        start,
+        end,
+        fast_candidates,
+    )
+    if bounds is not None:
+        _all_gather_rows(
+            topk_indices_buffer[start:end, : op.topk_tokens],
+            topk_indices_buffer[:num_rows, : op.topk_tokens],
+        )
+        if op.candidate_write:
+            assert op.candidate_blocks is not None
+            _all_gather_rows(
+                op.candidate_blocks[start:end], op.candidate_blocks[:num_rows]
+            )
+    return topk_indices_buffer
+
+
+def _decode_rows(
+    op: SparseAttnIndexer,
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    q_scale: torch.Tensor | None,
+    weights: torch.Tensor,
+    decode: DeepSeekV32IndexerDecodeMetadata,
+    max_seq_len: int,
+    start: int,
+    end: int,
+    fast_candidates: bool,
+) -> None:
+    """The varlen decode branch of `sparse_attn_indexer` on rows
+    ``[start, end)``: paged MQA logits, candidate selection or mask, and
+    top-k into the same rows of the shared buffers."""
+    assert decode.indices is not None
+    kv_cache = kv_cache_as_quant_view(
+        op.k_cache.kv_cache, op.head_dim, op.use_fp4_cache
+    )
+    seq_lens = decode.seq_lens[start:end]
+    indices = decode.indices[start:end]
+    schedule = decode.schedule_metadata
+    if end - start < decode.seq_lens.shape[0]:
+        # The slice's own schedule; a FULL graph records it.
+        schedule = get_paged_mqa_logits_metadata(
+            seq_lens, kv_cache.shape[1], schedule.shape[0] - 1, indices=indices
+        )
+    q = q[start:end].unsqueeze(1)
+    if op.use_fp4_cache:
+        q = q.view(torch.int8)
+    if q_scale is not None:
+        q_scale = q_scale[start:end].unsqueeze(1)
+    q_scale, decode_weights = mqa_logits_mx_inputs(q, q_scale, weights[start:end])
+    row_ends = seq_lens.view(-1)
+    logits = as_fp32_logits(
+        fp8_fp4_paged_mqa_logits(
+            (q, q_scale),
+            kv_cache,
+            decode_weights,
+            seq_lens,
+            decode.block_table[start:end],
+            schedule,
+            max_model_len=op.max_model_len,
+            indices=indices,
+        ),
+        row_ends,
+    )
+    if op.candidate_blocks is not None:
+        candidates = op.candidate_blocks[start:end]
+        if fast_candidates:
+            select_candidate_blocks_cooperative(
+                logits, row_ends, op.candidate_block_size, candidates
+            )
+        elif op.candidate_write:
+            select_candidate_blocks(
+                logits,
+                None,
+                row_ends,
+                candidates.shape[1],
+                op.candidate_block_size,
+                candidates,
+            )
+        else:
+            apply_candidate_mask(
+                logits, None, row_ends, candidates, op.candidate_block_size
+            )
+    get_indexer_topk(op.topk_backend)(
+        logits,
+        seq_lens,
+        1,
+        op.topk_indices_buffer[start:end, : op.topk_tokens],
+        op.topk_tokens,
+        max_seq_len,
+    )
+
+
+def decode_schedule(
+    op: SparseMQAIndexer,
+    rows: SparseMQARowsMetadata,
+    sparse_block_kv: int,
+    scratch: bool = False,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Expand the decode rows' candidates into ``rows.sparse_indices`` /
+    ``rows.end`` and return their DeepGEMM schedule; the same kernels and
+    inputs as the inline step of `sparse_mqa_logits_paged_decode`. With
+    ``scratch``, expand zero candidates into private outputs instead."""
+    assert rows.block_table is not None and rows.row_indices is not None
+    candidates = op.candidate_blocks[: rows.row_ke.shape[0]]
+    sparse_indices, end = rows.sparse_indices, rows.end
+    if scratch:
+        candidates = torch.zeros_like(candidates)
+        sparse_indices, end = torch.empty_like(sparse_indices), torch.empty_like(end)
+    candidate_blocks_to_sparse_indices(
+        candidates,
+        rows.row_ks,
+        rows.row_ke,
+        op.candidate_block_size,
+        sparse_block_kv,
+        out=(sparse_indices, end),
+    )
+    return get_paged_sparse_mqa_logits_metadata(
+        rows.row_ke,
+        rows.block_table,
+        rows.row_indices,
+        op.k_cache.kv_cache.shape[1],
+        sparse_indices,
+        torch.int8,
+        sparse_block_kv,
+    )
+
+
+class CandidateOverlap:
+    """The candidate consumers' expansion and schedule on a side stream.
+
+    The first candidate consumer of a decode step expands the candidate blocks
+    into DeepGEMM sparse block ids and builds the paged sparse MQA-logits
+    schedule, which later consumers reuse. Neither reads Q, the KV cache or the
+    hidden states, so the candidate source forks them onto ``stream`` once it
+    has written the candidates (``fork``) and every consumer waits for them
+    (``join``) before scoring. The kernels and inputs are those of the inline
+    path, so the outputs match.
+
+    The side stream issues no collectives. The fork waits on the main stream,
+    so a step's writes to the builder's ``sparse_indices`` / ``end`` cannot
+    overtake the previous step's reads, and the schedule allocated on
+    ``stream`` is recorded as used by the main stream.
+
+    DeepGEMM's schedule kernel keeps a per-stream workspace that it creates on
+    first use and refuses to create during a capture, so ``warm`` runs the
+    schedule on ``stream`` once from an eager decode step, on zero candidates
+    and private outputs; the executor forks only after that.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, consumer: SparseMQAIndexer) -> None:
+        self.consumer = consumer
+        self.stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
+        self.done = torch.cuda.Event()
+        self.warmed = False
+        self._forked = False
+
+    def _decode_rows(self) -> tuple[SparseMQARowsMetadata, int] | None:
+        attn_metadata = get_forward_context().attn_metadata
+        metadata = (
+            attn_metadata.get(self.consumer.k_cache.prefix)
+            if isinstance(attn_metadata, dict)
+            else None
+        )
+        if not isinstance(metadata, DeepseekV41SparseIndexerMetadata):
+            return None
+        rows = metadata.sparse_decode
+        if rows is None or not rows.row_ke.numel():
+            return None
+        return rows, metadata.sparse_block_kv
+
+    def warm(self) -> None:
+        """Create the side stream's schedule workspace from an eager step."""
+        found = None if self.warmed else self._decode_rows()
+        if found is None:
+            return
+        main = torch.cuda.current_stream()
+        self.stream.wait_stream(main)
+        with torch.cuda.stream(self.stream):
+            decode_schedule(self.consumer, *found, scratch=True)
+        main.wait_stream(self.stream)
+        self.warmed = True
+
+    def fork(self) -> None:
+        """Start the expansion; the candidate source calls this right after
+        its indexer has written the candidates."""
+        found = self._decode_rows()
+        if found is None or found[0].kernel_metadata is not None:
+            return
+        rows, sparse_block_kv = found
+        main = torch.cuda.current_stream()
+        self.stream.wait_stream(main)
+        try:
+            with torch.cuda.stream(self.stream):
+                schedule = decode_schedule(self.consumer, rows, sparse_block_kv)
+                self.done.record()
+        except BaseException:
+            # Rejoin so that a capture reports this error, not unjoined work.
+            main.wait_stream(self.stream)
+            raise
+        schedule.record_stream(main)
+        rows.kernel_metadata = schedule
+        self._forked = True
+
+    def join(self) -> None:
+        """Make the current stream wait for a pending fork, if any."""
+        if self._forked:
+            torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_event(self.done)
+            self._forked = False

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""MXFP4 indexer key store for the FP32 output of the low-batch ``wk`` GEMM.
+
+``indexer_k_norm_rope_store`` (``common/ops/indexer_k_store.py``) takes the
+BF16 output of the ``wk`` GEMM. The low-batch ``ll_bf16`` kernel returns its
+FP32 accumulation instead. This copy of the store kernel's MXFP4 path rounds
+each row to BF16 as it loads it, so it writes the keys the shared kernel
+writes for that row's BF16 GEMM output, without a separate cast launch.
+"""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.common.ops import MXFP4_BLOCK_SIZE, _fp32x2_to_fp4x2
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+
+def indexer_k_norm_rope_store_fp32(
+    k_pre: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    cos_sin_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    rms_norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    rms_norm_eps: float,
+    k_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    kv_slot_mapping: torch.Tensor,
+    compress_ratio: int,
+) -> None:
+    """``indexer_k_norm_rope_store`` into an MXFP4 cache for an FP32 ``k_pre``
+    ([num_tokens, 128], the FP32 ``wk(latent)``)."""
+    num_tokens = kv_slot_mapping.numel()
+    assert k_pre.ndim == 2 and k_pre.shape[1] == 128
+    assert k_pre.dtype == torch.float32 and k_pre.stride(1) == 1
+    assert num_tokens <= k_pre.shape[0] and num_tokens <= positions.numel()
+    assert compress_ratio in (1, 2)
+    if num_tokens == 0:
+        return
+    head_dim = k_pre.shape[1]
+    _k_norm_rope_mxfp4_store_kernel[(num_tokens,)](
+        k_pre,
+        k_pre.stride(0),
+        positions,
+        rms_norm_weight,
+        rms_norm_eps,
+        cos_sin_cache,
+        cos_sin_cache.stride(0),
+        k_cache,
+        kv_slot_mapping,
+        k_cache.shape[1],
+        HEAD_SIZE=head_dim,
+        ROPE_HEAD_DIM=64,
+        COMPRESS_RATIO=compress_ratio,
+        TOKEN_STRIDE=head_dim // 2,
+        SCALE_DIM=head_dim // MXFP4_BLOCK_SIZE,
+        KV_BLOCK_STRIDE=k_cache.stride(0),
+        num_warps=1,
+        launch_pdl=False,
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _k_norm_rope_mxfp4_store_kernel(
+    k_pre_ptr,
+    k_pre_stride,
+    positions_ptr,
+    rms_norm_weight_ptr,
+    rms_norm_eps,
+    cos_sin_cache_ptr,
+    cos_sin_stride,
+    k_cache_ptr,
+    kv_slot_mapping_ptr,
+    kv_cache_block_size,
+    HEAD_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    ROPE_HEAD_DIM: tl.constexpr,
+    COMPRESS_RATIO: tl.constexpr,
+    TOKEN_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    SCALE_DIM: tl.constexpr,
+    KV_BLOCK_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    token_idx = tl.program_id(0)
+    kv_slot_idx = tl.load(kv_slot_mapping_ptr + token_idx)
+    if kv_slot_idx < 0:
+        return
+    position = tl.load(positions_ptr + token_idx)
+    if (position + 1) % COMPRESS_RATIO != 0:
+        return
+
+    block = tl.arange(0, HEAD_SIZE)
+    # The BF16 GEMM output, then k_norm as in the shared kernel.
+    k = tl.load(k_pre_ptr + token_idx * k_pre_stride + block)
+    k = k.to(tl.bfloat16).to(tl.float32)
+    rms_w = tl.load(rms_norm_weight_ptr + block).to(tl.float32)
+    variance = tl.sum(k * k, axis=0) / HEAD_SIZE
+    k = (k * tl.rsqrt(variance + rms_norm_eps) * rms_w).to(tl.bfloat16)
+    k = k.to(tl.float32)
+
+    # GPT-J RoPE of the trailing ROPE_HEAD_DIM values at the group position.
+    NUM_PAIRS: tl.constexpr = HEAD_SIZE // 2
+    NOPE_PAIRS: tl.constexpr = (HEAD_SIZE - ROPE_HEAD_DIM) // 2
+    HALF_ROPE: tl.constexpr = ROPE_HEAD_DIM // 2
+    even, odd = tl.split(tl.reshape(k, (NUM_PAIRS, 2)))
+    rope_pair = tl.arange(0, NUM_PAIRS) - NOPE_PAIRS
+    is_rope_pair = rope_pair >= 0
+    cs_idx = tl.maximum(rope_pair, 0)
+    compressed_pos = (position // COMPRESS_RATIO) * COMPRESS_RATIO
+    cache_base = cos_sin_cache_ptr + compressed_pos * cos_sin_stride
+    cos_v = tl.load(cache_base + cs_idx, mask=is_rope_pair, other=1.0)
+    sin_v = tl.load(cache_base + HALF_ROPE + cs_idx, mask=is_rope_pair, other=0.0)
+    new_even = (even * cos_v - odd * sin_v).to(tl.bfloat16).to(tl.float32)
+    new_odd = (odd * cos_v + even * sin_v).to(tl.bfloat16).to(tl.float32)
+
+    # MXFP4 values, then one UE8M0 scale per 32 values, in the paged block.
+    kv_block_idx = kv_slot_idx // kv_cache_block_size
+    kv_pos_in_block = kv_slot_idx % kv_cache_block_size
+    cache_block_ptr = k_cache_ptr + kv_block_idx.to(tl.int64) * KV_BLOCK_STRIDE
+    val_ptr = cache_block_ptr + kv_pos_in_block * TOKEN_STRIDE
+    scale_ptr = (
+        cache_block_ptr
+        + kv_cache_block_size * TOKEN_STRIDE
+        + kv_pos_in_block * SCALE_DIM
+    )
+    N_QUANT_BLOCKS: tl.constexpr = HEAD_SIZE // 32
+    even_2d = tl.reshape(new_even, (N_QUANT_BLOCKS, 16))
+    odd_2d = tl.reshape(new_odd, (N_QUANT_BLOCKS, 16))
+    amax = tl.maximum(tl.max(tl.abs(even_2d), axis=1), tl.max(tl.abs(odd_2d), axis=1))
+    amax = tl.maximum(amax, 6.0 * (2**-126))
+    log2_ratio = tl.ceil(tl.log2(amax * (1.0 / 6.0)))
+    log2_ratio = tl.minimum(tl.maximum(log2_ratio, -127.0), 127.0)
+    inv_scale = tl.reshape(tl.exp2(-log2_ratio), (N_QUANT_BLOCKS, 1))
+    packed = _fp32x2_to_fp4x2(even_2d * inv_scale, odd_2d * inv_scale)
+    tl.store(val_ptr + tl.arange(0, TOKEN_STRIDE), tl.reshape(packed, (TOKEN_STRIDE,)))
+    tl.store(scale_ptr + tl.arange(0, SCALE_DIM), (log2_ratio + 127.0).to(tl.uint8))

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Low-batch MXFP8 attention projections.
+
+At up to ``LOW_BATCH_MAX_ROWS`` rows the executor runs ``fused_wqa_wkv``,
+``wq_b`` and ``wo_b`` on FlashInfer ``mm_mxfp8`` with its
+``cutedsl_low_latency`` backend whenever their input is already MXFP8; the
+stock layers keep ``cute-dsl``. Both backends read the same weights, weight
+scales and F8_128x4 activation scales.
+
+The backend's tactics differ by under 1 us when tuned in isolation, but split-K
+tactics are slower inside the back-to-back PDL chain of a decode step, so the
+5-8-row bucket of the GB300 TP4 shapes is tuned over one pinned tactic.
+"""
+
+import importlib
+from collections.abc import Callable, Iterable, Iterator
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from functools import cache
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.mxfp8.flashinfer import (
+    FlashInferCutedslMxfp8LinearKernel,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fusion.quant_activation import (
+    QuantizedActivation,
+    as_quantized_activation,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.quant_utils import kMxfp8Dynamic
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.common.ops.query_quant import mxfp8_scale_bytes
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.utils import flashinfer as vllm_flashinfer
+
+from .. import LOW_BATCH_MAX_ROWS, uses_checked_flashinfer
+
+BACKEND = "cutedsl_low_latency"
+
+# (cta_k, ab_stages, sfb_tmem_stages, split_k) per (N, K) on GB300 for 5-8
+# rows, chosen jointly for the chain of the three projections.
+Tactic = tuple[int, int, int, int]
+PINNED_TACTICS: dict[tuple[int, int], Tactic] = {
+    (1792, 5120): (128, 10, 1, 4),
+    (8192, 1280): (256, 6, 1, 1),
+    (5120, 2048): (256, 4, 1, 2),
+}
+_PINNED_MIN_ROWS = LOW_BATCH_MAX_ROWS // 2 + 1
+
+
+def mxfp8_mm(layer: nn.Module, qa: QuantizedActivation) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``layer``'s GEMM on ``cutedsl_low_latency``."""
+    out = vllm_flashinfer.mm_mxfp8(
+        qa.data,
+        layer.weight,
+        qa.scale,
+        layer.weight_scale,
+        out_dtype=qa.orig_dtype,
+        backend=BACKEND,
+    )
+    return out.view(*qa.orig_shape[:-1], out.shape[-1])
+
+
+@cache
+def _backend_supported() -> bool:
+    capability = current_platform.get_device_capability()
+    try:
+        from flashinfer import mm_mxfp8
+
+        return capability is not None and bool(
+            mm_mxfp8.is_backend_supported(BACKEND, capability.to_int())
+        )
+    except (AttributeError, ImportError, RuntimeError, TypeError, ValueError):
+        return False
+
+
+def _mxfp8_kernel(layer: nn.Module) -> FlashInferCutedslMxfp8LinearKernel | None:
+    """``layer``'s kernel when it is exactly the ``cute-dsl`` MXFP8 one."""
+    method = getattr(layer, "scheme", getattr(layer, "quant_method", None))
+    kernel = getattr(method, "kernel", None)
+    return kernel if type(kernel) is FlashInferCutedslMxfp8LinearKernel else None
+
+
+def mxfp8_eligible(layer: nn.Module) -> bool:
+    """Whether ``layer`` is a ``cute-dsl`` MXFP8 linear whose weights the
+    low-latency backend also takes."""
+    kernel = _mxfp8_kernel(layer)
+    return (
+        kernel is not None
+        and kernel.config.weight_shape[1] % 128 == 0
+        and getattr(layer, "bias", None) is None
+        and _backend_supported()
+    )
+
+
+def low_latency_mm(
+    layer: nn.Module, x: torch.Tensor | QuantizedActivation
+) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+    """``layer``'s GEMM of ``x`` on ``cutedsl_low_latency`` for an eligible
+    layer, or None when ``x`` is not an MXFP8 input of the backend's layout."""
+    kernel = _mxfp8_kernel(layer)
+    assert kernel is not None
+    qa = as_quantized_activation(x, kernel.input_quant_key())
+    if qa is None or qa.scale.ndim != 1 or not qa.data.is_contiguous():
+        return None
+    return mxfp8_mm(layer, qa)
+
+
+def shape_representatives(linears: Iterable[nn.Module]) -> list[nn.Module]:
+    """One eligible linear per distinct (N, K), in a rank-independent order."""
+    by_shape: dict[tuple[int, int], nn.Module] = {}
+    for linear in linears:
+        kernel = _mxfp8_kernel(linear)
+        if kernel is not None and mxfp8_eligible(linear):
+            by_shape.setdefault(kernel.config.weight_shape, linear)
+    return [by_shape[shape] for shape in sorted(by_shape)]
+
+
+def run_zeros(linear: nn.Module, rows: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Call ``linear`` on an input laid out like the fused quantize producers'."""
+    k = linear.weight.shape[0]  # column-major [K, N]
+    device = linear.weight.device
+    shape = torch.Size((rows, k))
+    qa = QuantizedActivation(
+        torch.zeros(shape, dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn, device=device),
+        torch.zeros(mxfp8_scale_bytes(rows, k), dtype=torch.uint8, device=device),
+        torch.bfloat16,
+        shape,
+        kMxfp8Dynamic,
+    )
+    return mxfp8_mm(linear, qa)
+
+
+@contextmanager
+def pinned_tactics() -> Iterator[None]:
+    """Offer FlashInfer's tuner only the pinned tactic for pinned problems. The
+    tuner's tactic list is a FlashInfer internal: off the checked version,
+    every tactic is tuned."""
+    if not (

+    ):
+        yield
+        return

+        "flashinfer.gemm.kernels.cute_dsl.low_latency_blockscaled_gemm"
+    )
+    original: Callable[..., list[Tactic]] | None = getattr(
+        module, "autotune_tactics", None
+    )
+    if original is None:
+        yield
+        return
+    enumerate_tactics = original
+
+    def autotune_tactics(
+        problem_sizes_mnkl: tuple[int, int, int, int], *args: object, **kwargs: object

+            return [pinned]

+
+    module.autotune_tactics = autotune_tactics  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    try:

+    finally:

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The FlashInfer sparse-MLA decode of a specialized decode step.
+
+It is the decode branch of ``DeepseekV4FlashInferMLAAttention.forward_mqa``
+with two changes, neither of which issues a collective:
+
+- Shared sparse-index tables (``SparseIndexTables``). Compressed layers that
+  share an index source build equal tables in a step, so the first of them
+  builds the table and the others reuse it; the first layer of such a run also
+  builds, on a side stream, the tables its later layers look up in other SWA
+  KV-cache groups.
+- Persistent multi-CTA KV counters. Without a caller-owned counter buffer,
+  ``trtllm_batch_decode_sparse_mla_dsv4`` allocates and zeroes a fresh one
+  before every call, a small fill kernel ahead of each decode launch. The
+  kernel returns every counter to zero when it finishes, so a buffer zeroed
+  once stays valid for launches that do not overlap, as in the FlashInfer MLA
+  backend.
+"""
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, cast
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.sparse_mla import DeepseekV4FlashMLAMetadata
+from vllm.utils.flashinfer import flashinfer_trtllm_batch_decode_sparse_mla_dsv4
+
+from ...flashinfer_sparse import (
+    DeepseekV4FlashInferMLAAttention,
+    _get_flashinfer_dsv4_workspace,
+)
+from .. import uses_checked_flashinfer
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.sparse_swa import DeepseekSparseSWAMetadata
+
+# (sparse_indices, sparse_topk_lens) of one step, SWA group and key.
+SparseIndexTable = tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]
+
+_kv_counters_by_device: dict[torch.device, torch.Tensor] = {}
+
+
+def kv_counter_buffer(max_rows: int) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+    """Zeroed multi-CTA KV counters on the current device for decode launches
+    of up to ``max_rows`` rows (requests x heads), or None off the checked
+    FlashInfer version.
+
+    Allocated when the executor is built, outside any CUDA graph capture. Every
+    layer shares the buffer, as it shares the workspace: their decode launches
+    run one after another on one stream. Decode launches that overlap on one
+    device would race on it.
+    """
+    if not uses_checked_flashinfer("the sparse-MLA decode's persistent KV counters"):
+        return None
+    from flashinfer.utils import (
+        get_device_sm_count,
+        get_trtllm_gen_multi_ctas_kv_counter_bytes,
+    )
+
+    device = torch.device("cuda", torch.accelerator.current_device_index())
+    nbytes = get_trtllm_gen_multi_ctas_kv_counter_bytes(
+        max_rows, 1, get_device_sm_count(device)
+    )
+    counters = _kv_counters_by_device.get(device)
+    if counters is None or counters.nbytes < nbytes:
+        counters = torch.zeros(nbytes, dtype=torch.uint8, device=device)
+        _kv_counters_by_device[device] = counters
+    return counters
+
+
+def trtllm_decode_sparse_mla_dsv4(
+    *,
+    query: torch.Tensor,
+    swa_kv_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    compressed_kv_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    workspace_buffer: torch.Tensor,
+    sparse_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    sparse_topk_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    seq_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    out: torch.Tensor,
+    bmm1_scale: float | torch.Tensor,
+    bmm2_scale: float | torch.Tensor,
+    sinks: torch.Tensor | None,
+    cum_seq_lens_q: torch.Tensor | None,
+    max_q_len: int,
+    kv_counters: torch.Tensor | None,
+) -> None:
+    """``trtllm_batch_decode_sparse_mla_dsv4`` for ``sparse_indices`` that are
+    KV storage offsets, on ``kv_counters`` (from ``kv_counter_buffer``) when
+    they are large enough for the launch."""
+    counter_kwargs: dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {}
+    if kv_counters is not None:
+        from flashinfer.utils import (
+            get_device_sm_count,
+            get_trtllm_gen_multi_ctas_kv_counter_bytes,
+        )
+
+        if kv_counters.nbytes >= get_trtllm_gen_multi_ctas_kv_counter_bytes(
+            seq_lens.size(0), query.size(-2), get_device_sm_count(query.device)
+        ):
+            counter_kwargs["multi_ctas_kv_counter_buffer"] = kv_counters
+    flashinfer_trtllm_batch_decode_sparse_mla_dsv4(
+        query=query,
+        swa_kv_cache=swa_kv_cache,
+        workspace_buffer=workspace_buffer,
+        sparse_indices=sparse_indices,
+        sparse_indices_are_storage_offsets=True,
+        compressed_kv_cache=compressed_kv_cache,
+        sparse_topk_lens=sparse_topk_lens,
+        seq_lens=seq_lens,
+        out=out,
+        bmm1_scale=bmm1_scale,
+        bmm2_scale=bmm2_scale,
+        sinks=sinks,
+        cum_seq_lens_q=cum_seq_lens_q,
+        max_q_len=max_q_len,
+        **counter_kwargs,
+    )
+
+
+def sparse_index_key(attn: DeepseekV4FlashInferMLAAttention) -> str:
+    """Layers with equal keys build equal sparse-index tables in a step: a
+    compressed layer's table depends on its compressed cache, compress ratio
+    and top-k indices, which only its index source writes."""
+    if attn.compress_ratio == 0:
+        return "swa_only"
+    return (
+        f"{attn.compressed_cache_prefix}:{attn.index_source_layer_id}:"
+        f"{attn.compress_ratio}"
+    )
+
+
+class SparseIndexTables:
+    """The sparse-index tables of one decode step, shared by equal keys.
+
+    Each SWA KV-cache group has its own metadata, and the layers of a run of
+    equal keys interleave the groups: each group would build each key's table
+    on the critical path. A table depends only on the step's metadata, the
+    group's SWA indices and block table and, for compressed layers, the index
+    source's top-k indices; not on any layer's KV write. So the first layer of
+    a run builds its own group's table through the stock
+    ``_build_sparse_index_metadata`` and then forks, onto ``stream``, the
+    builds that later layers of the run look up in other groups:
+
+    * ``lookup`` returns a layer's table, building and forking on a miss and
+      making the current stream wait for a table built on ``stream``.
+    * ``join`` makes the current stream wait for everything ``stream`` ran.
+      Index sources call it before their indexer overwrites the top-k indices,
+      and the executor at the end of its step, so a CUDA graph capture ends
+      joined.
+
+    Events are reused across forks: a wait on an event that a later fork
+    re-recorded waits for more work on the same in-order stream, never less.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, attns: list[DeepseekV4FlashInferMLAAttention]) -> None:
+        self.keys = {attn: sparse_index_key(attn) for attn in attns}
+        runs: list[list[DeepseekV4FlashInferMLAAttention]] = []
+        previous: str | None = None
+        for attn in attns:
+            key = self.keys[attn]
+            if key == previous:
+                runs[-1].append(attn)
+            else:
+                runs.append([attn])
+            previous = key
+        self.followers = {
+            attn: tuple(run[i + 1 :]) for run in runs for i, attn in enumerate(run)
+        }
+        self.stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
+        self._events = [
+            torch.cuda.Event() for _ in range(max(map(len, runs), default=1) - 1)
+        ]
+        self._tables: dict[tuple[int, str], SparseIndexTable] = {}
+        self._pending: dict[tuple[int, str], torch.cuda.Event] = {}
+        self._forked = False
+
+    def reset(self) -> None:
+        """Forget the previous step's tables."""
+        self._tables.clear()
+        self._pending.clear()
+        self._forked = False
+
+    def lookup(
+        self,
+        attn: DeepseekV4FlashInferMLAAttention,
+        kv_cache: torch.Tensor | None,
+        swa_k_cache: torch.Tensor,
+        swa_metadata: "DeepseekSparseSWAMetadata",
+        attn_metadata: DeepseekV4FlashMLAMetadata | None,
+        swa_only: bool,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """``attn._build_sparse_index_metadata``, on the step's shared tables."""
+        key = self.keys[attn]
+        table = self._tables.get((id(swa_metadata), key))
+        if table is None:
+            compressed_kv_cache, seq_lens, indices, lens = (
+                attn._build_sparse_index_metadata(
+                    kv_cache, swa_k_cache, swa_metadata, attn_metadata, swa_only
+                )
+            )
+            self._store(swa_metadata, key, (indices, lens))
+            self._fork(attn, key, kv_cache, swa_metadata, attn_metadata, swa_only)
+            return compressed_kv_cache, seq_lens, indices, lens
+        event = self._pending.get((id(swa_metadata), key))
+        if event is not None:
+            torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_event(event)
+        assert swa_metadata.seq_lens is not None
+        num_reqs = swa_metadata.num_decodes + swa_metadata.num_prefills
+        compressed_kv_cache = swa_k_cache if swa_only else kv_cache
+        assert compressed_kv_cache is not None
+        return compressed_kv_cache, swa_metadata.seq_lens[:num_reqs], *table
+
+    def join(self) -> None:
+        """Make the current stream wait for every build since the last join."""
+        if self._forked:
+            torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(self.stream)
+            self._forked = False
+            self._pending.clear()
+
+    def _store(
+        self,
+        swa_metadata: "DeepseekSparseSWAMetadata",
+        key: str,
+        table: SparseIndexTable,
+    ) -> None:
+        group = id(swa_metadata)
+        if key != "swa_only":
+            # Runs of a key are consecutive, so a new key ends the group's
+            # previous one; drop its table to bound memory.
+            for old in [k for k in self._tables if k[0] == group and k[1] != key]:
+                if old[1] != "swa_only":
+                    del self._tables[old]
+        self._tables[(group, key)] = table
+
+    def _fork(
+        self,
+        attn: DeepseekV4FlashInferMLAAttention,
+        key: str,
+        kv_cache: torch.Tensor | None,
+        swa_metadata: "DeepseekSparseSWAMetadata",
+        attn_metadata: DeepseekV4FlashMLAMetadata | None,
+        swa_only: bool,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Build, on ``stream``, the tables of the other KV-cache groups whose
+        later layers of the run look ``key`` up: for each group, the build its
+        first such layer would run on a miss. The key fixes the compressed
+        cache and its metadata, so these are ``attn``'s."""
+        by_layer = get_forward_context().attn_metadata
+        assert isinstance(by_layer, dict)
+        builds: list[
+            tuple[DeepseekV4FlashInferMLAAttention, DeepseekSparseSWAMetadata]
+        ] = []
+        seen = {id(swa_metadata)}
+        for follower in self.followers[attn]:
+            metadata = cast(
+                "DeepseekSparseSWAMetadata | None",
+                by_layer.get(follower.swa_cache_layer.prefix),
+            )
+            if metadata is None or id(metadata) in seen:
+                continue
+            seen.add(id(metadata))
+            if (id(metadata), key) not in self._tables:
+                builds.append((follower, metadata))
+        if not builds:
+            return
+        main = torch.cuda.current_stream()
+        self.stream.wait_stream(main)
+        self._forked = True
+        try:
+            with torch.cuda.stream(self.stream):
+                for event, (follower, metadata) in zip(self._events, builds):
+                    *_, indices, lens = follower._build_sparse_index_metadata(
+                        kv_cache,
+                        follower.swa_cache_layer.kv_cache,
+                        metadata,
+                        attn_metadata,
+                        swa_only,
+                    )
+                    event.record(self.stream)
+                    indices.record_stream(main)
+                    lens.record_stream(main)
+                    self._store(metadata, key, (indices, lens))
+                    self._pending[(id(metadata), key)] = event
+        except BaseException:
+            # Rejoin so that a capture reports this error, not unjoined work.
+            self.join()
+            raise
+
+
+class SparseMlaDecode:
+    """``forward_mqa`` of a pure-decode step on the shared tables and the
+    persistent KV counters."""
+
+    def __init__(self, tables: SparseIndexTables, max_rows: int) -> None:
+        self.tables = tables
+        self.kv_counters = kv_counter_buffer(max_rows)
+
+    def run(
+        self, attn: DeepseekV4FlashInferMLAAttention, q: torch.Tensor, out: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> None:
+        """Write ``attn``'s sparse MLA of ``q`` into ``out``."""
+        assert attn.kv_cache_torch_dtype in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+        by_layer = get_forward_context().attn_metadata
+        assert isinstance(by_layer, dict)
+        attn_metadata = cast(
+            DeepseekV4FlashMLAMetadata | None,
+            by_layer.get(attn.compressed_cache_prefix)
+            if attn.compressed_cache_prefix is not None
+            else None,
+        )
+        swa_metadata = cast(
+            "DeepseekSparseSWAMetadata", by_layer[attn.swa_cache_layer.prefix]
+        )
+        assert swa_metadata.num_prefills == 0
+        num_decodes = swa_metadata.num_decodes
+        num_tokens = swa_metadata.num_decode_tokens
+        if num_tokens == 0:
+            return
+        swa_only = attn.compress_ratio == 0
+        swa_k_cache = attn.swa_cache_layer.kv_cache
+        compressed_kv_cache, seq_lens, sparse_indices, sparse_topk_lens = (
+            self.tables.lookup(
+                attn,
+                None if swa_only else attn._compressed_kv_cache(),
+                swa_k_cache,
+                swa_metadata,
+                attn_metadata,
+                swa_only,
+            )
+        )
+
+        # CUDA graph execution can pad q/out past the scheduled token count.
+        query = q[:num_tokens]
+        output = out[:num_tokens]
+        bmm1_scale: float | torch.Tensor = attn.scale
+        bmm2_scale: float | torch.Tensor = 1.0
+        if attn.kv_cache_torch_dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn:
+            assert query.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn
+            bmm1_scale = attn._flashinfer_fp8_bmm1_scale
+            bmm2_scale = attn._flashinfer_fp8_bmm2_scale
+        else:
+            assert query.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            query = query.contiguous()
+        # TRTLLM-gen requires h_q in {64, 128}: zero-pad the query heads.
+        padded_heads = output.shape[1]
+        if query.shape[1] < padded_heads:
+            padded_query = query.new_zeros(
+                (query.shape[0], padded_heads, query.shape[2])
+            )
+            padded_query[:, : query.shape[1], :] = query
+            query = padded_query
+
+        query_start_loc = swa_metadata.query_start_loc
+        assert query_start_loc is not None
+        decode_cu: torch.Tensor | None = query_start_loc[: num_decodes + 1]
+        decode_seq_lens = seq_lens[:num_decodes]
+        decode_topk_lens = sparse_topk_lens[:num_tokens]
+        max_decode_query_len = swa_metadata.max_decode_query_len
+        if swa_metadata.decode_swa_width > attn.window_size:
+            # DSpark's non-causal window, as in the stock decode.
+            assert swa_only
+            assert swa_metadata.flashinfer_decode_topk_lens is not None
+            assert swa_metadata.flashinfer_decode_seq_lens is not None
+            decode_topk_lens = swa_metadata.flashinfer_decode_topk_lens
+            decode_seq_lens = swa_metadata.flashinfer_decode_seq_lens
+            query = query.unsqueeze(1)
+            output = output.unsqueeze(1)
+            decode_cu = None
+            max_decode_query_len = 1
+        trtllm_decode_sparse_mla_dsv4(
+            query=query,
+            swa_kv_cache=swa_k_cache,
+            compressed_kv_cache=compressed_kv_cache,
+            workspace_buffer=_get_flashinfer_dsv4_workspace(q.device),
+            sparse_indices=sparse_indices[:num_tokens],
+            sparse_topk_lens=decode_topk_lens,
+            seq_lens=decode_seq_lens,
+            out=output,
+            bmm1_scale=bmm1_scale,
+            bmm2_scale=bmm2_scale,
+            sinks=attn.attn_sink,
+            cum_seq_lens_q=decode_cu,
+            max_q_len=max_decode_query_len,
+            kv_counters=self.kv_counters,
+        )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The attention of a specialized decode step.
+
+``AttentionStep`` runs one ``DeepseekV4FlashInferMLAAttention`` layer through
+the layer's own modules and kernels, in a different schedule and with
+low-batch kernels where they apply:
+
+- ``fused_wqa_wkv`` reads the MXFP8 layer input the fused all-reduce + mHC
+  wrote instead of quantizing it again; up to ``LOW_BATCH_MAX_ROWS`` rows it,
+  ``wq_b`` and ``wo_b`` run on the low-latency MXFP8 GEMM (``mxfp8``).
+- The side projections (compressor ``kv_score``, indexer weights) join their
+  side streams at their first reader rather than before the query path, and
+  the indexer inputs are built on side streams: the indexer query once ``qr``
+  is ready and the index key right after the compressor.
+- Up to ``LOW_BATCH_MAX_ROWS`` rows, the side projections and the index key's
+  ``wk`` run on ``ll_bf16`` kernels (``aux_projections``), the key store reads
+  ``wk``'s FP32 output, and ``wo_b`` publishes its output into the mailbox of
+  the fused all-reduce that reduces it next (``boundary.publishing_gemm``).
+- Dense indexers row-shard their decode rows (``indexer.decode_rows``); the
+  candidate source starts the candidate consumers' expansion on a side stream
+  right after its indexer, and index sources first join the side-stream
+  sparse-index builds, which read the top-k indices they overwrite.
+- The sparse MLA reuses the step's sparse-index tables and runs on persistent
+  KV counters (``sparse_mla``).
+"""
+
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, cast
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fusion.quant_activation import QuantizedActivation
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.sparse_attn_indexer import SparseAttnIndexer
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.attention import DeepseekV4Indexer
+
+from ...flashinfer_sparse import DeepseekV4FlashInferMLAAttention
+from ...ops.o_proj import dsv41_o_proj
+from .aux_projections import aux_projection_gemm, aux_projection_gemm_accepts
+from .indexer import CandidateOverlap, decode_rows, rope_quant_q
+from .indexer_k_store import indexer_k_norm_rope_store_fp32
+from .mxfp8 import low_latency_mm, mxfp8_eligible
+from .sparse_mla import SparseIndexTables, SparseMlaDecode
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from ..boundary.publishing_gemm import PublishingMxfp8Linear
+    from ..runtime.decode import DecodeStep
+
+
+def side_weights(attn: DeepseekV4FlashInferMLAAttention) -> list[torch.Tensor]:
+    """The weights of ``attn``'s side projections."""
+    weights = []
+    if attn.compressor is not None:
+        weights.append(attn.compressor.fused_wkv_wgate.weight)
+    if attn.indexer is not None:
+        weights.append(attn.indexer.weights_proj.weight)
+    return weights
+
+
+def key_weight(attn: DeepseekV4FlashInferMLAAttention) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+    """``wk`` of ``attn``'s indexer when it produces MXFP4 index keys."""
+    indexer = attn.indexer
+    if indexer is not None and indexer.owns_k and indexer.use_fp4_kv:
+        return indexer.wk.weight
+    return None
+
+
+class AttentionStep:
+    """One attention layer of the decode step."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        attn: DeepseekV4FlashInferMLAAttention,
+        tables: SparseIndexTables,
+        mla: SparseMlaDecode,
+        publisher: "PublishingMxfp8Linear | None",
+        mxfp8_input: bool,
+        source: CandidateOverlap | None,
+        consumer: CandidateOverlap | None,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.attn = attn
+        self.tables = tables
+        self.mla = mla
+        self.publisher = (
+            publisher
+            if publisher is not None and publisher.supports(attn.wo_b, 1)
+            else None
+        )
+        # The boundary before this layer writes its input as MXFP8 too.
+        self.mxfp8_input = mxfp8_input
+        # The candidate expansion this layer forks after its indexer, or joins
+        # before it.
+        self.source = source
+        self.consumer = consumer
+        self.wqa_mxfp8 = mxfp8_eligible(attn.fused_wqa_wkv)
+        self.wq_b_mxfp8 = mxfp8_eligible(attn.wq_b)
+        self.wo_b_mxfp8 = mxfp8_eligible(attn.wo_b)
+        self.aux_gemm = aux_projection_gemm_accepts(side_weights(attn))
+        wk = key_weight(attn)
+        self.key_gemm = wk is not None and aux_projection_gemm_accepts([wk])
+        # start, latent ready, index key done, index query done.
+        self._events = [torch.cuda.Event() for _ in range(4)]
+
+    def run(
+        self,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        quant: QuantizedActivation | None,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        step: "DecodeStep",
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """The layer's TP-partial output for input ``x`` (``quant``: the same
+        input as MXFP8), published when ``wo_b`` publishes."""
+        attn = self.attn
+        out = attn._alloc_attn_out(x.shape[0], x)
+        assert isinstance(out, torch.Tensor)
+        qr_kv, kv_score, indexer_weights = self._input_projections(x, quant, step)
+        qr, qr_scale, kv = attn._split_qkv_and_norm(qr_kv)
+        q, index_q, index_q_scale, index_weights = self._prepare(
+            qr, kv, qr_scale, kv_score, indexer_weights, positions, step
+        )
+        indexer = attn.indexer
+        if indexer is not None and index_q is not None:
+            assert index_weights is not None
+            self._indexer(indexer, x, index_q, index_q_scale, index_weights, step)
+        self.mla.run(attn, q, out)
+        if step.low_batch and (self.publisher is not None or self.wo_b_mxfp8):
+            return dsv41_o_proj(attn, out, positions, wo_b_proj=self._wo_b_low_batch)
+        return attn._o_proj(out, positions)
+
+    def _input_projections(
+        self,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        quant: QuantizedActivation | None,
+        step: "DecodeStep",
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None, torch.Tensor | None]:
+        """``_run_parallel_input_projections``, with the side projections left
+        unjoined on aux streams 0 and 1; ``_prepare`` joins each at its first
+        reader."""
+        attn = self.attn
+        aux_gemm = self.aux_gemm and step.low_batch
+        aux_fns: list[Callable[[], torch.Tensor] | None] = [None, None]
+        if attn.compressor is not None:
+            kv_weight = attn.compressor.fused_wkv_wgate.weight
+            if aux_gemm:
+                aux_fns[0] = lambda: aux_projection_gemm(x, kv_weight)
+            else:
+                aux_fns[0] = lambda: torch.mm(x, kv_weight.T, out_dtype=torch.float32)
+        if attn.indexer is not None:
+            weights_proj = attn.indexer.weights_proj
+            if aux_gemm:
+                aux_fns[1] = lambda: aux_projection_gemm(x, weights_proj.weight).to(
+                    weights_proj.weight.dtype
+                )
+            else:
+                aux_fns[1] = lambda: weights_proj(x)[0]
+
+        streams = attn.aux_stream_list if step.overlap_inputs else None
+        start = attn.ln_events[0]
+        start.record()
+        results: list[torch.Tensor | None] = [None, None]
+        for i, fn in enumerate(aux_fns):
+            if fn is None:
+                continue
+            if streams is None:
+                results[i] = fn()
+                attn.ln_events[1 + i].record()
+                continue
+            with torch.cuda.stream(streams[i]):
+                start.wait()
+                results[i] = fn()
+                attn.ln_events[1 + i].record()
+
+        if quant is None:
+            qr_kv = attn._fused_wqa_wkv_gemm(x)
+        else:
+            qr_kv = None
+            if step.low_batch and self.wqa_mxfp8:
+                qr_kv = low_latency_mm(attn.fused_wqa_wkv, quant)
+            if qr_kv is None:
+                qr_kv = attn.fused_wqa_wkv(quant)[0]
+        return qr_kv, results[0], results[1]
+
+    def _prepare(
+        self,
+        qr: torch.Tensor | QuantizedActivation,
+        kv: torch.Tensor,
+        qr_scale: torch.Tensor | None,
+        kv_score: torch.Tensor | None,
+        indexer_weights: torch.Tensor | None,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        step: "DecodeStep",
+    ) -> tuple[
+        torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None, torch.Tensor | None, torch.Tensor | None
+    ]:
+        """``_prepare_and_attn`` up to the indexer, with the indexer inputs on
+        side streams.
+
+        From the moment ``qr`` is ready, aux stream 2 runs the indexer query
+        (``wq_b``, then RoPE/quantize once the weights GEMM is done) and aux
+        stream 0, after its ``kv_score`` GEMM, the compressor and the index
+        key; the current stream runs the main query and KV insertion, then the
+        compressed-cache insertion once the latent is ready. Returns the query
+        and the indexer query, its scale and weights.
+        """
+        attn = self.attn
+        indexer, compressor = attn.indexer, attn.compressor
+        streams = attn.aux_stream_list
+        assert streams is not None
+        start, latent_ready, index_k_done, index_q_done = self._events
+        start.record()
+        index_q: torch.Tensor | None = None
+        index_q_scale: torch.Tensor | None = None
+        index_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None
+        if indexer is not None:
+            assert indexer_weights is not None
+            with torch.cuda.stream(streams[2]):
+                start.wait()
+                index_q_pre = indexer._wq_b_proj(qr, qr_scale)
+                attn.ln_events[2].wait()
+                index_q, index_q_scale, index_weights = rope_quant_q(
+                    indexer,
+                    index_q_pre,
+                    indexer_weights,
+                    positions,
+                    attn.indexer_rotary_emb,
+                )
+                index_q_done.record()
+        latent = None
+        if compressor is not None:
+            assert kv_score is not None
+            # After the kv_score GEMM, which ran on this stream.
+            with torch.cuda.stream(streams[0]):
+                start.wait()
+                latent = compressor(kv_score, positions)
+                latent_ready.record()
+                if indexer is not None and indexer.owns_k:
+                    self._produce_k(indexer, latent, positions, step)
+                index_k_done.record()
+
+        q = None
+        if step.low_batch and self.wq_b_mxfp8:
+            q = low_latency_mm(attn.wq_b, qr)
+        if q is None:
+            q = attn._wq_b_proj(qr, qr_scale)
+        q = q.view(-1, attn.n_local_heads, attn.head_dim)
+        q = attn._fused_qnorm_rope_kv_insert(
+            q, kv, positions, get_forward_context().attn_metadata
+        )
+        if compressor is not None:
+            latent_ready.wait()
+            compressor.insert_cache(latent, positions, attn.rotary_emb)
+            index_k_done.wait()
+        if indexer is not None:
+            index_q_done.wait()
+        return q, index_q, index_q_scale, index_weights
+
+    def _produce_k(
+        self,
+        indexer: DeepseekV4Indexer,
+        latent: torch.Tensor | None,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        step: "DecodeStep",
+    ) -> None:
+        """``indexer._produce_k``; up to ``LOW_BATCH_MAX_ROWS`` rows, ``wk`` on
+        ``ll_bf16`` and the FP32 key store."""
+        rotary_emb = self.attn.indexer_rotary_emb
+        attn_metadata = get_forward_context().attn_metadata
+        if (
+            not self.key_gemm
+            or not step.low_batch
+            or latent is None
+            or not isinstance(attn_metadata, dict)
+            or latent.dtype != torch.bfloat16
+            or not latent.is_contiguous()
+        ):
+            indexer._produce_k(latent, positions, rotary_emb)
+            return
+        indexer_metadata = cast(Any, attn_metadata[indexer.k_cache.prefix])
+        indexer_k_norm_rope_store_fp32(
+            aux_projection_gemm(latent, indexer.wk.weight),
+            positions,
+            rotary_emb.cos_sin_cache,
+            indexer.k_norm.weight,
+            indexer.k_norm.variance_epsilon,
+            indexer.k_cache.kv_cache,
+            indexer_metadata.slot_mapping,
+            indexer.compress_ratio,
+        )
+
+    def _indexer(
+        self,
+        indexer: DeepseekV4Indexer,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        index_q: torch.Tensor,
+        index_q_scale: torch.Tensor | None,
+        index_weights: torch.Tensor,
+        step: "DecodeStep",
+    ) -> None:
+        """The layer's indexer: the top-k indices (and in the candidate
+        source, the candidate blocks) of the step."""
+        # The side-stream table builds read the top-k indices this overwrites.
+        self.tables.join()
+        q_quant = (index_q, index_q_scale) if index_q_scale is not None else index_q
+        op = indexer.indexer_op
+        if isinstance(op, SparseAttnIndexer):
+            decode_rows(op, x, q_quant, index_weights)
+        else:
+            if self.consumer is not None:
+                self.consumer.join()
+            op(x, q_quant, None, index_weights)
+        if self.source is not None and step.overlap_candidates and self.source.warmed:
+            self.source.fork()
+
+    def _wo_b_low_batch(self, z: torch.Tensor | QuantizedActivation) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """``wo_b`` up to ``LOW_BATCH_MAX_ROWS`` rows: published, or on the
+        low-latency MXFP8 GEMM."""
+        wo_b = self.attn.wo_b
+        if self.publisher is not None:
+            return self.publisher(wo_b, z)
+        out = low_latency_mm(wo_b, z) if self.wo_b_mxfp8 else None
+        return out if out is not None else self.attn._wo_b_proj(z)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The specialized decode's fused all-reduce + mHC kernel and its publish
+bookkeeping."""
+
+import torch
+from transformers import PreTrainedConfig
+
+from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+from ...ops.cute_dsl import AllReduceMHC
+from .. import FUSED_MHC_MAX_ROWS
+
+
+class BoundaryAllReduce(AllReduceMHC):
+    """``AllReduceMHC`` sized for every FULL decode graph of the executor, with
+    the residual-only variant and, optionally, the MXFP8 layer input.
+
+    A producer that stores its contribution into the mailbox itself (the
+    publishing ``wo_b`` GEMM) calls ``mark_published``; the next ``__call__``
+    with that tensor then launches only the consumer.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, config: PreTrainedConfig, quantize_layer_input: bool) -> None:
+        super().__init__(
+            hidden_size=config.hidden_size,
+            hc_mult=config.hc_mult,
+            max_num_tokens=FUSED_MHC_MAX_ROWS,
+            top_k=config.num_experts_per_tok,
+            device=current_platform.current_device(),
+            quantize_layer_input=quantize_layer_input,
+            residual_only=True,
+        )
+        group = get_tp_group()
+        self.tp = group.world_size
+        self.rank = group.rank_in_group
+        self._published: torch.Tensor | None = None
+
+    def publish_target(self) -> tuple[int, int]:
+        """(multicast mailbox address, stage-state address) for a producer
+        that stores its contribution itself, as ``_SharedOnlyPublishDeviceKernel``
+        does: generation ``stage_state[0]``, slot ``[rank][token]``, BF16 with
+        negative zero cleared, then ``stage_state[1] = stage_state[0]``. Both
+        stay valid for this instance's lifetime."""
+        return self._multicast, self._stage_state.data_ptr()
+
+    def mark_published(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+        """Record that ``x``'s kernel published it; ``__call__(x, ...)``, which
+        must come next, then launches only the consumer."""
+        if self._published is not None:
+            raise RuntimeError("a published contribution is still unreduced")
+        self._published = x
+
+    def reset(self) -> None:
+        """Drop a publish an aborted step left unreduced."""
+        self._published = None
+
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor,
+        post: torch.Tensor,
+        comb: torch.Tensor,
+        pre: torch.Tensor | None,
+        norm_weight: torch.Tensor | None,
+        norm_eps: float,
+        mxfp8_out: tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor] | None = None,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:
+        published, self._published = self._published, None
+        if published is None:
+            return super().__call__(
+                x, residual, post, comb, pre, norm_weight, norm_eps, mxfp8_out
+            )
+        if published is not x:
+            raise RuntimeError("reducing a tensor other than the published one")
+        m = x.shape[0]
+        self._check(m, residual, post, comb, pre)
+        return self._collect(
+            residual, post, comb, pre, norm_weight, norm_eps, m, mxfp8_out
+        )
+
+    def finalize(
+        self,
+        gemm2_permuted: torch.Tensor,
+        expert_weights: torch.Tensor,
+        expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx: torch.Tensor,
+        shared_output: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor,
+        post: torch.Tensor,
+        comb: torch.Tensor,
+        pre: torch.Tensor | None,
+        norm_weight: torch.Tensor | None,
+        norm_eps: float,
+        mxfp8_out: tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor] | None = None,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:
+        if self._published is not None:
+            raise RuntimeError("a published contribution is still unreduced")
+        return super().finalize(
+            gemm2_permuted,
+            expert_weights,
+            expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx,
+            shared_output,
+            residual,
+            post,
+            comb,
+            pre,
+            norm_weight,
+            norm_eps,
+            mxfp8_out,
+        )
