+"""Low-batch routed-expert GEMMs for DeepSeek-V4.1 decode (1-8 rows).
+
+At concurrency 1 with DSpark, every target MoE layer applies its routed experts
+to six rows (384 experts, top-6; at TP4 every rank holds all experts at
+intermediate 576, padded to 640). ``TrtLlmMxfp4ExpertsModular`` runs FlashInfer's
+TRT-LLM-gen routing kernel and two batched MXFP8 x MXFP4 GEMMs; at this size they
+stream the weights of about 22 experts per layer, so their cost is HBM time plus
+fixed per-kernel latency. This module computes the same values from the same
+tensors with CuTe DSL kernels sized for at most eight rows::
+
+    router logits ─► front ───────────────────────┐ (top-k, MXFP8 input, routing)
+    top-k ids, MXFP8 input ─► route ──────────────┤
+                                                  ▼
+                         GEMM1 ─► h (MXFP8) ─► GEMM2 ─► unweighted permuted rows
+                                                          │
+       UnfinalizedMoEOutput (fused all-reduce + mHC) ◄────┘
+
+* ``routed_expert_route_cute.py`` builds the expert-major, 8-row-tile
+  permutation and the per-tile record both GEMMs read, as FlashInfer's routing
+  kernel does with precomputed ids and an 8-token tile.
+* ``routed_expert_gemm_cute.py`` holds GEMM1 and GEMM2: persistent 128 x 8
+  ``tcgen05`` block-scaled tiles over the (weight tile, token tile) work items
+  of the record, with evict-first hints on the expert weights. GEMM1 skips the
+  zero padding tile of the 576-wide slice. Their numerics are those of the
+  TRT-LLM-gen ``t128x8`` tactics.
+* ``routed_expert_front_cute.py`` replaces the DSv4 top-k (Triton), the MXFP8
+  quantization of the routed input and the route kernel with one launch whose
+  outputs are bitwise those of the three; it is built for the target's 384
+  experts and top-6.
+
+The kernels read the tensors vLLM prepares for the TRT-LLM-gen MXFP4 backend:
+``w13`` [E, 1280, 2560] u8 (interleaved up/gate rows shuffled for 128-row
+epilogue tiles) with [E, 1280, 160] scales in the 128x4 layout, ``w2``
+[E, 5120, 320] u8 with [E, 5120, 20] scales, and the per-expert SwiGLU clamp.
+Each kernel is compiled once per device when the layers are bound (shapes,
+expert counts and the routing record are launch arguments) and launched on the
+current stream with programmatic dependent launch, so CUDA graphs capture
+them like any other kernel.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections import Counter
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from functools import cache
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+import torch
+from cutlass import Float32, Int32
+from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_fake_stream, make_ptr
+
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.moe_output import UnfinalizedMoEOutput
+
+from ...ops.cute_dsl.primitives import current_cu_stream
+from .routed_expert_front_cute import RoutedExpertFront
+from .routed_expert_gemm_cute import (
+    RoutedExpertGemm1,
+    RoutedExpertGemm2,
+    tile_scale_bytes,
+)
+from .routed_expert_route_cute import RoutedExpertRoute
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.config import FusedMoEQuantConfig
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.modular_kernel import (
+        FusedMoEPrepareAndFinalizeModular,
+    )
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+HIDDEN = 5120
+SLICE = 576
+PADDED = 640
+# The fused front is built for exactly the target layers' routing.
+EXPERTS = 384
+TOP_K = 6
+# The route kernel and the GEMMs take any multiple of 32 local experts up to
+# MAX_EXPERTS, and any top-k whose 8 rows fit the route kernel.
+MAX_EXPERTS = 384
+MAX_TOP_K = 8
+TILE = 8
+MAX_ROWS = 8
+
+
+def max_ctas(rows: int, top_k: int, experts: int) -> int:
+    """The most 8-row token tiles any routing of ``rows * top_k`` slots needs."""
+    slots = rows * top_k
+    filled = min(experts, slots)
+    return filled + (slots - filled) // TILE
+
+
+def cta_words(ctas: int) -> int:
+    """``ctas`` rounded up to a multiple of four (the record's table width)."""
+    return (ctas + 3) // 4 * 4
+
+
+def route_words(ctas: int) -> int:
+    """int32 length of the routing record for ``ctas`` token tiles."""
+    return 4 + 2 * cta_words(ctas) + TILE * ctas
+
+
+@dataclass
+class FrontConfig:
+    """The router's DSv4 top-k parameters the fused front applies."""
+
+    bias: torch.Tensor  # FP32 [384] score correction bias
+    bias_vl: torch.Tensor | None  # FP32 [384] image-token bias, None without
+    image_sentinel_lo: int  # first of the five image sentinel token ids
+    scale: float  # routed scaling factor of the normalized weights
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Routing:
+    """What GEMM1 and GEMM2 read, from ``route`` or ``front``."""
+
+    x_quant: torch.Tensor  # MXFP8 activations [rows, 5120]
+    x_scale: torch.Tensor  # their UE8M0 scales, linear layout
+    topk_ids: torch.Tensor  # int32 [rows, top_k]
+    topk_weights: torch.Tensor  # FP32 [rows, top_k]
+    permuted: torch.Tensor  # int32 [rows, top_k], slot -> permuted row
+    record: torch.Tensor  # int32 routing record (routed_expert_route_cute.py)
+    ctas: int  # token tiles the GEMMs' records allow for
+
+
+class RoutedExpertGemm:
+    """The route kernel (or fused front) and GEMM pair bound to one MoE
+    layer's TRT-LLM-gen MXFP4 experts (see the module docstring)."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        w13: torch.Tensor,
+        w13_scale: torch.Tensor,
+        w2: torch.Tensor,
+        w2_scale: torch.Tensor,
+        clamp: torch.Tensor,
+        top_k: int,
+        prepare_finalize: FusedMoEPrepareAndFinalizeModular,
+        quant_config: FusedMoEQuantConfig,
+    ):
+        check_weights(w13, w13_scale, w2, w2_scale, clamp, top_k)
+        self.experts = int(w13.size(0))
+        self.top_k = top_k
+        index = w13.device.index
+        self.device_index = (
+            torch.accelerator.current_device_index() if index is None else index
+        )
+        # Compile the kernels now, not inside a CUDA graph capture.
+        _route_kernel(self.device_index)
+        _gemm1_kernel(self.device_index)
+        _gemm2_kernel(self.device_index)
+        # The modular kernel's input quantization, reused so the activations
+        # match its path bit for bit.
+        self.prepare_finalize = prepare_finalize
+        self.quant_config = quant_config
+        self.front_config: FrontConfig | None = None
+        self.w13, self.w13_scale, self.w2, self.w2_scale = w13, w13_scale, w2, w2_scale
+        self.clamp = clamp
+
+    def set_front(self, config: FrontConfig) -> None:
+        """Use the fused front with the router's ``config``."""
+        _front_kernel(self.device_index, config.bias_vl is not None)
+        self.front_config = config
+
+    def accepts(self, x: torch.Tensor, runner: torch.nn.Module) -> bool:
+        """Whether a call with router input ``x`` can take these kernels: 1-8
+        BF16 rows, and the runner's expert weights still the tensors bound here
+        (a weight reload replaces them)."""
+        return (
+            1 <= x.size(0) <= MAX_ROWS
+            and x.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            and tuple(x.shape) == (x.size(0), HIDDEN)
+            and x.is_contiguous()
+            and x.data_ptr() % 16 == 0
+            and runner.routed_experts.w13_weight.data_ptr() == self.w13.data_ptr()
+        )
+
+    def route(
+        self,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_weights: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> Routing:
+        """Quantize ``x`` as the modular kernel does and launch the route kernel
+        on the router's top-k (``topk_weights`` FP32)."""
+        rows, top_k = topk_ids.shape
+        x_quant, x_scale, *_ = self.prepare_finalize.prepare(
+            x,
+            topk_weights,
+            topk_ids,
+            self.experts,
+            None,
+            False,
+            self.quant_config,
+            defer_input_quant=False,
+        )
+        assert x_scale is not None and x_scale.is_contiguous()
+        ids = topk_ids.to(torch.int32).contiguous()
+        ctas = max_ctas(rows, top_k, self.experts)
+        permuted = torch.empty((rows, top_k), dtype=torch.int32, device=x.device)
+        record = torch.empty(route_words(ctas), dtype=torch.int32, device=x.device)
+        _route_kernel(self.device_index)(
+            *(_pointer(cutlass.Int32, t, 4) for t in (ids, permuted, record)),
+            Int32(rows),
+            Int32(top_k),
+            Int32(self.experts),
+            current_cu_stream(),
+        )
+        return Routing(x_quant, x_scale, ids, topk_weights, permuted, record, ctas)
+
+    def front(
+        self, x: torch.Tensor, logits: torch.Tensor, input_ids: torch.Tensor | None
+    ) -> Routing:
+        """Top-k, MXFP8 quantization and routing record in one launch.
+
+        ``x``: BF16 router input [rows, 5120]; ``logits``: FP32 router logits
+        [rows, 384]; ``input_ids``: [rows] int32 or int64, read only with image
+        routing.
+        """
+        config = self.front_config
+        assert config is not None
+        rows = x.size(0)
+        device = x.device
+        ctas = max_ctas(rows, TOP_K, self.experts)
+        topk_ids = torch.empty((rows, TOP_K), dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        topk_weights = torch.empty((rows, TOP_K), dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+        x_quant = torch.empty((rows, HIDDEN), dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn, device=device)
+        x_scale = torch.empty((rows, HIDDEN // 32), dtype=torch.uint8, device=device)
+        permuted = torch.empty((rows, TOP_K), dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        record = torch.empty(route_words(ctas), dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        image = config.bias_vl is not None
+        ids = topk_ids
+        if image:
+            assert input_ids is not None
+            ids = input_ids
+        _front_kernel(self.device_index, image)(
+            _pointer(cutlass.Float32, logits, 16),
+            _pointer(cutlass.Float32, config.bias, 16),
+            _pointer(cutlass.Float32, config.bias_vl if image else config.bias, 16),
+            _pointer(cutlass.Int32, ids, 4),
+            Int32(int(ids.dtype == torch.int64)),
+            Int32(config.image_sentinel_lo),
+            Float32(config.scale),
+            _pointer(cutlass.Uint32, x, 16),
+            _pointer(cutlass.Int32, topk_ids, 16),
+            _pointer(cutlass.Float32, topk_weights, 16),
+            _pointer(cutlass.Uint8, x_quant, 16),
+            _pointer(cutlass.Uint8, x_scale, 16),
+            _pointer(cutlass.Int32, permuted, 16),
+            _pointer(cutlass.Int32, record, 16),
+            Int32(rows),
+            current_cu_stream(),
+        )
+        return Routing(x_quant, x_scale, topk_ids, topk_weights, permuted, record, ctas)
+
+    def gemms(self, routing: Routing) -> UnfinalizedMoEOutput:
+        """Launch GEMM1 and GEMM2 right after the kernel that built ``routing``."""
+        return self.gemm2(routing, *self.gemm1(routing))
+
+    def gemm1(self, routing: Routing) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """Launch GEMM1; returns the intermediate H and its block scales (one
+        128-row scale atom per token tile, rows 0-7 used)."""
+        device = routing.x_quant.device
+        padded_rows = TILE * routing.ctas
+        h_values = torch.empty((padded_rows, PADDED), dtype=torch.uint8, device=device)
+        h_scales = torch.empty(
+            routing.ctas * tile_scale_bytes(PADDED), dtype=torch.uint8, device=device
+        )
+        _gemm1_kernel(self.device_index)(
+            _pointer(cutlass.Float4E2M1FN, self.w13, 32),
+            _pointer(cutlass.Float8E8M0FNU, self.w13_scale, 16),
+            _pointer(cutlass.Float8E4M3FN, routing.x_quant, 16),
+            _pointer(cutlass.Uint32, routing.x_scale, 16),
+            _pointer(cutlass.Uint16, h_values, 16),
+            _pointer(cutlass.Uint8, h_scales, 16),
+            _pointer(cutlass.Int32, routing.record, 16),
+            _pointer(cutlass.Float32, self.clamp, 16),
+            Int32(routing.x_quant.size(0)),
+            Int32(self.experts),
+            Int32(cta_words(routing.ctas)),
+            Int32(padded_rows),
+            Int32(_sm_count(self.device_index)),
+            current_cu_stream(),
+        )
+        return h_values, h_scales
+
+    def gemm2(
+        self, routing: Routing, h_values: torch.Tensor, h_scales: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> UnfinalizedMoEOutput:
+        """Launch GEMM2 on GEMM1's outputs."""
+        rows, top_k = routing.topk_ids.shape
+        gemm2_rows = torch.empty(
+            (rows * top_k * TILE, HIDDEN),
+            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            device=routing.x_quant.device,
+        )
+        _gemm2_kernel(self.device_index)(
+            _pointer(cutlass.Float4E2M1FN, self.w2, 32),
+            _pointer(cutlass.Float8E8M0FNU, self.w2_scale, 16),
+            _pointer(cutlass.Float8E4M3FN, h_values, 16),
+            _pointer(cutlass.Float8E8M0FNU, h_scales, 16),
+            _pointer(cutlass.BFloat16, gemm2_rows, 16),
+            _pointer(cutlass.Int32, routing.record, 16),
+            Int32(TILE * routing.ctas),
+            Int32(self.experts),
+            Int32(cta_words(routing.ctas)),
+            Int32(_sm_count(self.device_index)),
+            current_cu_stream(),
+        )
+        return UnfinalizedMoEOutput(
+            gemm2_permuted=gemm2_rows,
+            expert_weights=routing.topk_weights.contiguous().view(rows, top_k),
+            expanded_idx_to_permuted_idx=routing.permuted,
+        )
+
+
+def _pointer(dtype: type[cutlass.Numeric], tensor: torch.Tensor, align: int):
+    """A CuTe DSL global-memory pointer to ``tensor``'s data."""
+    return make_ptr(
+        dtype, tensor.data_ptr(), cute.AddressSpace.gmem, assumed_align=align
+    )
+
+
+def _fake(dtype: type[cutlass.Numeric], align: int):
+    """A placeholder pointer for compilation."""
+    return make_ptr(dtype, align, cute.AddressSpace.gmem, assumed_align=align)
+
+
+@cache
+def _route_kernel(device_index: int):
+    """``RoutedExpertRoute`` compiled for a device."""
+    with torch.accelerator.device_index(device_index):
+        return cute.compile(
+            RoutedExpertRoute(),
+            _fake(cutlass.Int32, 4),
+            _fake(cutlass.Int32, 4),
+            _fake(cutlass.Int32, 4),
+            Int32(1),
+            Int32(TOP_K),
+            Int32(MAX_EXPERTS),
+            make_fake_stream(),
+        )
+
+
+@cache
+def _front_kernel(device_index: int, image: bool):
+    """``RoutedExpertFront`` compiled for a device, with or without image
+    routing."""
+    with torch.accelerator.device_index(device_index):
+        return cute.compile(
+            RoutedExpertFront(image),
+            _fake(cutlass.Float32, 16),
+            _fake(cutlass.Float32, 16),
+            _fake(cutlass.Float32, 16),
+            _fake(cutlass.Int32, 4),
+            Int32(0),
+            Int32(0),
+            Float32(1.0),
+            _fake(cutlass.Uint32, 16),
+            _fake(cutlass.Int32, 16),
+            _fake(cutlass.Float32, 16),
+            _fake(cutlass.Uint8, 16),
+            _fake(cutlass.Uint8, 16),
+            _fake(cutlass.Int32, 16),
+            _fake(cutlass.Int32, 16),
+            Int32(1),
+            make_fake_stream(),
+        )
+
+
+@cache
+def _gemm1_kernel(device_index: int):
+    """``RoutedExpertGemm1`` compiled for a device."""
+    with torch.accelerator.device_index(device_index):
+        return cute.compile(
+            RoutedExpertGemm1(HIDDEN, SLICE, PADDED),
+            _fake(cutlass.Float4E2M1FN, 32),
+            _fake(cutlass.Float8E8M0FNU, 16),
+            _fake(cutlass.Float8E4M3FN, 16),
+            _fake(cutlass.Uint32, 16),
+            _fake(cutlass.Uint16, 16),
+            _fake(cutlass.Uint8, 16),
+            _fake(cutlass.Int32, 16),
+            _fake(cutlass.Float32, 16),
+            Int32(1),
+            Int32(MAX_EXPERTS),
+            Int32(4),
+            Int32(TILE),
+            Int32(1),
+            make_fake_stream(),
+        )
+
+
+@cache
+def _gemm2_kernel(device_index: int):
+    """``RoutedExpertGemm2`` compiled for a device."""
+    with torch.accelerator.device_index(device_index):
+        return cute.compile(
+            RoutedExpertGemm2(HIDDEN, PADDED),
+            _fake(cutlass.Float4E2M1FN, 32),
+            _fake(cutlass.Float8E8M0FNU, 16),
+            _fake(cutlass.Float8E4M3FN, 16),
+            _fake(cutlass.Float8E8M0FNU, 16),
+            _fake(cutlass.BFloat16, 16),
+            _fake(cutlass.Int32, 16),
+            Int32(TILE),
+            Int32(MAX_EXPERTS),
+            Int32(4),
+            Int32(1),
+            make_fake_stream(),
+        )
+
+
+@cache
+def _sm_count(device_index: int) -> int:
+    """Streaming multiprocessors of a device: the persistent GEMMs' CTAs."""
+    return torch.cuda.get_device_properties(device_index).multi_processor_count
+
+
+def check_weights(
+    w13: torch.Tensor,
+    w13_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    w2: torch.Tensor,
+    w2_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    clamp: torch.Tensor | None,
+    top_k: int,
+) -> None:
+    """Raise ``ValueError`` unless the weights have the layout the kernels read
+    and the routing fits the route kernel."""
+    experts = w13.size(0)
+    for tensor, shape in (
+        (w13, (experts, 2 * PADDED, HIDDEN // 2)),
+        (w13_scale, (experts, 2 * PADDED, HIDDEN // 32)),
+        (w2, (experts, HIDDEN, PADDED // 2)),
+        (w2_scale, (experts, HIDDEN, PADDED // 32)),
+    ):
+        if (
+            tuple(tensor.shape) != shape
+            or tensor.element_size() != 1
+            or not tensor.is_contiguous()
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"expected a contiguous {shape} 1-byte tensor, got "
+                f"{tuple(tensor.shape)} {tensor.dtype}"
+            )
+    if w13.data_ptr() % 32 or w2.data_ptr() % 32:
+        raise ValueError("packed expert weights must be 32-byte aligned")
+    if w13_scale.data_ptr() % 16 or w2_scale.data_ptr() % 16:
+        raise ValueError("weight scales must be 16-byte aligned")
+    if experts % 32 or not 0 < experts <= MAX_EXPERTS:
+        raise ValueError(f"{experts} local experts")
+    if not 1 <= top_k <= MAX_TOP_K:
+        raise ValueError(f"top-k {top_k}")
+    if (
+        clamp is None
+        or clamp.dtype != torch.float32
+        or tuple(clamp.shape) != (experts,)
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("no FP32 [E] SwiGLU clamp limit")
+    # GEMM1 never reads w13's padding tile (intermediate 576..639), so the
+    # padding must be zero, as must the matching K columns of w2.
+    if (
+        torch.count_nonzero(w13.view(torch.uint8)[:, 2 * SLICE :]).item()
+        or torch.count_nonzero(w2.view(torch.uint8)[:, :, SLICE // 2 :]).item()
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("the intermediate padding of w13/w2 is not zero")
+
+
+def _unsupported_reason(runner: torch.nn.Module) -> str | None:
+    """Why the MoE runner's routed experts cannot take the GEMM pair."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.activation import MoEActivation
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.experts.trtllm_mxfp4_moe import (
+        TrtLlmMxfp4ExpertsModular,
+    )
+
+    kernel = runner.routed_experts.quant_method.moe_kernel
+    impl = kernel.fused_experts if kernel is not None else None
+    if not isinstance(impl, TrtLlmMxfp4ExpertsModular):
+        return f"experts kernel {type(impl).__name__}"
+    config = impl.moe_config
+    quant = impl.quant_config
+    if config.activation != MoEActivation.SILU:
+        return f"activation {config.activation}"
+    if impl.gemm1_alpha is not None or impl.gemm1_beta is not None:
+        return "gemm1 alpha/beta"
+    if impl.w1_bias is not None or impl.w2_bias is not None:
+        return "expert biases"
+    if impl.local_num_experts != config.num_experts:
+        return "expert parallelism"
+    if runner.routed_scaling_factor != 1.0:
+        return "routed scaling"
+    if quant.quant_dtype != "mxfp8" or quant.is_scale_swizzled:
+        return "activations are not MXFP8 with linear scales"
+    return None
+
+
+def _front_config(runner: torch.nn.Module) -> FrontConfig | str:
+    """The fused front's configuration for the runner's router, or why its
+    routing is not the plain DSv4 top-k the front computes."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.router.fused_topk_bias_router import (
+        FusedTopKBiasRouter,
+    )
+
+    router = runner.router
+    if not isinstance(router, FusedTopKBiasRouter):
+        return f"router {type(router).__name__}"
+    if router.scoring_func != "sqrtsoftplus" or not router.renormalize:
+        return "routing is not renormalized sqrt-softplus"
+    if router.top_k != TOP_K or router.global_num_experts != EXPERTS:
+        return f"top-{router.top_k} of {router.global_num_experts} experts"
+    if router._hash_indices_table is not None or router.num_fused_shared_experts:
+        return "hash routing or fused shared experts"
+    if runner.gate is None or runner._fse_fuse_gate:
+        return "no plain router gate"
+    bias, bias_vl = router.e_score_correction_bias, router.bias_vl
+    for tensor in (bias, bias_vl):
+        if tensor is not None and (
+            tensor.dtype != torch.float32
+            or tuple(tensor.shape) != (EXPERTS,)
+            or not tensor.is_contiguous()
+        ):
+            return f"bias is not FP32 [{EXPERTS}]"
+    if bias is None:
+        return "no score correction bias"
+    if router.image_sentinel_lo <= 0:
+        bias_vl = None
+    return FrontConfig(
+        bias=bias.data,
+        bias_vl=None if bias_vl is None else bias_vl.data,
+        image_sentinel_lo=0 if bias_vl is None else router.image_sentinel_lo,
+        scale=float(router.routed_scaling_factor),
+    )
+
+
+def front_applies(gemm: RoutedExpertGemm, runner: torch.nn.Module) -> bool:
+    """Whether the fused front may replace the router's top-k this call: the
+    router's biases are the tensors the front reads, and no routed-expert
+    capture hook (which only ``select_experts`` feeds) is set."""
+    config = gemm.front_config
+    router = runner.router
+    if (
+        config is None
+        or router.capture_fn is not None
+        or router._routing_replay_out is not None
+    ):
+        return False
+    bias, bias_vl = router.e_score_correction_bias, router.bias_vl
+    return (
+        bias is not None
+        and bias.data_ptr() == config.bias.data_ptr()
+        and (
+            config.bias_vl is None
+            or (bias_vl is not None and bias_vl.data_ptr() == config.bias_vl.data_ptr())
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def build_routed_expert_gemms(
+    runners: list[torch.nn.Module],
+) -> list[RoutedExpertGemm | None]:
+    """A ``RoutedExpertGemm`` for each MoE runner that supports it (None for the
+    others), with the fused front where the router allows it. Needs the MoE
+    kernels that the loader's per-layer quantization finalize builds."""
+    reasons: Counter[str] = Counter()
+    gemms: list[RoutedExpertGemm | None] = []
+    fronts = 0
+    for runner in runners:
+        gemm = None
+        reason = _unsupported_reason(runner)
+        if reason is not None:
+            reasons[reason] += 1
+        else:
+            routed = runner.routed_experts
+            kernel = routed.quant_method.moe_kernel
+            impl = kernel.fused_experts
+            try:
+                gemm = RoutedExpertGemm(
+                    routed.w13_weight,
+                    impl.w1_scale,
+                    routed.w2_weight,
+                    impl.w2_scale,
+                    impl.gemm1_clamp_limit,
+                    impl.topk,
+                    kernel.prepare_finalize,
+                    impl.quant_config,
+                )
+            except ValueError as error:
+                reasons[str(error)] += 1
+        if gemm is not None:
+            front = _front_config(runner)

+"""Routed-expert GEMMs of the DeepSeek-V4.1 low-batch MoE in CuTe DSL.
+
+The low-batch MoE (``routed_expert_gemm.py``) multiplies at most eight token
+rows by the weights of the experts they chose. Its routing record
+(``routed_expert_route_cute.py``) lists, for each 8-row token tile, the
+tile's expert and its row limit (the end of the expert's rows within the
+tile). A GEMM here computes 128 x 8 output tiles from MXFP4 weights (operand
+A, 128 rows of one expert) and MXFP8 activations (operand B, 8 rows) with
+``tcgen05`` block-scaled MMAs, as FlashInfer's low-latency block-scaled GEMM
+does, over the work items (weight row tile, token tile) of the tiles the
+record uses:
+
+* the kernel is persistent: CTA ``b`` of ``G`` takes items ``b, b + G, ..``,
+  so the weight loads stream without a gap from one item to the next, and no
+  CTA works on a token tile the call does not use;
+* the warp that loads A loads it at the item's expert ``record[4 + c]``;
+* the MMAs run in ascending K order without split-K, the order of the
+  TRT-LLM-gen ``t128x8`` tactics, so every output is bitwise theirs;
+* the accumulator has two tensor-memory stages, so the epilogue of one item
+  overlaps the MMAs of the next.
+
+Warps: 0 loads A and its scales, 1 loads B and its scales, 2 issues the MMAs,
+4-7 run the epilogue (warp 3 is idle).
+
+Programmatic dependent launch. GEMM2's weights stream before GEMM1 finishes:
+only its B load warp waits for GEMM1, and it reads the record without waiting
+(the record comes from the kernel before GEMM1, and GEMM1 triggers its
+dependents only after its own wait for that kernel). GEMM1 needs the record to
+pick its experts, so all its warps wait first.
+
+The weights are those vLLM prepares for the TRT-LLM-gen backend, whose rows are
+shuffled for 128-row epilogue tiles: in each block of 32, shuffled row
+``s0 + 8 * s1`` (``s0 < 8``, ``s1 < 4``) holds row ``4 * s0 + s1``. Their
+scales are in the 128x4 layout the kernel reads for A.
+
+GEMM1 (:class:`RoutedExpertGemm1`) multiplies the whole routed input (at most
+eight rows) by each tile's expert and keeps, for every row of the tile, the
+column of the token routed to it: clamped SwiGLU of the interleaved up/gate
+rows, quantized to MXFP8 (H and its block scales). The epilogue's arithmetic
+follows the GEMM1 kernel from Cake (vllm-project/vllm#59725).
+
+GEMM2 (:class:`RoutedExpertGemm2`) reads token tile ``c`` of the intermediate
+H, the contiguous rows ``8c .. 8c + 7``, and writes BF16 rows of the output in
+the same permuted order. H's block scales use the layout the kernel reads for
+B: one 128-row scale atom per 8-row tile, of which rows 0-7 are used
+(``HS[c * K + (k // 128) * 512 + r * 16 + (k // 32) % 4]`` for the scale of
+row ``8c + r`` at column ``k``, ``K`` the bytes of one tile's atoms).

+        """Tensor-memory layout of the staged accumulators."""
+        acc_shape = tiled_mma.partition_shape_C((self.cta_m, self.cta_n))

+            cute.append(acc_shape, self.num_acc_stage)

+    @cute.jit
+    def mma_warp(
+        self,
+        ab_full_bar,
+        ab_empty_bar,
+        acc_pipeline,
+        tmem_bar,
+        tmem_base_smem_ptr,
+        tiled_mma: cute.TiledMma,
+        sA: cute.Tensor,
+        sB: cute.Tensor,
+        sSFA: cute.Tensor,
+        sSFB: cute.Tensor,
+        sfa_smem_layout_staged: cute.Layout,
+        sfb_smem_layout_staged: cute.Layout,
+        count: Int32,
+    ):
+        """Allocate tensor memory; for every item, wait for an accumulator
+        stage and issue the block-scaled MMAs of its K tiles (scales copied
+        from shared to tensor memory first); free the tensor memory."""
+        tCrA = tiled_mma.make_fragment_A(sA)
+        tCrB = tiled_mma.make_fragment_B(sB)
+        cute.arch.alloc_tmem(TMEM_COLUMNS, tmem_base_smem_ptr)
+        cute.arch.mbarrier_arrive(tmem_bar)
+        cute.arch.relinquish_tmem_alloc_permit()
+        tmem_ptr = cute.arch.retrieve_tmem_ptr(self.acc_dtype, 16, tmem_base_smem_ptr)
+        tCtAcc_base = cute.make_tensor(tmem_ptr, self._acc_layout(tiled_mma))
+
+        sfa_tmem_ptr = cute.recast_ptr(
+            tmem_ptr + self.num_acc_tmem_cols, dtype=self.sf_dtype
+        )
+        tCtSFA = cute.make_tensor(
+            sfa_tmem_ptr,
+            blockscaled_utils.make_tmem_layout_sfa(
+                tiled_mma,
+                tiled_mma.shape_mnk,
+                self.sf_vec_size,
+                cute.slice_(sfa_smem_layout_staged, (None, None, None, 0)),
+            ),
+        )
+        sfb_tmem_ptr = cute.recast_ptr(
+            tmem_ptr + self.num_acc_tmem_cols + self.num_sfa_tmem_cols,
+            dtype=self.sf_dtype,
+        )
+        tCtSFB = cute.make_tensor(
+            sfb_tmem_ptr,
+            blockscaled_utils.make_tmem_layout_sfb(
+                tiled_mma,
+                tiled_mma.shape_mnk,
+                self.sf_vec_size,
+                cute.slice_(sfb_smem_layout_staged, (None, None, None, 0)),
+            ),
+        )
+        copy_sfa, tCsSFA_s2t, tCtSFA_s2t = self._s2t_copy(sSFA, tCtSFA)
+        copy_sfb, tCsSFB_s2t, tCtSFB_s2t = self._s2t_copy(sSFB, tCtSFB)
+
+        ab_state = make_pipeline_state(PipelineUserType.Consumer, self.num_ab_stage)
+        acc_state = make_pipeline_state(PipelineUserType.Producer, self.num_acc_stage)
+        for _ in cutlass.range(count, unroll=1):
+            acc_pipeline.producer_acquire(acc_state)
+            tCtAcc = tCtAcc_base[(None, None, None, acc_state.index)]
+            for k_tile in cutlass.range(self.k_tiles, unroll=1):
+                cute.arch.mbarrier_wait(ab_full_bar + ab_state.index, ab_state.phase)
+                stage = (None, None, None, None, ab_state.index)
+                cute.copy(copy_sfa, tCsSFA_s2t[stage], tCtSFA_s2t)
+                cute.copy(copy_sfb, tCsSFB_s2t[stage], tCtSFB_s2t)
+                tiled_mma.set(tcgen05.Field.ACCUMULATE, k_tile != 0)
+                operand = (None, None, None, ab_state.index)
+                cute.gemm(
+                    tiled_mma,
+                    tCtAcc,
+                    [tCrA[operand], tCtSFA],
+                    [tCrB[operand], tCtSFB],
+                    tCtAcc,
+                )
+                with cute.arch.elect_one():
+                    tcgen05.commit(ab_empty_bar + ab_state.index, None, self.cta_group)
+                ab_state.advance()
+            acc_pipeline.producer_commit(acc_state)
+            acc_state.advance()
+
+        # Free the tensor memory once the epilogue has read it. Every thread
+        # waits for each phase it arrived on before arriving again.
+        cute.arch.mbarrier_wait(tmem_bar, 0)
+        cute.arch.mbarrier_arrive(tmem_bar)
+        cute.arch.mbarrier_wait(tmem_bar, 1)
+        cute.arch.dealloc_tmem(tmem_ptr, TMEM_COLUMNS)
+
+    def _s2t_copy(self, sSF: cute.Tensor, tSF: cute.Tensor):
+        """Shared-to-tensor-memory copy of scale factors, partitioned."""
+        tCsSF_compact = cute.filter_zeros(sSF)
+        tCtSF_compact = cute.filter_zeros(tSF)
+        copy_atom = cute.make_copy_atom(
+            tcgen05.Cp4x32x128bOp(self.cta_group), self.sf_dtype
+        )
+        tiled_copy = tcgen05.make_s2t_copy(copy_atom, tCtSF_compact)
+        thr_copy = tiled_copy.get_slice(0)
+        tCsSF = tcgen05.get_s2t_smem_desc_tensor(
+            tiled_copy, thr_copy.partition_S(tCsSF_compact)
+        )
+        return tiled_copy, tCsSF, thr_copy.partition_D(tCtSF_compact)

+@cute.jit
+def unshuffled_row(row: Int32) -> Int32:
+    """The weight row that shuffled row ``row`` holds (module docstring)."""
+    return (row & Int32(-32)) | ((row & Int32(7)) << Int32(2)) | ((row >> 3) & 3)

+class RoutedExpertGemm2(RoutedExpertGemm):
+    """GEMM2: the BF16 rows ``h @ w2[expert]^T`` of each token tile, in the
+    tile's permuted order."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self, hidden: int, intermediate: int, cta_k: int = 128, num_ab_stage: int = 10
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__(hidden, hidden // 128, intermediate, cta_k, num_ab_stage)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        a_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        sfa_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        b_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        sfb_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        c_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        route_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        rows: Int32,
+        experts: Int32,
+        cta_words: Int32,
+        ctas: Int32,
+        stream: cuda.CUstream,
+    ):
+        """A: w2 (hidden, intermediate, experts), K-major; B: H (rows,
+        intermediate), K-major, ``rows`` the padded rows; C: (rows, hidden)
+        BF16; ``ctas`` persistent CTAs."""
+        self.a_dtype = a_ptr.value_type
+        self.b_dtype = b_ptr.value_type
+        self.sf_dtype = sfa_ptr.value_type
+        a = cute.make_tensor(
+            a_ptr, cute.make_ordered_layout((self.m, self.k, experts), order=(1, 0, 2))
+        )
+        sfa = cute.make_tensor(
+            sfa_ptr, blockscaled_utils.tile_atom_to_shape_SF(a.shape, self.sf_vec_size)
+        )
+        b = cute.make_tensor(
+            b_ptr, cute.make_ordered_layout((rows, self.k, 1), order=(1, 0, 2))
+        )
+        padded = cute.ceil_div(rows, TILE) * 128
+        sfb = cute.make_tensor(
+            sfb_ptr,
+            blockscaled_utils.tile_atom_to_shape_SF(
+                cute.make_ordered_layout((padded, self.k, 1), order=(1, 0, 2)).shape,
+                self.sf_vec_size,
+            ),
+        )
+        c = cute.make_tensor(
+            c_ptr, cute.make_ordered_layout((self.m, rows), order=(0, 1))
+        )
+        route = cute.make_tensor(route_ptr, cute.make_layout(4 + 2 * cta_words))
+        self._launch(a, sfa, b, sfb, route, (c,), (), cta_words, ctas, stream)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def store(
+        self,
+        tDrAcc: cute.Tensor,
+        tDcC: cute.Tensor,
+        epi: tuple,
+        mRoute: cute.Tensor,
+        cta_words: Int32,
+        n_tile: Int32,
+        m_tile: Int32,
+        item: Int32,
+        exchange: cute.Tensor,
+    ):
+        """Round to BF16 (nearest even) and store the tile's rows below its
+        limit at their unshuffled hidden index."""
+        (mC,) = epi
+        row_limit = mRoute[4 + cta_words + n_tile]
+        tDrC = cute.make_rmem_tensor(tDrAcc.shape, cutlass.BFloat16)
+        tDrC.store(tDrAcc.load().to(cutlass.BFloat16))
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(cute.size(tDrC)):
+            coord = tDcC[i]
+            if coord[1] < row_limit:
+                mC[unshuffled_row(coord[0]), coord[1]] = tDrC[i]

+# GEMM1's epilogue arithmetic, spelled out instruction by instruction so that H,
+# its scales and GEMM2's rows are bitwise those of the TRT-LLM-gen MoE.
+_SWIGLU_X2 = """{
+.reg .pred sw_p;
+.reg .f32 sw_u0, sw_u1, sw_g0, sw_g1, sw_x0, sw_x1;
+.reg .b32 sw_r0, sw_r1;
+.reg .b64 sw_up, sw_gate, sw_one, sw_zero, sw_l2e, sw_neg, sw_f, sw_a, sw_d;
+setp.lt.ftz.f32 sw_p, $6, $2;
+selp.f32 sw_u0, $6, $2, sw_p;
+setp.lt.ftz.f32 sw_p, $2, $7;
+selp.f32 sw_u0, $7, sw_u0, sw_p;
+setp.lt.ftz.f32 sw_p, $6, $3;
+selp.f32 sw_u1, $6, $3, sw_p;
+setp.lt.ftz.f32 sw_p, $3, $7;
+selp.f32 sw_u1, $7, sw_u1, sw_p;
+setp.lt.ftz.f32 sw_p, $6, $4;
+selp.f32 sw_g0, $6, $4, sw_p;
+setp.lt.ftz.f32 sw_p, $4, 0fFF7FFFFF;
+selp.f32 sw_g0, 0fFF7FFFFF, sw_g0, sw_p;
+setp.lt.ftz.f32 sw_p, $6, $5;
+selp.f32 sw_g1, $6, $5, sw_p;
+setp.lt.ftz.f32 sw_p, $5, 0fFF7FFFFF;
+selp.f32 sw_g1, 0fFF7FFFFF, sw_g1, sw_p;
+mov.b32 sw_r0, sw_u0;
+mov.b32 sw_r1, sw_u1;
+mov.b64 sw_up, {sw_r0, sw_r1};
+mov.b32 sw_r0, sw_g0;
+mov.b32 sw_r1, sw_g1;
+mov.b64 sw_gate, {sw_r0, sw_r1};
+mov.b64 sw_one, 4575657222473777152;
+mov.b64 sw_zero, 0;
+mov.b64 sw_l2e, 4591606991553079867;
+mov.b64 sw_neg, -4647714812233515008;
+fma.rn.f32x2 sw_f, sw_up, sw_one, sw_zero;
+mul.rn.f32x2 sw_a, sw_gate, sw_l2e;
+mul.rn.f32x2 sw_a, sw_neg, sw_a;
+mov.b64 {sw_r0, sw_r1}, sw_a;
+mov.b32 sw_x0, sw_r0;
+mov.b32 sw_x1, sw_r1;
+ex2.approx.ftz.f32 sw_x0, sw_x0;
+ex2.approx.ftz.f32 sw_x1, sw_x1;
+mov.b32 sw_r0, sw_x0;
+mov.b32 sw_r1, sw_x1;
+mov.b64 sw_d, {sw_r0, sw_r1};
+add.f32x2 sw_d, sw_one, sw_d;
+mov.b64 {sw_r0, sw_r1}, sw_d;
+mov.b32 sw_x0, sw_r0;
+mov.b32 sw_x1, sw_r1;
+rcp.approx.ftz.f32 sw_x0, sw_x0;
+rcp.approx.ftz.f32 sw_x1, sw_x1;
+mov.b32 sw_r0, sw_x0;
+mov.b32 sw_r1, sw_x1;
+mov.b64 sw_d, {sw_r0, sw_r1};
+mul.rn.f32x2 sw_d, sw_gate, sw_d;
+mul.rn.f32x2 sw_d, sw_f, sw_d;
+mov.b64 {sw_r0, sw_r1}, sw_d;
+mov.b32 $0, sw_r0;
+mov.b32 $1, sw_r1;
+}"""
+
+# Two blocks' amax (this warp's half, the partner warp's half) to the bits of
+# amax / 448, an all-zero block counting as amax 448.
+_SCALES_X2 = """{
+.reg .pred sc_p;
+.reg .f32 sc_a, sc_b;
+.reg .b32 sc_r0, sc_r1;
+.reg .b64 sc_x, sc_c;
+max.ftz.f32 sc_a, $2, $3;
+setp.eq.ftz.f32 sc_p, sc_a, 0f00000000;
+selp.f32 sc_a, 0f43E00000, sc_a, sc_p;
+max.ftz.f32 sc_b, $4, $5;
+setp.eq.ftz.f32 sc_p, sc_b, 0f00000000;
+selp.f32 sc_b, 0f43E00000, sc_b, sc_p;
+mov.b32 sc_r0, sc_a;
+mov.b32 sc_r1, sc_b;
+mov.b64 sc_x, {sc_r0, sc_r1};
+mov.b64 sc_c, 4256545022072211749;
+mul.rn.f32x2 sc_x, sc_x, sc_c;
+mov.b64 {$0, $1}, sc_x;
+}"""
+
+
+def _asm(result, operands: list, text: str, constraints: str, loc, ip):
+    """A side-effect-free PTX inline assembly operation."""
+    return llvm.inline_asm(
+        result,
+        operands,
+        text,
+        constraints,
+        has_side_effects=False,
+        is_align_stack=False,
+        asm_dialect=llvm.AsmDialect.AD_ATT,
+        loc=loc,
+        ip=ip,
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def clamped_swiglu_x2(up0, up1, gate0, gate1, limit, neg_limit, *, loc=None, ip=None):
+    """``h`` of two tokens: ``up`` clamped to [-limit, limit] and ``gate`` to
+    at most ``limit``, then ``up * gate * sigmoid(gate)``."""
+    result = _asm(
+        llvm.StructType.get_literal([T.f32(), T.f32()]),
+        [
+            Float32(v).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)
+            for v in (up0, up1, gate0, gate1, limit, neg_limit)
+        ],
+        _SWIGLU_X2,
+        "=f,=f,f,f,f,f,f,f",
+        loc,
+        ip,
+    )
+    return tuple(
+        Float32(llvm.extractvalue(T.f32(), result, [index], loc=loc, ip=ip))
+        for index in range(2)
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def abs_max_x2(lo, hi, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> Float32:
+    """``max(|lo|, |hi|, 0)``, subnormals flushed."""
+    return Float32(
+        _asm(
+            T.f32(),
+            [Float32(v).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip) for v in (lo, hi)],
+            "{\n.reg .f32 am_a, am_b;\nabs.ftz.f32 am_a, $1;\nabs.ftz.f32 am_b, $2;\n"
+            "max.ftz.f32 am_a, am_a, am_b;\nabs.ftz.f32 am_a, am_a;\n"
+            "max.ftz.f32 $0, am_a, 0f00000000;\n}",
+            "=f,f,f",
+            loc,
+            ip,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def scale_bits_x2(mine0, partner0, mine1, partner1, *, loc=None, ip=None):
+    """The ``_SCALES_X2`` bits of two blocks."""
+    result = _asm(
+        llvm.StructType.get_literal([T.i32(), T.i32()]),
+        [
+            Float32(v).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)
+            for v in (mine0, partner0, mine1, partner1)
+        ],
+        _SCALES_X2,
+        "=r,=r,f,f,f,f",
+        loc,
+        ip,
+    )
+    return tuple(
+        Uint32(llvm.extractvalue(T.i32(), result, [index], loc=loc, ip=ip))
+        for index in range(2)
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def quantize_e4m3x2(lo, hi, inverse_bits, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> Uint16:
+    """``lo`` and ``hi`` times the inverse scale (subnormals flushed) as two
+    saturating E4M3 bytes, ``lo`` first."""
+    return Uint16(
+        _asm(
+            T.i16(),
+            [
+                Float32(lo).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+                Float32(hi).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+                Uint32(inverse_bits).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+            ],
+            "{\n.reg .f32 qz_i, qz_a, qz_b;\nmov.b32 qz_i, $3;\n"
+            "mul.ftz.f32 qz_a, $1, qz_i;\nmul.ftz.f32 qz_b, $2, qz_i;\n"
+            "cvt.rn.satfinite.e4m3x2.f32 $0, qz_b, qz_a;\n}",
+            "=h,f,f,r",
+            loc,
+            ip,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def ue8m0_code(bits: Uint32):
+    """The UE8M0 code of a positive scale (rounded up to a power of two) and
+    the bits of the FP32 inverse scale."""
+    exponent = (bits >> Uint32(23)) & Uint32(255)
+    mantissa = bits & Uint32(0x7FFFFF)
+    code = exponent
+    if mantissa != Uint32(0) and exponent != Uint32(254):
+        if exponent != Uint32(0):
+            code = exponent + Uint32(1)
+        elif mantissa > Uint32(0x400000):
+            code = Uint32(1)
+    if exponent == Uint32(255):
+        code = Uint32(255)
+    inverse = (Uint32(254) - code) << Uint32(23)
+    if code == Uint32(254):
+        inverse = Uint32(0x400000)
+    return code, inverse
+
+
+class RoutedExpertGemm1(RoutedExpertGemm):
+    """GEMM1: ``h = MXFP8(clamped SwiGLU(x @ w13[expert]^T))`` of each token
+    tile, in the tile's permuted rows.
+
+    B is the whole routed input ``x`` (at most eight rows; rows past its end
+    read as zero) with its linear UE8M0 scales, which the B load warp writes
+    into the layout the MMA reads. Accumulator column ``t`` is token ``t``;
+    the epilogue writes it to the tile row that token was routed to
+    (``record[4 + 2 C + 8 c + r] == t``), if any. w13's rows interleave up and
+    gate, so each thread pairs them, clamps them, applies SwiGLU, scales each
+    32-column block by its amax / 448 rounded up to a power of two (UE8M0),
+    and stores E4M3 values with the block scales in the per-tile layout GEMM2
+    reads. The m tile holding the slice's last columns also zeroes the padding
+    columns of H and gives their blocks scale 1.
+    """
+
+    route_before_wait = False
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        hidden: int,
+        slice_: int,
+        padded: int,
+        cta_k: int = 256,
+        num_ab_stage: int = 6,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__(2 * padded, 2 * slice_ // 128, hidden, cta_k, num_ab_stage)
+        self.slice, self.padded = slice_, padded
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        a_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        sfa_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        b_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        b_scale_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        h_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        hs_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        route_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        clamp_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        rows: Int32,
+        experts: Int32,
+        cta_words: Int32,
+        h_rows: Int32,
+        ctas: Int32,
+        stream: cuda.CUstream,
+    ):
+        """A: w13 (2 x padded, hidden, experts), K-major; B: x (rows,
+        hidden), ``b_scale_ptr`` its scales as Uint32 words (rows, hidden /
+        128); H (``h_rows``, padded) as Uint16 pairs; HS in the per-tile
+        layout; ``clamp`` FP32 per expert; ``ctas`` persistent CTAs."""
+        self.a_dtype = a_ptr.value_type
+        self.b_dtype = b_ptr.value_type
+        self.sf_dtype = sfa_ptr.value_type
+        a = cute.make_tensor(
+            a_ptr, cute.make_ordered_layout((self.m, self.k, experts), order=(1, 0, 2))
+        )
+        sfa = cute.make_tensor(
+            sfa_ptr, blockscaled_utils.tile_atom_to_shape_SF(a.shape, self.sf_vec_size)
+        )
+        b = cute.make_tensor(
+            b_ptr, cute.make_ordered_layout((rows, self.k, 1), order=(1, 0, 2))
+        )
+        words = self.k // 128
+        b_scale = cute.make_tensor(
+            b_scale_ptr, cute.make_layout((rows, words), stride=(words, 1))
+        )
+        h = cute.make_tensor(h_ptr, cute.make_layout(h_rows * (self.padded // 2)))
+        hs = cute.make_tensor(
+            hs_ptr,
+            cute.make_layout(
+                (h_rows + TILE - 1) // TILE * tile_scale_bytes(self.padded)
+            ),
+        )
+        clamp = cute.make_tensor(clamp_ptr, cute.make_layout(experts))
+        route = cute.make_tensor(
+            route_ptr, cute.make_layout(4 + 2 * cta_words + h_rows)
+        )
+        self._launch(
+            a, sfa, b, None, route, (h, hs, clamp), (b_scale,), cta_words, ctas, stream
+        )
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def b_tile_index(self, n_tile: Int32) -> Int32:
+        """Every item multiplies all of ``x``."""
+        return Int32(0)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def write_b_scales(
+        self, sSFB: cute.Tensor, stage: Int32, k_tile: Int32, b_side: tuple
+    ):
+        """Copy the stage's scales of ``x`` (four per 32-bit word) into rows
+        0-7 of B's scale atoms; rows past ``x``'s end get scale 1."""
+        (b_scale,) = b_side
+        atoms = self.cta_k // 128
+        stage_bytes = 512 * atoms
+        words = cute.make_tensor(
+            cute.recast_ptr(sSFB.iterator, dtype=Uint32),
+            cute.make_layout(self.num_ab_stage * stage_bytes // 4),
+        )
+        lane = cute.arch.lane_idx()
+        if lane < TILE * atoms:
+            row = lane // atoms
+            atom = lane - row * atoms
+            value = Uint32(0x7F7F7F7F)
+            if row < cute.size(b_scale, mode=[0]):
+                value = Uint32(b_scale[row, k_tile * atoms + atom])
+            words[(stage * stage_bytes + atom * 512 + row * 16) // 4] = value
+        # The MMA warp copies them to tensor memory through the async proxy.
+        cute.arch.fence_proxy("async.shared", space="cta")
+        cute.arch.sync_warp()
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def store(
+        self,
+        tDrAcc: cute.Tensor,
+        tDcC: cute.Tensor,
+        epi: tuple,
+        mRoute: cute.Tensor,
+        cta_words: Int32,
+        n_tile: Int32,
+        m_tile: Int32,
+        item: Int32,
+        exchange: cute.Tensor,
+    ):
+        """H and HS of the item (class docstring). The thread holds, for
+        tokens ``t, t + 1`` (``t`` = 2 x lane % 4), the up and gate rows of H
+        columns ``p`` (registers 0-3) and ``p + 1`` (4-7), ``p`` = 64 x m_tile
+        + 16 x warp + 2 x lane / 4."""
+        mH, mHS, mClamp = epi
+        warp = cute.arch.make_warp_uniform(cute.arch.warp_idx()) - self.epilogue_warp
+        lane = cute.arch.lane_idx()
+        token = (lane % 4) * 2
+        pair = warp * 16 + (lane // 4) * 2
+        limit = mClamp[mRoute[4 + n_tile]]
+        row0 = n_tile * TILE
+        valid = mRoute[4 + cta_words + n_tile] - row0
+        # The tile rows of the thread's two tokens (-1: not routed here).
+        row_a = Int32(-1)
+        row_b = Int32(-1)
+        for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(TILE):
+            if r < valid:
+                routed = mRoute[4 + 2 * cta_words + row0 + r]
+                if routed == token:
+                    row_a = Int32(r)
+                if routed == token + 1:
+                    row_b = Int32(r)
+
+        lo_a, lo_b = clamped_swiglu_x2(
+            tDrAcc[0], tDrAcc[1], tDrAcc[2], tDrAcc[3], limit, -limit
+        )
+        hi_a, hi_b = clamped_swiglu_x2(
+            tDrAcc[4], tDrAcc[5], tDrAcc[6], tDrAcc[7], limit, -limit
+        )
+        amax_a = abs_max_x2(lo_a, hi_a)
+        amax_b = abs_max_x2(lo_b, hi_b)
+        for shift in cutlass.range_constexpr(4, 1, -1):
+            amax_a = cute.arch.fmax(
+                amax_a, cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(amax_a, 1 << shift), ftz=True
+            )
+            amax_b = cute.arch.fmax(
+                amax_b, cute.arch.shuffle_sync_bfly(amax_b, 1 << shift), ftz=True
+            )
+        # A 32-column block spans warps 2j and 2j + 1.
+        base = (item % 2) * (4 * TILE)
+        if lane < 4:
+            exchange[base + warp * TILE + token] = amax_a
+            exchange[base + warp * TILE + token + 1] = amax_b
+        cute.arch.barrier(barrier_id=1, number_of_threads=128)
+        partner = base + (warp ^ 1) * TILE + token
+        bits_a, bits_b = scale_bits_x2(
+            amax_a, exchange[partner], amax_b, exchange[partner + 1]
+        )
+        code_a, inverse_a = ue8m0_code(bits_a)
+        code_b, inverse_b = ue8m0_code(bits_b)

+        if row_b >= 0:
+            mH[(row0 + row_b) * h_row + column] = quantize_e4m3x2(lo_b, hi_b, inverse_b)
+        tile_bytes = tile_scale_bytes(self.padded)
+        if warp % 2 == 0 and lane < TILE:
+            block = m_tile * 2 + warp // 2
+            row = row_a
+            code = code_a
+            if lane >= 4:
+                row = row_b
+                code = code_b
+            if row >= 0:
+                mHS[n_tile * tile_bytes + (block // 4) * 512 + row * 16 + block % 4] = (
+                    Uint8(code)
+                )

+            # Zero H's padding columns; their blocks get scale 1 (code 127).
+            thread = warp * 32 + lane
+            pad_row = thread // 16
+            if pad_row < valid:
+                pad = (row0 + pad_row) * h_row + (self.slice + (thread % 16) * 4) // 2
+                mH[pad] = Uint16(0)
+                mH[pad + 1] = Uint16(0)
+            if thread < 2 * TILE:
+                pad_row = thread // 2
+                pad_block = self.slice // 32 + thread % 2

+                    mHS[
+                        n_tile * tile_bytes
+                        + (pad_block // 4) * 512
+                        + pad_row * 16
+                        + pad_block % 4
+                    ] = Uint8(127)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Routing record of the DeepSeek-V4.1 low-batch routed-expert GEMMs in CuTe DSL.
+
+The routed-expert GEMMs (``routed_expert_gemm_cute.py``) multiply token tiles of
+at most eight rows by the weights of one expert each. The top-k expert ids of
+up to eight rows become the expert-major, tile-padded row permutation and the
+per-tile tables both GEMMs read. The result is that of FlashInfer's TRT-LLM-gen
+routing kernel with precomputed ids and an 8-token tile:
+
+* local experts (ids in ``[0, experts)``) in ascending id order, each one's
+  rows in ascending token order, every expert's segment padded to a multiple
+  of the tile (8 rows);
+* ``permuted[t, k]`` = the slot's row in that order, -1 for an id outside
+  ``[0, experts)``;
+* the record (int32, one buffer per call)::
+
+      [0]                      8 * tiles (padded rows)
+      [1]                      tiles
+      [2, 4)                   zero
+      [4, 4 + C)               tile -> local expert
+      [4 + C, 4 + 2C)          tile -> row limit min((c + 1) * 8, first + count)
+      [4 + 2C, 4 + 2C + 8 M)   padded row -> token (GEMM1 only)
+
+  where ``M`` is :func:`max_tiles` (the most tiles any routing of the call's
+  slots needs) and ``C`` is ``M`` rounded up to a multiple of four.
+
+The ids come from a top-k selection, so the valid ids of one row are distinct:
+an expert is chosen by at most ``rows <= 8`` slots and owns exactly one tile.
+The expert's tile is then the number of distinct selected experts below it (a
+presence bitmap), and a slot's rank the number of earlier rows that chose the
+expert (a row mask per expert): a few population counts, no scans.
+
+:class:`RoutedExpertRoute` builds the record from precomputed ids in one
+64-thread CTA; the fused front builds it with the same helpers.
+"""
+
+import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+from cutlass import Int32, Uint32
+
+TILE = 8
+MAX_EXPERTS = 384
+WORDS = MAX_EXPERTS // 32
+ROUTE_THREADS = 64  # >= rows * top_k (at most 8 * 8 slots)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def max_tiles(rows: Int32, top_k: Int32, experts: Int32) -> Int32:
+    """The most 8-row token tiles any routing of ``rows * top_k`` slots needs."""
+    slots = rows * top_k
+    filled = slots
+    if experts < slots:
+        filled = experts
+    return filled + (slots - filled) // TILE
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def tile_words(tiles: Int32) -> Int32:
+    """``C``: ``tiles`` rounded up to a multiple of four."""
+    return (tiles + 3) // 4 * 4
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def record_words(rows: Int32, top_k: Int32, experts: Int32) -> Int32:
+    """int32 length of the record."""
+    tiles = max_tiles(rows, top_k, experts)
+    return 4 + 2 * tile_words(tiles) + TILE * tiles
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def clear_scratch(
+    present: cute.Tensor,
+    rows_of: cute.Tensor,
+    thread: Int32,
+    threads: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+):
+    """Zero the expert bitmap and the per-expert row masks; a block barrier
+    must separate it from :func:`build_record`."""
+    for expert in cutlass.range(thread, MAX_EXPERTS, threads, unroll=1):
+        rows_of[expert] = Uint32(0)
+        if expert < WORDS:
+            present[expert] = Uint32(0)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def zero_record(
+    record: cute.Tensor,
+    rows: Int32,
+    top_k: Int32,
+    experts: Int32,
+    thread: Int32,
+    threads: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+):
+    """Zero the record; :func:`build_record`'s block barrier orders it before
+    that function's stores."""
+    for word in cutlass.range(
+        thread, record_words(rows, top_k, experts), threads, unroll=1
+    ):
+        record[word] = Int32(0)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def build_record(
+    present: cute.Tensor,
+    rows_of: cute.Tensor,
+    ids: cute.Tensor,
+    permuted: cute.Tensor,
+    record: cute.Tensor,
+    rows: Int32,
+    top_k: Int32,
+    experts: Int32,
+    thread: Int32,
+):
+    """Build the permutation and the record from ``ids`` (visible to every
+    thread of the block) into a zeroed record. Every thread of the block calls
+    it (it synchronizes the block once); thread ``s < rows * top_k`` handles
+    slot ``s``. ``experts``: a multiple of 32, at most 384; ``rows <= 8``."""
+    slots = rows * top_k
+    words = tile_words(max_tiles(rows, top_k, experts))
+    row = thread // top_k
+    expert = Int32(-1)
+    if thread < slots:
+        expert = Int32(ids[thread])
+        if expert < 0 or expert >= experts:
+            expert = Int32(-1)
+    if expert >= 0:
+        cute.arch.atomic_or(
+            present.iterator + (expert >> 5),
+            Uint32(1) << Uint32(expert & 31),
+            scope="cta",
+        )
+        cute.arch.atomic_or(
+            rows_of.iterator + expert, Uint32(1) << Uint32(row), scope="cta"
+        )
+    cute.arch.sync_threads()
+    if thread < slots:
+        tiles = Int32(0)
+        tile = Int32(0)
+        for word in cutlass.range_constexpr(WORDS):
+            bits = Int32(cute.arch.popc(present[word]))
+            tiles += bits
+            if word < (expert >> 5):  # never for expert -1
+                tile += bits
+        if thread == 0:
+            record[0] = tiles * TILE
+            record[1] = tiles
+        if expert < 0:
+            permuted[thread] = Int32(-1)
+        else:
+            below = (Uint32(1) << Uint32(expert & 31)) - Uint32(1)
+            tile += Int32(cute.arch.popc(present[expert >> 5] & below))
+            chosen_by = rows_of[expert]
+            count = Int32(cute.arch.popc(chosen_by))
+            earlier = (Uint32(1) << Uint32(row)) - Uint32(1)
+            rank = Int32(cute.arch.popc(chosen_by & earlier))
+            first = tile * TILE
+            permuted[thread] = first + rank
+            record[4 + 2 * words + first + rank] = row
+            if rank == 0:
+                record[4 + tile] = expert
+                limit = first + count
+                if count > TILE:
+                    limit = first + TILE
+                record[4 + words + tile] = limit
+
+
+class RoutedExpertRoute:
+    """The route kernel: the record from precomputed top-k ids (int32).
+
+    PDL: dependents may launch at once (the trigger is the first instruction),
+    so GEMM1's set-up overlaps this kernel; GEMM1 reads the outputs only after
+    its own grid-dependency wait. Every global access here follows this
+    kernel's own wait.
+    """
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        ids_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        permuted_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        record_ptr: cute.Pointer,
+        rows: Int32,
+        top_k: Int32,
+        experts: Int32,
+        stream: cuda.CUstream,
+    ):
+        """``ids``/``permuted``: int32 [rows, top_k]; rows in [1, 8],
+        ``rows * top_k <= 64``."""
+        slots = cute.make_layout(rows * top_k)
+        self.kernel(
+            cute.make_tensor(ids_ptr, slots),
+            cute.make_tensor(permuted_ptr, slots),
+            cute.make_tensor(
+                record_ptr, cute.make_layout(record_words(rows, top_k, experts))
+            ),
+            rows,
+            top_k,
+            experts,
+        ).launch(
+            grid=(1, 1, 1), block=[ROUTE_THREADS, 1, 1], stream=stream, use_pdl=True
+        )
+
+    @cute.kernel
+    def kernel(
+        self,
+        ids: cute.Tensor,
+        permuted: cute.Tensor,
+        record: cute.Tensor,
+        rows: Int32,
+        top_k: Int32,
+        experts: Int32,
+    ):
+        """One CTA of :data:`ROUTE_THREADS` threads."""
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_launch_dependents()
+
+        @cute.struct
+        class Scratch:
+            present: cute.struct.MemRange[Uint32, WORDS]
+            rows_of: cute.struct.MemRange[Uint32, MAX_EXPERTS]
+
+        scratch = cutlass.utils.SmemAllocator().allocate(Scratch)
+        present = cute.make_tensor(scratch.present.data_ptr(), cute.make_layout(WORDS))
+        rows_of = cute.make_tensor(
+            scratch.rows_of.data_ptr(), cute.make_layout(MAX_EXPERTS)
+        )
+        thread, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        clear_scratch(present, rows_of, thread, ROUTE_THREADS)
+        cute.arch.sync_threads()
+        cute.arch.griddepcontrol_wait()
+        zero_record(record, rows, top_k, experts, thread, ROUTE_THREADS)
+        build_record(
+            present, rows_of, ids, permuted, record, rows, top_k, experts, thread
+        )

+"""The MoE of a specialized decode step.
+
+Every MoE layer whose experts can stop after GEMM2 leaves its routed top-k
+reduction, the shared-expert add and the all-reduce to the next boundary's
+fused kernel, including the layers before an Engram layer and the last one,
+whose boundaries take the kernel's residual-only variant:
+
+- up to ``LOW_BATCH_MAX_ROWS`` rows, on the low-batch routed-expert GEMMs
+  (``routed_expert_gemm``);
+- above that, on the runner's own ``_forward_impl`` with the deferral raised to
+  the step's rows for the call (``deferred_finalize``).
+"""
+
+from collections.abc import Iterator
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.config import FusedMoEConfig
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.experts.trtllm_mxfp4_moe import (
+    TrtLlmMxfp4ExpertsModular,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.moe_output import (
+    MoEOutput,
+    UnfinalizedMoEOutput,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.runner.moe_runner import _unpack
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.runner.shared_experts import (
+    SharedExpertsOrder,

+

+    from ...model import DeepseekV4MoE

+
+@contextmanager
+def deferred_finalize(config: FusedMoEConfig, max_num_tokens: int) -> Iterator[None]:
+    """Within the block, let the experts leave the top-k reduction of calls of
+    up to ``max_num_tokens`` tokens to the caller; then restore the layer's own
+    deferral, which the stock forward reads."""
+    saved = config._defer_moe_finalize, config.defer_moe_finalize_max_num_tokens
+    config._defer_moe_finalize = True
+    config.defer_moe_finalize_max_num_tokens = max_num_tokens
+    try:
+        yield
+    finally:
+        config._defer_moe_finalize, config.defer_moe_finalize_max_num_tokens = saved
+
+
+def defers_finalize(ffn: "DeepseekV4MoE", max_num_tokens: int) -> bool:
+    """Whether ``ffn``'s experts can leave the top-k reduction to the fused
+    all-reduce + mHC: the modular TRT-LLM MXFP4 experts without routed scaling,
+    on a TP-only deployment."""
+    runner = ffn.experts
+    experts_cls = getattr(runner.routed_experts.quant_method, "experts_cls", None)
+    if (
+        experts_cls is not TrtLlmMxfp4ExpertsModular
+        or runner.routed_scaling_factor != 1.0
+        or ffn.use_native_mega_moe
+    ):
+        return False
+    with deferred_finalize(runner.moe_config, max_num_tokens):
+        return runner.moe_config.should_defer_moe_finalize(max_num_tokens)
+
+
+class MoEStep:
+    """One MoE layer of the decode step."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self, ffn: "DeepseekV4MoE", gemm: RoutedExpertGemm | None, max_rows: int
+    ) -> None:
+        self.ffn = ffn
+        self.runner = ffn.experts
+        self.deferrable = defers_finalize(ffn, max_rows)
+        # The low-batch GEMMs leave the top-k reduction open too.
+        self.gemm = gemm if self.deferrable else None
+
+    def run(
+        self, x: torch.Tensor, input_ids: torch.Tensor | None, step: "DecodeStep"
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | MoEOutput:
+        """The layer's TP-partial output, unfinalized where it can defer."""
+        if not self.deferrable:
+            return self.ffn(x, input_ids, None)
+        gemm = self.gemm
+        if step.low_batch and gemm is not None and gemm.accepts(x, self.runner):
+            routed, shared_output = self._forward_low_batch(gemm, x, input_ids)
+            return MoEOutput(routed=routed, shared_output=shared_output)
+        # The runner's custom op returns tensors only, so run its body directly.
+        with deferred_finalize(self.runner.moe_config, x.shape[0]):
+            shared_output, routed = _unpack(
+                self.runner._forward_impl(x, x, x, input_ids)
+            )
+        assert shared_output is not None
+        if isinstance(routed, UnfinalizedMoEOutput):
+            return MoEOutput(routed=routed, shared_output=shared_output)
+        # Experts that split the call across launches finalize it.
+        return shared_output + routed
+
+    def _forward_low_batch(
+        self,
+        gemm: RoutedExpertGemm,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor | None,
+    ) -> tuple[UnfinalizedMoEOutput, torch.Tensor]:
+        """The runner's ``_forward_impl`` with the routed experts on the
+        low-batch GEMMs; the gate and the shared experts run as the runner runs
+        them. Returns the unfinalized routed output and the shared output."""
+        runner = self.runner
+        shared = runner._shared_experts
+        assert shared is not None
+        runner.routed_experts._ensure_moe_quant_config_init()
+        overlapping = shared.maybe_forward_async(hidden_states)
+        router_logits, _ = runner.gate(hidden_states)
+        runner._maybe_apply_shared_experts(hidden_states, SharedExpertsOrder.NO_OVERLAP)
+        if front_applies(gemm, runner):
+            routing = gemm.front(hidden_states, router_logits, input_ids)
+        else:
+            topk_weights, topk_ids = runner.router.select_experts(
+                hidden_states=hidden_states,
+                router_logits=router_logits,
+                topk_indices_dtype=runner._quant_method.topk_indices_dtype,
+                input_ids=input_ids,
+            )
+            routing = gemm.route(hidden_states, topk_ids, topk_weights)
+        routed = gemm.gemms(routing)
+        if overlapping:
+            shared.wait()
+        # Read once: the property hands the output over and clears it.
+        return routed, shared.output

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""The specialized decode executor.
+
+``SpecializedDecode`` runs the decoder layers of ``DeepseekV4Model`` for the
+steps captured into FULL CUDA graphs of pure decode batches of up to
+``FUSED_MHC_MAX_ROWS`` rows. Its model state builds it once the weights are
+loaded. ``plan`` decides per forward whether it runs; the model's forward then
+passes the returned ``DecodeStep`` to the backbone, which runs its embedding
+and Engram hashing as usual and hands the layers to ``DecodeStep.run``. Every
+other forward (prefill, mixed, eager, PIECEWISE) runs the stock layers, which
+the executor leaves unchanged.
+
+Per layer the executor runs the stock modules through its own steps:
+
+- ``Boundaries`` (``boundary``): the mHC between sublayers, on the fused
+  all-reduce + mHC kernel;
+- ``AttentionStep`` (``attention.step``);
+- ``MoEStep`` (``moe.step``), which leaves the MoE finalize to the next
+  boundary;
+- ``EngramPrefetch`` (``engram.prefetch``) for the Engram layers.
+
+The steps issue TP collectives, so every decision reads host state that all TP
+ranks share: the step's rows and the attention metadata's host fields. Side
+streams the steps fork are joined before ``run`` returns, so a capture ends
+joined.
+"""
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, NamedTuple, TypeAlias, cast

+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+import vllm.envs as envs
+from vllm.config import CUDAGraphMode
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context, is_forward_context_available
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.mhc.triton import hc_collapse_triton
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.sparse_mqa_indexer import SparseMQAIndexer
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.common.engram import Engram
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.common.ops.query_quant import can_fuse_query_quant

+    FUSED_MHC_MAX_ROWS,
+    LOW_BATCH_MAX_ROWS,
+    MHC_OVERLAP_MAX_ROWS,
+    DecodeConfig,
+    uses_checked_flashinfer,
+)
+from ..attention.indexer import OVERLAP_MAX_ROWS, CandidateOverlap
+from ..attention.sparse_mla import SparseIndexTables, SparseMlaDecode
+from ..attention.step import AttentionStep
+from ..boundary.boundary import Boundaries, BoundaryState
+from ..engram.prefetch import EngramPrefetch
+from ..moe.routed_expert_gemm import build_routed_expert_gemms
+from ..moe.step import MoEStep

+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.sparse_swa import DeepseekSparseSWAMetadata
+
+    from ...model import DeepseekV4DecoderLayer, DeepseekV4Model

+# Most rows of a step whose Engram WKV runs ahead of the layers.

+class DecodeStep(NamedTuple):
+    """The host-side gates of one captured decode step, by its rows."""

+    rows: int
+    # The next mHC coefficients and aux means run on the mHC side stream;
+    # otherwise inline after the fused all-reduce + mHC.
+    side_stream: bool
+    # The low-batch GEMMs: routed experts, MXFP8 projections, ll_bf16 side
+    # projections, publishing wo_b.
+    low_batch: bool
+    # The attention side projections run on aux streams.
+    overlap_inputs: bool
+    # The candidate source forks the consumers' candidate expansion.
+    overlap_candidates: bool
+    # The Engram WKV runs ahead of the layers.
+    engram_prefetch: bool
+    executor: "SpecializedDecode"
+
+    def run(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor | None,
+        engram_hashes: torch.Tensor | None,
+        engram_mask: torch.Tensor | None,
+    ) -> DecodeOutput:
+        """The backbone's output after its embedding."""
+        return self.executor.run(
+            self, hidden_states, positions, input_ids, engram_hashes, engram_mask
+        )
+

+def step_gates(rows: int, executor: "SpecializedDecode") -> DecodeStep:
+    """The step of ``rows`` rows (0 < rows <= ``FUSED_MHC_MAX_ROWS``)."""

+        rows=rows,
+        side_stream=rows <= MHC_OVERLAP_MAX_ROWS,
+        low_batch=rows <= LOW_BATCH_MAX_ROWS,
+        overlap_inputs=rows <= envs.VLLM_MULTI_STREAM_GEMM_TOKEN_THRESHOLD,
+        overlap_candidates=rows <= OVERLAP_MAX_ROWS,
+        engram_prefetch=rows <= ENGRAM_PREFETCH_MAX_ROWS,
+        executor=executor,

+def captures_pure_decode(swa_prefixes: list[str]) -> bool:
+    """Whether the forward being captured into a CUDA graph is a FULL graph of
+    a pure decode step: not a PIECEWISE capture (Model Runner V2 captures FULL
+    graphs with the forward context's mode NONE, and PIECEWISE ones, which
+    report capturing too, with PIECEWISE), and decode metadata without
+    prefills for every SWA KV-cache group (``swa_prefixes``) of the layers."""
+    context = get_forward_context()

+    if context.cudagraph_runtime_mode == CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE or not isinstance(

+        if metadata is None or metadata.num_prefills > 0:
+            return False

+    layer_id: int
+    layer: "DeepseekV4DecoderLayer"
+    attention: AttentionStep
+    moe: MoEStep
+    engram: Engram | None

+            raise ValueError(
+                "decode_backend=latency_specialized needs the fused all-reduce + mHC"
+            )

+        from ..boundary.all_reduce import BoundaryAllReduce
+        from ..boundary.publishing_gemm import PublishingMxfp8Linear
+
+        # Collective: every TP rank builds the executor in lockstep.
+        self.all_reduce = BoundaryAllReduce(
+            backbone.config,
+            uses_checked_flashinfer("the fused kernel's MXFP8 layer input"),
+        )
+        self.boundaries = Boundaries(self.all_reduce)
+        self.publisher = (
+            PublishingMxfp8Linear(self.all_reduce)

+        self.mla = SparseMlaDecode(

+        source = next(
+            (
+                attn
+                for attn in attns
+                if attn.indexer is not None

+        consumers = [
+            attn

+                    attn,
+                    self.tables,
+                    self.mla,
+                    self.publisher,
+                    mxfp8_input=quantize and can_fuse_query_quant([attn.fused_wqa_wkv]),

+                    consumer=self.candidates if attn in consumers else None,

+    def for_target(
+        cls, backbone: "DeepseekV4Model", config: DecodeConfig, lm_head: nn.Module

+    def plan(
+        self,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        intermediate_tensors: IntermediateTensors | None,
+    ) -> DecodeStep | None:

+        FULL CUDA graph captures of pure decode steps of up to
+        ``FUSED_MHC_MAX_ROWS`` rows run the executor."""

+            intermediate_tensors is not None
+            or not 0 < rows <= FUSED_MHC_MAX_ROWS

+        ):

+    def run(

+                self.engram.start(x.shape[0])

+    def _join_side_work(self, error: bool = False) -> None:
+        """Make the current stream wait for the side streams' pending work."""
+        self.tables.join()

+            for layer_id in backbone.aux_hidden_state_layers
+            if layer_id in aux
+        ]
+        if aux_hidden_states:
+            return hidden_states, aux_hidden_states
+        return hidden_states

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""CUDA graphs of the attention metadata builds of FULL decode steps.
+
+A FULL CUDA graph replays the forward only: before every replay the runner
+still builds the attention metadata on the host, which refreshes the persistent
+buffers the graph reads. For small decode batches that build costs about as
+much as the replay. ``AttnMetadataCudaGraphs`` records, during CUDA graph
+capture, the build of every uniform decode batch shape that a FULL decode graph
+serves, and replays it on the steps of that shape, returning the metadata
+objects captured with it. A step of a shape without a recording builds its
+metadata eagerly.
+"""
+
+from collections.abc import Callable, Sequence
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.compilation.cudagraph_pool import capture_pool
+from vllm.config import CUDAGraphMode, VllmConfig
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.compressor import CompressorMetadataBuilder
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.flashinfer_sparse import (
+    DeepseekSparseSWAFlashInferMetadataBuilder,
+    DeepseekV4FlashInferSparseMLAMetadataBuilder,
+)
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.utils.math_utils import round_up
+from vllm.utils.torch_utils import current_stream
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.sparse_indexer import (
+    DeepseekV41SparseIndexerMetadataBuilder,
+)
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.input_batch import InputBatch
+from vllm.v1.worker.utils import AttentionGroup
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+# Builders whose build() of a uniform decode batch launches only capture-safe
+# work (no device-to-host reads, no pageable host-to-device copies) into
+# persistent buffers, with host arguments set by the batch shape.
+_RECORDABLE_BUILDERS = frozenset(
+    {
+        CompressorMetadataBuilder,
+        DeepseekSparseSWAFlashInferMetadataBuilder,
+        DeepseekV41SparseIndexerMetadataBuilder,
+        DeepseekV4FlashInferSparseMLAMetadataBuilder,
+    }
+)
+
+GraphKey = tuple[int, int, int, int]
+# Builds the metadata of the attention groups it is given.
+BuildFn = Callable[[list[list[AttentionGroup]]], dict[str, Any]]
+
+
+class AttnMetadataCudaGraphs:
+    """Records attention metadata builds by graph key during CUDA graph
+    capture, and replays them.
+
+    Each key is built once eagerly, warming lazy allocations, kernel
+    compilation and per-stream library state, then recorded with the metadata
+    it returns. The graphs write the builders' buffers at their capture-time
+    addresses: every capture releases and records them again.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig, decode_query_len: int) -> None:
+        self._vllm_config = vllm_config
+        self._decode_query_len = decode_query_len
+        self._graphs: dict[GraphKey, tuple[torch.cuda.CUDAGraph, dict[str, Any]]] = {}
+        self._side_streams: list[torch.cuda.Stream] = []
+        self._recordable: bool | None = None
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def key(input_batch: InputBatch, cudagraph_mode: CUDAGraphMode) -> GraphKey | None:
+        """The graph key of a step whose metadata build can be recorded, or None.
+
+        Only FULL steps of uniform decodes qualify; their key fixes every host
+        value the build reads. Under adaptive verification (``max_query_len``
+        set) the device splits the drafts, so the host query lengths are only
+        bounds.
+        """
+        if (
+            cudagraph_mode != CUDAGraphMode.FULL
+            or input_batch.has_prefill
+            or input_batch.max_query_len is not None
+        ):
+            return None
+        query_lens = input_batch.num_scheduled_tokens[: input_batch.num_reqs]
+        if not (query_lens == query_lens[0]).all():
+            return None
+        return (
+            input_batch.num_reqs,
+            input_batch.num_reqs_after_padding,
+            input_batch.num_tokens,
+            input_batch.num_tokens_after_padding,
+        )
+
+    def capture_keys(self) -> list[GraphKey]:
+        """The keys of the decode steps the FULL decode graphs serve, largest
+        first.
+
+        As in ``CudaGraphManager``, each capture size rounds up to whole
+        requests of the decode query length, and a step runs the smallest graph
+        that holds its requests.
+        """
+        config = self._vllm_config.compilation_config
+        query_len = self._decode_query_len
+        max_tokens = min(
+            self._vllm_config.scheduler_config.max_num_seqs * query_len,
+            config.max_cudagraph_capture_size,
+        )
+        graph_reqs = sorted(
+            {
+                round_up(size, query_len) // query_len
+                for size in config.cudagraph_capture_sizes or ()
+                if round_up(size, query_len) <= max_tokens
+            }
+        )
+        keys: list[GraphKey] = []
+        num_reqs = 1
+        for padded in graph_reqs:
+            keys += [
+                (n, padded, n * query_len, padded * query_len)
+                for n in range(num_reqs, padded + 1)
+            ]
+            num_reqs = padded + 1
+        return keys[::-1]
+
+    def can_record(self, attn_groups: list[list[AttentionGroup]]) -> bool:
+        """Whether every metadata builder of ``attn_groups`` is recordable."""
+        if self._recordable is None:
+            self._recordable = all(
+                type(group.get_metadata_builder()) in _RECORDABLE_BUILDERS
+                for groups in attn_groups
+                for group in groups
+            )
+        return self._recordable
+
+    def capture(
+        self,
+        key: GraphKey,
+        attn_groups: list[list[AttentionGroup]],
+        block_tables: Sequence[torch.Tensor],
+        build_fn: BuildFn,
+    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        """Record the build of ``key`` in the global CUDA graph pool, which the
+        FULL forward graphs and memory profiling use; returns its metadata."""
+        self._forked_build(attn_groups, block_tables, build_fn)
+        graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+        with (
+            capture_pool(
+                current_platform.get_global_graph_pool(), self._vllm_config
+            ) as pool,
+            torch.cuda.graph(graph, pool),
+        ):
+            attn_metadata = self._forked_build(attn_groups, block_tables, build_fn)
+        self._graphs[key] = (graph, attn_metadata)
+        return attn_metadata
+
+    def replay(self, key: GraphKey) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+        """Replay the build of ``key`` and return its metadata, or None if the
+        key was not recorded."""
+        entry = self._graphs.get(key)
+        if entry is None:
+            logger.warning_once(
+                "DeepSeek-V4.1 specialized decode: a FULL decode step has no "
+                "recorded attention-metadata build; building it eagerly."
+            )
+            return None
+        graph, attn_metadata = entry
+        graph.replay()
+        return attn_metadata
+
+    def _forked_build(
+        self,
+        attn_groups: list[list[AttentionGroup]],
+        block_tables: Sequence[torch.Tensor],
+        build_fn: BuildFn,
+    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        """Build the KV-cache groups as concurrent branches on side streams.
+
+        The groups share only read-only inputs, with two exceptions. The sparse
+        MLA builder clamps its block table in place, so groups whose block
+        tables share storage stay on one branch, in serial order. And the first
+        group that needs the token-to-request map builds it into its own buffer,
+        which later groups reuse. Each branch builds its own map; the serial
+        build's producer is also the first of its branch to need one, so it
+        fills the buffer that the FULL forward graphs read.
+        """
+        branches: dict[int, list[int]] = {}
+        for i, groups in enumerate(attn_groups):
+            if groups:
+                storage = block_tables[i].untyped_storage().data_ptr()
+                branches.setdefault(storage, []).append(i)
+        if len(branches) < 2:
+            return build_fn(attn_groups)
+        # Reused, so a warm-up creates per-stream state (e.g. DeepGEMM's) on the
+        # streams its capture records.
+        while len(self._side_streams) < len(branches):
+            self._side_streams.append(torch.cuda.Stream())
+        main_stream = current_stream()
+        built: dict[str, Any] = {}
+        for stream, branch in zip(self._side_streams, branches.values()):
+            stream.wait_stream(main_stream)
+            with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+                built.update(
+                    build_fn(
+                        [g if i in branch else [] for i, g in enumerate(attn_groups)]
+                    )
+                )
+        for stream in self._side_streams[: len(branches)]:
+            main_stream.wait_stream(stream)
+        # The serial build's layer order.
+        return {
+            name: built[name]
+            for groups in attn_groups
+            for group in groups
+            for name in group.layer_names
+        }
+
+    def release(self) -> None:
+        """Drop the recorded builds."""
+        self._graphs.clear()
+        self._recordable = None
